[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m
[31m+       const clientScope = req.user!.role === 'Client' ? (req.user as any).clientId : null;[39m
[31m+       const passportResult = await db.execute(sql`SELECT id, version, evidence, client_id AS "clientId" FROM passports WHERE id=${req.params.id} AND tenant_id=${tenantId} AND (${clientScope} IS NULL OR client_id=${clientScope}) LIMIT 1`) as any;[39m
[31m+       const passport = passportResult.rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+       if (!passport) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Passport not found' });[39m
[31m+       const findingResult = await db.execute(sql`SELECT id, passport_id AS "passportId", evidence_ids, status FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passport.id}`) as any;[39m
[31m+       const parseJson = (value: unknown): unknown[] => { try { const parsed = JSON.parse(String(value ?? '')); return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : []; } catch { return []; } };[39m
[31m+       const openFindingEvidenceIds = (findingResult.rows ?? []).filter((row: any) => !['resolved','closed','verified'].includes(String(row.status || '').toLowerCase())).flatMap((row: any) => parseJson(row.evidence_ids)).filter((id: any): id is string => typeof id === 'string');[39m
[31m+       const adapted = adaptEvidenceForEvaluation({ evidence: parseJson(passport.evidence) as any[], passportVersion: passport.version, openFindingEvidenceIds });[39m
[31m+       const evaluatedAt = Date.now();[39m
[31m+       const decision = evaluateVerification({ evidence: adapted.evidence, evaluatedAt, targetIdentity: adapted.targetIdentity });[39m
[31m+       res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'private, max-age=0, no-store');[39m
[31m+       return res.json({ decision, observations: decision.observationCount, independentSources: decision.independentSourceCount });[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) { return next(error); }[39m
[31m+   });[39m

[31m+   router.get('/user/verification', requireAuth, async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m
[31m+       const clientScope = req.user!.role === 'Client' ? (req.user as any).clientId : null;[39m
[31m+       const passportRows = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id, version, evidence, client_id AS "clientId" FROM passports WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND (${clientScope} IS NULL OR client_id=${clientScope}) ORDER BY id`) as any).rows ?? [];[39m
[31m+       const passportIds = passportRows.map((row: any) => String(row.id));[39m
[31m+       const parseJson = (value: unknown): unknown[] => { try { const parsed = JSON.parse(String(value ?? '')); return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : []; } catch { return []; } };[39m
[31m+       // Drizzle's proven one-query binding shape for the passport findings is[39m
[31m+       // `asset_id IN ${passportIds}`; do not replace this with ANY(array).[39m
[31m+       const findingRows = passportIds.length ? ((await db.execute(sql`SELECT id, passport_id AS "passportId", evidence_ids, status FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id IN ${passportIds}`) as any).rows ?? []) : [];[39m
[31m+       const evidenceByPassport = new Map<string, any[]>();[39m
[31m+       for (const passport of passportRows) evidenceByPassport.set(String(passport.id), parseJson(passport.evidence) as any[]);[39m
[31m+       const evaluatedAt = Date.now();[39m
[31m+       const verificationDecisions: Record<string, VerificationDecision> = {};[39m
[31m+       const verificationDetails: Record<string, unknown> = {};[39m
[31m+       for (const passport of passportRows) {[39m
[31m+         const findings = findingRows.filter((row: any) => String(row.passportId) === String(passport.id));[39m
[31m+         const openFindingEvidenceIds = findings.filter((row: any) => !['resolved','closed','verified'].includes(String(row.status || '').toLowerCase())).flatMap((row: any) => parseJson(row.evidence_ids)).filter((id: any): id is string => typeof id === 'string');[39m
[31m+         const adapted = adaptEvidenceForEvaluation({ evidence: evidenceByPassport.get(String(passport.id)) ?? [], passportVersion: passport.version, openFindingEvidenceIds });[39m
[31m+         const decision = evaluateVerification({ evidence: adapted.evidence, evaluatedAt, targetIdentity: adapted.targetIdentity });[39m
[31m+         verificationDecisions[String(passport.id)] = decision;[39m
[31m+         verificationDetails[String(passport.id)] = { unmappedCount: adapted.unmappedCount, undatedCount: adapted.undatedCount, observations: decision.observationCount, independentSources: decision.independentSourceCount };[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'private, max-age=0, no-store');[39m
[31m+       return res.json({ verificationDecisions, verificationDetails });[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) { return next(error); }[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return router;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+   router.get('/user/verification', requireAuth, async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m
[31m+       const clientScope = req.user!.role === 'Client' ? (req.user as any).clientId : null;[39m
[31m+       const passportRows = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id, version, evidence, client_id AS "clientId" FROM passports WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND (${clientScope} IS NULL OR client_id=${clientScope}) ORDER BY id`) as any).rows ?? [];[39m
[31m+       const passportIds = passportRows.map((row: any) => String(row.id));[39m
[31m+       const parseJson = (value: unknown): unknown[] => { try { const parsed = JSON.parse(String(value ?? '')); return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : []; } catch { return []; } };[39m
[31m+       // Drizzle's proven one-query binding shape for the passport findings is[39m
[31m+       // `asset_id IN ${passportIds}`; do not replace this with ANY(array).[39m
[31m+       const findingRows = passportIds.length ? ((await db.execute(sql`SELECT id, passport_id AS "passportId", evidence_ids, status FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id IN ${passportIds}`) as any).rows ?? []) : [];[39m
[31m+       const evidenceByPassport = new Map<string, any[]>();[39m
[31m+       for (const passport of passportRows) evidenceByPassport.set(String(passport.id), parseJson(passport.evidence) as any[]);[39m
[31m+       const evaluatedAt = Date.now();[39m
[31m+       const verificationDecisions: Record<string, VerificationDecision> = {};[39m
[31m+       const verificationDetails: Record<string, unknown> = {};[39m
[31m+       for (const passport of passportRows) {[39m
[31m+         const findings = findingRows.filter((row: any) => String(row.passportId) === String(passport.id));[39m
[31m+         const openFindingEvidenceIds = findings.filter((row: any) => !['resolved','closed','verified'].includes(String(row.status || '').toLowerCase())).flatMap((row: any) => parseJson(row.evidence_ids)).filter((id: any): id is string => typeof id === 'string');[39m
[31m+         const adapted = adaptEvidenceForEvaluation({ evidence: evidenceByPassport.get(String(passport.id)) ?? [], passportVersion: passport.version, openFindingEvidenceIds });[39m
[31m+         const decision = evaluateVerification({ evidence: adapted.evidence, evaluatedAt, targetIdentity: adapted.targetIdentity });[39m
[31m+         verificationDecisions[String(passport.id)] = decision;[39m
[31m+         verificationDetails[String(passport.id)] = { unmappedCount: adapted.unmappedCount, undatedCount: adapted.undatedCount, observations: decision.observationCount, independentSources: decision.independentSourceCount };[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'private, max-age=0, no-store');[39m
[31m+       return res.json({ verificationDecisions, verificationDetails });[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) { return next(error); }[39m
[31m+   });[39m

[31m+   return router;[39m

[31m+ import { adminAuth, setUserCustomClaims } from '../lib/firebase-admin.ts';[39m
[31m+ import { appendAuditEntry, verifyAuditChain } from '../security/audit-log.ts';[39m
[31m+ import { describeUserAgent, sessionFingerprint } from '../security/session-tracking.ts';[39m
[31m+ import { offboardTenantData } from '../db/sync.ts';[39m
[31m+ import { INTEGRATION_CATALOG } from '../integrations/catalog.ts';[39m

[31m+ const INVITABLE_ROLES = ['Admin', 'Technician', 'Viewer', 'Client'] as const;[39m
[31m+ const inviteSchema = z.object({ email: z.string().trim().email().max(255), role: z.enum(INVITABLE_ROLES) }).strict();[39m
[31m+ const roleUpdateSchema = z.object({ role: z.enum(INVITABLE_ROLES) }).strict();[39m
[31m+ const profileUpdateSchema = z.object({[39m
[31m+   displayName: z.string().trim().max(200).optional(),[39m
[31m+   roleTitle: z.string().trim().max(200).optional(),[39m
[31m+   companyName: z.string().trim().max(200).optional(),[39m
[31m+ }).strict();[39m
[31m+ const revokeSessionSchema = z.object({ sessionId: z.string().trim().min(1).max(200) }).strict();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ export function createAuthRouter() {[39m
[31m+   const router = Router();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   // The Firebase ID token is the sole authentication authority. The database[39m
[31m+   // record supplies the tenant/RBAC projection after token verification.[39m
[31m+   router.get('/user/me', requireAuth, async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const user = await db.select({[39m
[31m+         id: users.id,[39m
[31m+         uid: users.uid,[39m
[31m+         email: users.email,[39m
[31m+         tenantId: users.tenantId,[39m
[31m+         role: users.role,[39m
[31m+         companyName: users.companyName,[39m
[31m+         roleTitle: users.roleTitle,[39m
[31m+         displayName: users.displayName,[39m
[31m+         numTechnicians: users.numTechnicians,[39m
[31m+         clientCount: users.clientCount,[39m
[31m+         primaryUseCase: users.primaryUseCase,[39m
[31m+         onboarded: users.onboarded,[39m
[31m+         mfaEnabled: users.mfaEnabled,[39m
[31m+         createdAt: users.createdAt,[39m
[31m+       }).from(users).where(eq(users.uid, req.user!.uid)).then(rows => rows[0]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (!user) return res.status(403).json({ error: 'User account is not provisioned' });[39m
[31m+       return res.json({ ...user, emailVerified: req.user!.emailVerified });[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+       return next(error);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   router.put('/user/profile', requireAuth, async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const parsed = profileUpdateSchema.safeParse(req.body);[39m
[31m+       if (!parsed.success) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid request', details: parsed.error.flatten() });[39m
[31m+       const result = await db.execute(sql`[39m
[31m+         UPDATE users SET[39m
[31m+           display_name = COALESCE(${parsed.data.displayName ?? null}, display_name),[39m
[31m+           role_title = COALESCE(${parsed.data.roleTitle ?? null}, role_title),[39m
[31m+           company_name = COALESCE(${parsed.data.companyName ?? null}, company_name)[39m
[31m+         WHERE uid = ${req.user!.uid} AND tenant_id = ${req.user!.tenantId}[39m
[31m+         RETURNING id, email, display_name AS "displayName", role_title AS "roleTitle", company_name AS "companyName"[39m
[31m+       `);[39m
[31m+       const row = (result as any).rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+       if (!row) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'User account not found' });[39m
[31m+       await appendAuditEntry(db, { tenantId: req.user!.tenantId, action: 'profile.updated', actor: req.user!.email, payload: { userId: req.user!.id } });[39m
[31m+       return res.json(row);[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+       return next(error);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   });[39m

[31m+   router.get('/organization/team', requireAuth, async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const result = await db.execute(sql`[39m
[31m+         SELECT id, email, display_name AS "displayName", role, onboarded, created_at AS "createdAt"[39m
[31m+         FROM users WHERE tenant_id = ${req.user!.tenantId} ORDER BY created_at ASC[39m
[31m+       `);[39m
[31m+       return res.json((result as any).rows ?? []);[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m

[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   });[39m

[31m+   router.post('/organization/invite', requireAuth, requireRole(['Owner', 'Admin']), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const parsed = inviteSchema.safeParse(req.body);[39m
[31m+       if (!parsed.success) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid request', details: parsed.error.flatten() });[39m
[31m+       const email = parsed.data.email.toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const existing = await db.execute(sql`SELECT id FROM users WHERE tenant_id = ${req.user!.tenantId} AND lower(btrim(email)) = ${email} LIMIT 1`);[39m
[31m+       if ((existing as any).rows?.length) return res.status(409).json({ error: 'This email is already a member of your workspace.' });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       let firebaseUser;[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         firebaseUser = await adminAuth.getUserByEmail(email);[39m
[31m+       } catch {[39m
[31m+         firebaseUser = await adminAuth.createUser({ email, emailVerified: false });[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const inserted = await db.execute(sql`[39m
[31m+         INSERT INTO users (uid, email, tenant_id, role, invited_by, onboarded)[39m
[31m+         VALUES (${firebaseUser.uid}, ${email}, ${req.user!.tenantId}, ${parsed.data.role}, ${req.user!.email}, 0)[39m
[31m+         RETURNING id, email, role[39m
[31m+       `);[39m
[31m+       await setUserCustomClaims(firebaseUser.uid, { workspaceId: req.user!.tenantId, role: parsed.data.role });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       let inviteLink: string | null = null;[39m
[31m+       try { inviteLink = await adminAuth.generatePasswordResetLink(email); } catch { inviteLink = null; }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       await appendAuditEntry(db, { tenantId: req.user!.tenantId, action: 'team.invited', actor: req.user!.email, payload: { invitedEmail: email, role: parsed.data.role } });[39m
[31m+       return res.status(201).json({ ...(inserted as any).rows?.[0], inviteLink });[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+       return next(error);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   });[39m

[31m+   router.put('/organization/team/:userId/role', requireAuth, requireRole(['Owner', 'Admin']), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const parsed = roleUpdateSchema.safeParse(req.body);[39m
[31m+       if (!parsed.success) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid request', details: parsed.error.flatten() });[39m
[31m+       const targetId = Number(req.params.userId);[39m
[31m+       if (!Number.isInteger(targetId)) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid user id' });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const result = await db.execute(sql`[39m
[31m+         UPDATE users SET role = ${parsed.data.role}[39m
[31m+         WHERE id = ${targetId} AND tenant_id = ${req.user!.tenantId} AND role <> 'Owner'[39m
[31m+         RETURNING id, uid, email, role[39m
[31m+       `);[39m
[31m+       const row = (result as any).rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+       if (!row) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Team member not found, or the Owner role cannot be changed here.' });[39m
[31m+       await setUserCustomClaims(row.uid, { workspaceId: req.user!.tenantId, role: parsed.data.role });[39m
[31m+       await appendAuditEntry(db, { tenantId: req.user!.tenantId, action: 'team.role_changed', actor: req.user!.email, payload: { targetUserId: targetId, newRole: parsed.data.role } });[39m
[31m+       return res.json({ id: row.id, email: row.email, role: row.role });[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+       return next(error);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   router.delete('/organization/team/:userId', requireAuth, requireRole(['Owner', 'Admin']), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const targetId = Number(req.params.userId);[39m
[31m+       if (!Number.isInteger(targetId)) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid user id' });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const result = await db.execute(sql`[39m
[31m+         DELETE FROM users WHERE id = ${targetId} AND tenant_id = ${req.user!.tenantId} AND role <> 'Owner'[39m
[31m+         RETURNING id, uid, email[39m
[31m+       `);[39m
[31m+       const row = (result as any).rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+       if (!row) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Team member not found, or the Owner cannot be removed.' });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       try { await adminAuth.updateUser(row.uid, { disabled: true }); await adminAuth.revokeRefreshTokens(row.uid); } catch { /* Firebase account may already be gone; DB removal already took effect. */ }[39m
[31m+       await appendAuditEntry(db, { tenantId: req.user!.tenantId, action: 'team.removed', actor: req.user!.email, payload: { targetUserId: targetId, targetEmail: row.email } });[39m
[31m+       return res.status(204).send();[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+       return next(error);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   });[39m

[31m+   router.get('/auth/sessions', requireAuth, async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const currentIp = req.ip || req.socket.remoteAddress || 'unknown';[39m
[31m+       const currentUserAgent = typeof req.headers['user-agent'] === 'string' ? req.headers['user-agent'].slice(0, 512) : '';[39m
[31m+       const currentFingerprint = sessionFingerprint(req.user!.uid, currentIp, currentUserAgent);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const result = await db.execute(sql`[39m
[31m+         SELECT id, session_fingerprint AS "sessionFingerprint", ip, user_agent AS "userAgent", last_seen_at AS "lastSeenAt"[39m
[31m+         FROM user_sessions[39m
[31m+         WHERE tenant_id = ${req.user!.tenantId} AND user_id = ${req.user!.id} AND revoked_at IS NULL[39m
[31m+         ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC[39m
[31m+       `);[39m
[31m+       const rows = ((result as any).rows ?? []) as Array<{ id: string; sessionFingerprint: string; ip: string; userAgent: string; lastSeenAt: string }>;[39m
[31m+       return res.json(rows.map(row => ({[39m
[31m+         id: row.id,[39m
[31m+         email: req.user!.email,[39m
[31m+         current: row.sessionFingerprint === currentFingerprint,[39m
[31m+         ip: row.ip,[39m
[31m+         device: describeUserAgent(row.userAgent),[39m
[31m+         location: 'Not geolocated',[39m
[31m+         lastSeenAt: row.lastSeenAt,[39m
[31m+       })));[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+       return next(error);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   router.post('/auth/sessions/revoke', requireAuth, async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const parsed = revokeSessionSchema.safeParse(req.body);[39m
[31m+       if (!parsed.success) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid request', details: parsed.error.flatten() });[39m
[31m+       const currentIp = req.ip || req.socket.remoteAddress || 'unknown';[39m
[31m+       const currentUserAgent = typeof req.headers['user-agent'] === 'string' ? req.headers['user-agent'].slice(0, 512) : '';[39m
[31m+       const currentFingerprint = sessionFingerprint(req.user!.uid, currentIp, currentUserAgent);[39m
[31m+       if (parsed.data.sessionId === `sess_${currentFingerprint}`) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Cannot revoke the session you are currently using. Sign out instead.' });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const result = await db.execute(sql`[39m
[31m+         UPDATE user_sessions SET revoked_at = NOW()[39m
[31m+         WHERE id = ${parsed.data.sessionId} AND tenant_id = ${req.user!.tenantId} AND user_id = ${req.user!.id} AND revoked_at IS NULL[39m
[31m+         RETURNING id[39m
[31m+       `);[39m
[31m+       if (!((result as any).rows?.length)) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Session not found' });[39m
[31m+       await appendAuditEntry(db, { tenantId: req.user!.tenantId, action: 'session.revoked', actor: req.user!.email, payload: { sessionId: parsed.data.sessionId } });[39m
[31m+       return res.status(204).send();[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+       return next(error);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   });[39m

[31m+   router.get('/auth/audit-chain', requireAuth, async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const beforeRaw = typeof req.query.before === 'string' ? Number(req.query.before) : null;[39m
[31m+       const before = Number.isInteger(beforeRaw) && beforeRaw! > 0 ? beforeRaw : null;[39m
[31m+       const result = before[39m
[31m+         ? await db.execute(sql`[39m
[31m+             SELECT id, action, timestamp, actor, payload, current_hash AS "currentHash", previous_hash AS "previousHash"[39m
[31m+             FROM audit_trail WHERE tenant_id = ${req.user!.tenantId} AND id < ${before} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50[39m
[31m+           `)[39m
[31m+         : await db.execute(sql`[39m
[31m+         SELECT id, action, timestamp, actor, payload, current_hash AS "currentHash", previous_hash AS "previousHash"[39m
[31m+         FROM audit_trail WHERE tenant_id = ${req.user!.tenantId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50[39m
[31m+       `);[39m
[31m+       const rows = ((result as any).rows ?? []) as Array<{ id: number; action: string; timestamp: string; actor: string; payload: string; currentHash: string; previousHash: string }>;[39m
[31m+       return res.json(rows.map(row => ({[39m
[31m+         id: row.id,[39m
[31m+         action: row.action,[39m
[31m+         timestamp: row.timestamp,[39m
[31m+         actor: row.actor,[39m
[31m+         payload: row.payload,[39m
[31m+         hash: row.currentHash,[39m
[31m+         currentHash: row.currentHash,[39m
[31m+         previousHash: row.previousHash,[39m
[31m+         block: { action: row.action, userEmail: row.actor.includes('@') ? row.actor : null },[39m
[31m+       })));[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+       return next(error);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   });[39m

[31m+   // Owner-only founder metrics. Every value is either observed from tenant[39m
[31m+   // data or explicitly reported as not verified; this endpoint never invents[39m
[31m+   // production health, security, financial, or performance telemetry.[39m
[31m+   router.get('/founder/metrics', requireAuth, requireRole('Owner'), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const counts = await db.execute(sql`[39m
[31m+         SELECT[39m
[31m+           (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM clients WHERE tenant_id = ${req.user!.tenantId}) AS "clientCount",[39m
[31m+           (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM passports WHERE tenant_id = ${req.user!.tenantId}) AS "passportCount",[39m
[31m+           (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM scans WHERE tenant_id = ${req.user!.tenantId}) AS "scanCount"[39m
[31m+       `);[39m
[31m+       const row = (counts as any).rows?.[0] || {};[39m
[31m+       return res.json({[39m
[31m+         latency: 'Not verified',[39m
[31m+         capitalProtected: 'Not verified',[39m
[31m+         throughput: 'Not verified',[39m
[31m+         mitigations: 'Not verified',[39m
[31m+         overallScore: null,[39m
[31m+         auditEvents: null,[39m
[31m+         activeThreats: null,[39m
[31m+         systemIntegrity: 'Not verified',[39m
[31m+         observed: {[39m
[31m+           clientCount: Number(row.clientCount || 0),[39m
[31m+           passportCount: Number(row.passportCount || 0),[39m
[31m+           scanCount: Number(row.scanCount || 0),[39m
[31m+         },[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+       return next(error);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   // Owner-only operational health for the command center. Every section reads[39m
[31m+   // from the real tables the corresponding subsystem already writes -- no[39m
[31m+   // second heartbeat, delivery ledger, integration status, or audit verifier[39m
[31m+   // is created here. Sections with no real backing data are omitted rather[39m
[31m+   // than populated with placeholder values; see the `notes` field.[39m
[31m+   router.get('/founder/operations', requireAuth, requireRole('Owner'), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m
[31m+       const notes: string[] = [];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- A. Worker/job health ---------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       // osv-worker.ts claims agent_jobs rows (job_type osv_manifest_scan /[39m
[31m+       // repository_scan). It has no separate heartbeat row; the queue state[39m
[31m+       // itself (locked_at/locked_by, the same 10-minute staleness window the[39m
[31m+       // worker uses to reclaim stuck jobs) is the real signal.[39m
[31m+       const [osvCounts, osvStale, osvFailures, osvActivity] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT job_type AS "jobType", status, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') GROUP BY job_type, status`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') AND status='Running' AND locked_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, job_type AS "jobType", error, attempt_count AS "attemptCount", max_attempts AS "maxAttempts", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') AND status='Failed' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 5`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT MAX(updated_at) AS "lastActivityAt" FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan')`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // monitoring-worker.ts (the file name this dashboard's spec named) is not[39m
[31m+       // imported by worker.ts and never runs in production -- confirmed dead[39m
[31m+       // code, not a running system. trust-monitoring-worker.ts is the real,[39m
[31m+       // currently-running system that plays the equivalent role (collector_jobs[39m
[31m+       // has an actual heartbeat_at column, unlike agent_jobs).[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+   // Owner-only operational health for the command center. Every section reads[39m
[31m+   // from the real tables the corresponding subsystem already writes -- no[39m
[31m+   // second heartbeat, delivery ledger, integration status, or audit verifier[39m
[31m+   // is created here. Sections with no real backing data are omitted rather[39m
[31m+   // than populated with placeholder values; see the `notes` field.[39m
[31m+   router.get('/founder/operations', requireAuth, requireRole('Owner'), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m
[31m+       const notes: string[] = [];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- A. Worker/job health ---------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       // osv-worker.ts claims agent_jobs rows (job_type osv_manifest_scan /[39m
[31m+       // repository_scan). It has no separate heartbeat row; the queue state[39m
[31m+       // itself (locked_at/locked_by, the same 10-minute staleness window the[39m
[31m+       // worker uses to reclaim stuck jobs) is the real signal.[39m
[31m+       const [osvCounts, osvStale, osvFailures, osvActivity] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT job_type AS "jobType", status, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') GROUP BY job_type, status`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') AND status='Running' AND locked_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, job_type AS "jobType", error, attempt_count AS "attemptCount", max_attempts AS "maxAttempts", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') AND status='Failed' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 5`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT MAX(updated_at) AS "lastActivityAt" FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan')`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // monitoring-worker.ts (the file name this dashboard's spec named) is not[39m
[31m+       // imported by worker.ts and never runs in production -- confirmed dead[39m
[31m+       // code, not a running system. trust-monitoring-worker.ts is the real,[39m
[31m+       // currently-running system that plays the equivalent role (collector_jobs[39m
[31m+       // has an actual heartbeat_at column, unlike agent_jobs).[39m
[31m+       const [monitoringCounts, monitoringHeartbeat, monitoringFailures] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT state, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} GROUP BY state`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT MAX(heartbeat_at) AS "lastHeartbeatAt" FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND state='running'`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, collector_id AS "collectorId", safe_error_code AS "errorCode", safe_error_message AS "errorMessage", completed_at AS "completedAt" FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND state IN ('failed','dead_lettered') ORDER BY completed_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       notes.push('monitoring-worker.ts is dead code (never imported by worker.ts); "monitoringWorker" below reflects trust-monitoring-worker.ts, the real running system for the same role.');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- B. Webhook delivery health ----------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       const [webhookCounts, webhookEndpoints, webhookFailures] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT status, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM spr_webhook_deliveries WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND created_at::timestamptz > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY status`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE active)::int AS "activeCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT active)::int AS "disabledCount" FROM spr_webhooks WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId}`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT d.id, d.webhook_id AS "webhookId", w.url, d.event_type AS "eventType", d.safe_error_code AS "errorCode", d.safe_error_message AS "errorMessage", d.completed_at AS "completedAt" FROM spr_webhook_deliveries d JOIN spr_webhooks w ON w.id=d.webhook_id AND w.tenant_id=d.tenant_id WHERE d.tenant_id=${tenantId} AND d.status IN ('failed','dead_lettered') ORDER BY d.completed_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       notes.push('Webhook failures are grouped by destination endpoint (webhookId/url), not "provider" -- SPR webhooks are user-configured destination URLs, not third-party provider connectors; there is no per-provider concept for outbound deliveries.');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- C. Integration health ----------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       const [credentialRows, integrationRows] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT provider, status, last_tested_at AS "lastTestedAt" FROM integration_credentials WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId}`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT name, connected, last_sync_date AS "lastSyncDate" FROM integrations WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId}`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       const credentialByProvider = new Map<string, any>((credentialRows as any).rows?.map((r: any) => [r.provider, r]) ?? []);[39m
[31m+       const integrationByName = new Map<string, any>((integrationRows as any).rows?.map((r: any) => [r.name, r]) ?? []);[39m
[31m+       const integrations = INTEGRATION_CATALOG.map((item) => ({[39m
[31m+         provider: item.provider,[39m
[31m+         name: item.name,[39m

[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m

[31m+       const passportRows = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id, version, evidence, client_id AS "clientId" FROM passports WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND (${clientScope} IS NULL OR client_id=${clientScope}) ORDER BY id`) as any).rows ?? [];[39m
[31m+       const passportIds = passportRows.map((row: any) => String(row.id));[39m
[31m+       const parseJson = (value: unknown): unknown[] => { try { const parsed = JSON.parse(String(value ?? '')); return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : []; } catch { return []; } };[39m
[31m+       // Drizzle's proven one-query binding shape for the passport findings is[39m
[31m+       // `asset_id IN ${passportIds}`; do not replace this with ANY(array).[39m
[31m+       const findingRows = passportIds.length ? ((await db.execute(sql`SELECT id, passport_id AS "passportId", evidence_ids, status FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id IN ${passportIds}`) as any).rows ?? []) : [];[39m
[31m+       const evidenceByPassport = new Map<string, any[]>();[39m
[31m+       for (const passport of passportRows) evidenceByPassport.set(String(passport.id), parseJson(passport.evidence) as any[]);[39m

[31m+         const openFindingEvidenceIds = findings.filter((row: any) => !['resolved','closed','verified'].includes(String(row.status || '').toLowerCase())).flatMap((row: any) => parseJson(row.evidence_ids)).filter((id: any): id is string => typeof id === 'string');[39m
[31m+         const adapted = adaptEvidenceForEvaluation({ evidence: evidenceByPassport.get(String(passport.id)) ?? [], passportVersion: passport.version, openFindingEvidenceIds });[39m
[31m+         const decision = evaluateVerification({ evidence: adapted.evidence, evaluatedAt, targetIdentity: adapted.targetIdentity });[39m
[31m+         verificationDecisions[String(passport.id)] = decision;[39m
[31m+         verificationDetails[String(passport.id)] = { unmappedCount: adapted.unmappedCount, undatedCount: adapted.undatedCount, observations: decision.observationCount, independentSources: decision.independentSourceCount };[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'private, max-age=0, no-store');[39m
[31m+       return res.json({ verificationDecisions, verificationDetails });[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) { return next(error); }[39m
[31m+   });[39m

[31m+       if ((existing as any).rows?.length) return res.status(409).json({ error: 'This email is already a member of your workspace.' });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       let firebaseUser;[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         firebaseUser = await adminAuth.getUserByEmail(email);[39m
[31m+       } catch {[39m
[31m+         firebaseUser = await adminAuth.createUser({ email, emailVerified: false });[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const inserted = await db.execute(sql`[39m
[31m+         INSERT INTO users (uid, email, tenant_id, role, invited_by, onboarded)[39m
[31m+         VALUES (${firebaseUser.uid}, ${email}, ${req.user!.tenantId}, ${parsed.data.role}, ${req.user!.email}, 0)[39m
[31m+         RETURNING id, email, role[39m
[31m+       `);[39m
[31m+       await setUserCustomClaims(firebaseUser.uid, { workspaceId: req.user!.tenantId, role: parsed.data.role });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       let inviteLink: string | null = null;[39m
[31m+       try { inviteLink = await adminAuth.generatePasswordResetLink(email); } catch { inviteLink = null; }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       await appendAuditEntry(db, { tenantId: req.user!.tenantId, action: 'team.invited', actor: req.user!.email, payload: { invitedEmail: email, role: parsed.data.role } });[39m
[31m+       return res.status(201).json({ ...(inserted as any).rows?.[0], inviteLink });[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+       return next(error);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   });[39m

[31m+         timestamp: row.timestamp,[39m
[31m+         actor: row.actor,[39m
[31m+         payload: row.payload,[39m
[31m+         hash: row.currentHash,[39m

[31m+   // Owner-only operational health for the command center. Every section reads[39m
[31m+   // from the real tables the corresponding subsystem already writes -- no[39m
[31m+   // second heartbeat, delivery ledger, integration status, or audit verifier[39m
[31m+   // is created here. Sections with no real backing data are omitted rather[39m
[31m+   // than populated with placeholder values; see the `notes` field.[39m
[31m+   router.get('/founder/operations', requireAuth, requireRole('Owner'), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m
[31m+       const notes: string[] = [];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- A. Worker/job health ---------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       // osv-worker.ts claims agent_jobs rows (job_type osv_manifest_scan /[39m
[31m+       // repository_scan). It has no separate heartbeat row; the queue state[39m
[31m+       // itself (locked_at/locked_by, the same 10-minute staleness window the[39m
[31m+       // worker uses to reclaim stuck jobs) is the real signal.[39m
[31m+       const [osvCounts, osvStale, osvFailures, osvActivity] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT job_type AS "jobType", status, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') GROUP BY job_type, status`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') AND status='Running' AND locked_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, job_type AS "jobType", error, attempt_count AS "attemptCount", max_attempts AS "maxAttempts", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') AND status='Failed' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 5`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT MAX(updated_at) AS "lastActivityAt" FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan')`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // monitoring-worker.ts (the file name this dashboard's spec named) is not[39m
[31m+       // imported by worker.ts and never runs in production -- confirmed dead[39m
[31m+       // code, not a running system. trust-monitoring-worker.ts is the real,[39m
[31m+       // currently-running system that plays the equivalent role (collector_jobs[39m
[31m+       // has an actual heartbeat_at column, unlike agent_jobs).[39m
[31m+       const [monitoringCounts, monitoringHeartbeat, monitoringFailures] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT state, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} GROUP BY state`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT MAX(heartbeat_at) AS "lastHeartbeatAt" FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND state='running'`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, collector_id AS "collectorId", safe_error_code AS "errorCode", safe_error_message AS "errorMessage", completed_at AS "completedAt" FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND state IN ('failed','dead_lettered') ORDER BY completed_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       notes.push('monitoring-worker.ts is dead code (never imported by worker.ts); "monitoringWorker" below reflects trust-monitoring-worker.ts, the real running system for the same role.');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- B. Webhook delivery health ----------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       const [webhookCounts, webhookEndpoints, webhookFailures] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT status, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM spr_webhook_deliveries WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND created_at::timestamptz > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY status`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE active)::int AS "activeCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT active)::int AS "disabledCount" FROM spr_webhooks WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId}`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT d.id, d.webhook_id AS "webhookId", w.url, d.event_type AS "eventType", d.safe_error_code AS "errorCode", d.safe_error_message AS "errorMessage", d.completed_at AS "completedAt" FROM spr_webhook_deliveries d JOIN spr_webhooks w ON w.id=d.webhook_id AND w.tenant_id=d.tenant_id WHERE d.tenant_id=${tenantId} AND d.status IN ('failed','dead_lettered') ORDER BY d.completed_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       notes.push('Webhook failures are grouped by destination endpoint (webhookId/url), not "provider" -- SPR webhooks are user-configured destination URLs, not third-party provider connectors; there is no per-provider concept for outbound deliveries.');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- C. Integration health ----------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       const [credentialRows, integrationRows] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT provider, status, last_tested_at AS "lastTestedAt" FROM integration_credentials WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId}`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT name, connected, last_sync_date AS "lastSyncDate" FROM integrations WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId}`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       const credentialByProvider = new Map<string, any>((credentialRows as any).rows?.map((r: any) => [r.provider, r]) ?? []);[39m
[31m+       const integrationByName = new Map<string, any>((integrationRows as any).rows?.map((r: any) => [r.name, r]) ?? []);[39m
[31m+       const integrations = INTEGRATION_CATALOG.map((item) => ({[39m
[31m+         provider: item.provider,[39m
[31m+         name: item.name,[39m
[31m+         connected: Boolean(integrationByName.get(item.name)?.connected),[39m
[31m+         lastSyncDate: integrationByName.get(item.name)?.lastSyncDate ?? null,[39m
[31m+         credentialStatus: credentialByProvider.get(item.provider)?.status ?? 'NOT_CONFIGURED',[39m
[31m+         lastTestedAt: credentialByProvider.get(item.provider)?.lastTestedAt ?? null,[39m
[31m+       }));[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- D. Audit chain integrity --------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       // Reuses the exact function GET /api/auth/audit-chain/verify calls --[39m
[31m+       // no second verifier.[39m
[31m+       const auditChain = await verifyAuditChain(db, tenantId);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- E. Scan / job queue --------------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       const [runningRepoScans, complianceSchedules] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, passport_id AS "passportId", status, progress, updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type='repository_scan' AND status='Running' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 10`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, client_id AS "clientId", frequency, status, last_audit_at AS "lastAuditAt", next_audit_at AS "nextAuditAt" FROM compliance_schedules WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} ORDER BY COALESCE(last_audit_at, created_at) DESC LIMIT 10`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return res.json({[39m
[31m+         generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),[39m
[31m+         workers: {[39m
[31m+           osv: {[39m
[31m+             countsByStatus: (osvCounts as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+             staleRunningCount: Number((osvStale as any).rows?.[0]?.count ?? 0),[39m
[31m+             recentFailures: (osvFailures as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+             lastActivityAt: (osvActivity as any).rows?.[0]?.lastActivityAt ?? null,[39m
[31m+           },[39m
[31m+           monitoringWorker: {[39m
[31m+             realSource: 'trust-monitoring-worker.ts (collector_jobs)',[39m
[31m+             countsByState: (monitoringCounts as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+             lastHeartbeatAt: (monitoringHeartbeat as any).rows?.[0]?.lastHeartbeatAt ?? null,[39m
[31m+             recentFailures: (monitoringFailures as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+           },[39m
[31m+         },[39m
[31m+         webhooks: {[39m
[31m+           countsByStatusLast7Days: (webhookCounts as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+           activeEndpoints: Number((webhookEndpoints as any).rows?.[0]?.activeCount ?? 0),[39m
[31m+           disabledEndpoints: Number((webhookEndpoints as any).rows?.[0]?.disabledCount ?? 0),[39m
[31m+           recentFailures: (webhookFailures as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+         },[39m
[31m+         integrations,[39m
[31m+         auditChain,[39m
[31m+         queue: {[39m

[31m+ function buildReportTypeExtras(reportType: string, passport: any, findings: any[]) {[39m
[31m+   if (reportType === 'sbom') {[39m
[31m+     const components = parseJson(passport.sbom, []) as any[];[39m
[31m+     const vulnerabilities = parseJson(passport.vulnerabilities, []) as any[];[39m
[31m+     const sbom = components.map((component) => {[39m
[31m+       const name = component?.name || component?.packageName || component?.component;[39m
[31m+       const matched = vulnerabilities.filter((vuln) => (vuln?.component || vuln?.packageName || vuln?.package) === name);[39m
[31m+       return { ...component, vulnerabilityCount: matched.length, criticalOrHighCount: matched.filter((vuln) => SEVERITY_ORDER.slice(0, 2).includes(String(vuln?.severity || '').toLowerCase())).length };[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     return { sbom };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (reportType === 'compliance') {[39m
[31m+     const byControl = new Map<string, { controlId: string; findingCount: number; openCount: number; worstSeverity: string; findingIds: string[] }>();[39m
[31m+     for (const finding of findings) {[39m
[31m+       const controlId = finding.control_id || 'unmapped';[39m
[31m+       const entry = byControl.get(controlId) || { controlId, findingCount: 0, openCount: 0, worstSeverity: 'low', findingIds: [] as string[] };[39m
[31m+       entry.findingCount += 1;[39m
[31m+       entry.findingIds.push(finding.id);[39m
[31m+       if (!['resolved', 'closed', 'verified'].includes(String(finding.status || '').toLowerCase())) entry.openCount += 1;[39m
[31m+       const severity = String(finding.severity || '').toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+       if (SEVERITY_ORDER.includes(severity) && SEVERITY_ORDER.indexOf(severity) < SEVERITY_ORDER.indexOf(entry.worstSeverity)) entry.worstSeverity = severity;[39m
[31m+       byControl.set(controlId, entry);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return { controls: [...byControl.values()] };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return {};[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export async function buildAndPersistReport(db: any, tenantId: string, passportId: string, reportType: string) {[39m
[31m+   const passport = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,name,overall_score,security_score,compliance_score,verification_status,confidence_score,evidence_completeness,sbom,evidence,vulnerabilities,timeline FROM passports WHERE id=${passportId} AND tenant_id=${tenantId} LIMIT 1`) as any).rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+   if (!passport) return null;[39m
[31m+   const findings = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,control_id,title,severity,status,description,remediation,evidence_ids,updated_at,resolved_at FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'low' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END,updated_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const evidence = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,provider,control_id,subject,source_url,observed_at,verification_method,status,severity,evidence_hash,limitation FROM evidence_ledger WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY observed_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const observations = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,observation_version,generated_at,previous_observation_id,evidence_ids,finding_ids,canonical_payload_hash,completeness_basis_points,confidence_basis_points,open_finding_count,unknown_dimension_count FROM trust_observations WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY observation_version DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const remediation = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM trust_remediation_work_items WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const verification = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM remediation_verification_ledger WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND finding_id IN (SELECT id FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId}) ORDER BY created_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const latest = observations[0];[39m
[31m+   const risk = deriveReportRiskFields(passport as ReportPassportRow);[39m
[31m+   const report = {[39m
[31m+     schemaVersion: 'spr.report.v2', reportType, generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(), passport: { id: passport.id, name: passport.name },[39m
[31m+     risk: { overall: risk.canonicalScore, security: passport.security_score, compliance: passport.compliance_score, verificationStatus: risk.verificationStatus },[39m
[31m+     evidenceQuality: { completenessBasisPoints: risk.completenessBasisPoints, confidenceBasisPoints: risk.confidenceBasisPoints, unknownDimensions: latest?.unknown_dimension_count ?? 0, latestObservationAt: latest?.generated_at ?? null },[39m
[31m+     findings, evidence, observations, remediation, verification,[39m
[31m+     traceability: 'Report -> Passport -> Risk -> Finding -> Observation -> Provider -> Source -> Timestamp -> Hash',[39m
[31m+     resolutionTraceability: 'Finding -> remediation -> new observation -> independent verification',[39m
[31m+     limitations: evidence.filter((item: any) => item.limitation).map((item: any) => ({ evidenceId: item.id, limitation: item.limitation })),[39m
[31m+     ...buildReportTypeExtras(reportType, passport, findings),[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+   const canonicalPayload = JSON.stringify(report);[39m
[31m+   const reportHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalPayload).digest('hex');[39m
[31m+   await db.execute(sql`INSERT INTO trust_report_snapshots (id,tenant_id,passport_id,report_type,generated_at,score,confidence_basis_points,completeness_basis_points,evidence_ids,finding_ids,observation_id,canonical_payload_hash,payload,created_at) VALUES (${id('report')},${tenantId},${passportId},${reportType},${report.generatedAt},${risk.canonicalScore},${risk.confidenceBasisPoints},${risk.completenessBasisPoints},${JSON.stringify(evidence.map((item: any) => item.id))},${JSON.stringify(findings.map((item: any) => item.id))},${latest?.id ?? null},${reportHash},${canonicalPayload},${report.generatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,passport_id,report_type,canonical_payload_hash) DO NOTHING`);[39m
[31m+   return { ...report, reportHash };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+   router.post('/organization/invite', requireAuth, requireRole(['Owner', 'Admin']), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const parsed = inviteSchema.safeParse(req.body);[39m
[31m+       if (!parsed.success) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid request', details: parsed.error.flatten() });[39m
[31m+       const email = parsed.data.email.toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const existing = await db.execute(sql`SELECT id FROM users WHERE tenant_id = ${req.user!.tenantId} AND lower(btrim(email)) = ${email} LIMIT 1`);[39m
[31m+       if ((existing as any).rows?.length) return res.status(409).json({ error: 'This email is already a member of your workspace.' });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       let firebaseUser;[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         firebaseUser = await adminAuth.getUserByEmail(email);[39m
[31m+       } catch {[39m
[31m+         firebaseUser = await adminAuth.createUser({ email, emailVerified: false });[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const inserted = await db.execute(sql`[39m
[31m+         INSERT INTO users (uid, email, tenant_id, role, invited_by, onboarded)[39m
[31m+         VALUES (${firebaseUser.uid}, ${email}, ${req.user!.tenantId}, ${parsed.data.role}, ${req.user!.email}, 0)[39m
[31m+         RETURNING id, email, role[39m
[31m+       `);[39m
[31m+       await setUserCustomClaims(firebaseUser.uid, { workspaceId: req.user!.tenantId, role: parsed.data.role });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       let inviteLink: string | null = null;[39m
[31m+       try { inviteLink = await adminAuth.generatePasswordResetLink(email); } catch { inviteLink = null; }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       await appendAuditEntry(db, { tenantId: req.user!.tenantId, action: 'team.invited', actor: req.user!.email, payload: { invitedEmail: email, role: parsed.data.role } });[39m
[31m+       return res.status(201).json({ ...(inserted as any).rows?.[0], inviteLink });[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+       return next(error);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   });[39m

[31m+   router.get('/auth/sessions', requireAuth, async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const currentIp = req.ip || req.socket.remoteAddress || 'unknown';[39m
[31m+       const currentUserAgent = typeof req.headers['user-agent'] === 'string' ? req.headers['user-agent'].slice(0, 512) : '';[39m
[31m+       const currentFingerprint = sessionFingerprint(req.user!.uid, currentIp, currentUserAgent);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const result = await db.execute(sql`[39m
[31m+         SELECT id, session_fingerprint AS "sessionFingerprint", ip, user_agent AS "userAgent", last_seen_at AS "lastSeenAt"[39m
[31m+         FROM user_sessions[39m
[31m+         WHERE tenant_id = ${req.user!.tenantId} AND user_id = ${req.user!.id} AND revoked_at IS NULL[39m
[31m+         ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC[39m
[31m+       `);[39m
[31m+       const rows = ((result as any).rows ?? []) as Array<{ id: string; sessionFingerprint: string; ip: string; userAgent: string; lastSeenAt: string }>;[39m
[31m+       return res.json(rows.map(row => ({[39m
[31m+         id: row.id,[39m
[31m+         email: req.user!.email,[39m
[31m+         current: row.sessionFingerprint === currentFingerprint,[39m
[31m+         ip: row.ip,[39m
[31m+         device: describeUserAgent(row.userAgent),[39m
[31m+         location: 'Not geolocated',[39m
[31m+         lastSeenAt: row.lastSeenAt,[39m
[31m+       })));[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+       return next(error);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   });[39m

[31m+       const parsed = revokeSessionSchema.safeParse(req.body);[39m

[31m+       const currentIp = req.ip || req.socket.remoteAddress || 'unknown';[39m
[31m+       const currentUserAgent = typeof req.headers['user-agent'] === 'string' ? req.headers['user-agent'].slice(0, 512) : '';[39m

[31m+         UPDATE user_sessions SET revoked_at = NOW()[39m

[31m+       await appendAuditEntry(db, { tenantId: req.user!.tenantId, action: 'session.revoked', actor: req.user!.email, payload: { sessionId: parsed.data.sessionId } });[39m
[31m+       return res.status(204).send();[39m

[31m+       return next(error);[39m

[31m+           `)[39m
[31m+         : await db.execute(sql`[39m
[31m+         SELECT id, action, timestamp, actor, payload, current_hash AS "currentHash", previous_hash AS "previousHash"[39m
[31m+         FROM audit_trail WHERE tenant_id = ${req.user!.tenantId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50[39m
[31m+       `);[39m
[31m+       const rows = ((result as any).rows ?? []) as Array<{ id: number; action: string; timestamp: string; actor: string; payload: string; currentHash: string; previousHash: string }>;[39m
[31m+       return res.json(rows.map(row => ({[39m
[31m+         id: row.id,[39m
[31m+         action: row.action,[39m
[31m+         timestamp: row.timestamp,[39m
[31m+         actor: row.actor,[39m
[31m+         payload: row.payload,[39m
[31m+         hash: row.currentHash,[39m
[31m+         currentHash: row.currentHash,[39m
[31m+         previousHash: row.previousHash,[39m
[31m+         block: { action: row.action, userEmail: row.actor.includes('@') ? row.actor : null },[39m

[31m+       return next(error);[39m
[31m+     }[39m

[31m+   // Owner-only operational health for the command center. Every section reads[39m
[31m+   // from the real tables the corresponding subsystem already writes -- no[39m
[31m+   // second heartbeat, delivery ledger, integration status, or audit verifier[39m
[31m+   // is created here. Sections with no real backing data are omitted rather[39m
[31m+   // than populated with placeholder values; see the `notes` field.[39m
[31m+   router.get('/founder/operations', requireAuth, requireRole('Owner'), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m
[31m+       const notes: string[] = [];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- A. Worker/job health ---------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       // osv-worker.ts claims agent_jobs rows (job_type osv_manifest_scan /[39m
[31m+       // repository_scan). It has no separate heartbeat row; the queue state[39m
[31m+       // itself (locked_at/locked_by, the same 10-minute staleness window the[39m
[31m+       // worker uses to reclaim stuck jobs) is the real signal.[39m
[31m+       const [osvCounts, osvStale, osvFailures, osvActivity] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT job_type AS "jobType", status, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') GROUP BY job_type, status`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') AND status='Running' AND locked_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, job_type AS "jobType", error, attempt_count AS "attemptCount", max_attempts AS "maxAttempts", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') AND status='Failed' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 5`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT MAX(updated_at) AS "lastActivityAt" FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan')`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // monitoring-worker.ts (the file name this dashboard's spec named) is not[39m
[31m+       // imported by worker.ts and never runs in production -- confirmed dead[39m
[31m+       // code, not a running system. trust-monitoring-worker.ts is the real,[39m
[31m+       // currently-running system that plays the equivalent role (collector_jobs[39m
[31m+       // has an actual heartbeat_at column, unlike agent_jobs).[39m
[31m+       const [monitoringCounts, monitoringHeartbeat, monitoringFailures] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT state, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} GROUP BY state`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT MAX(heartbeat_at) AS "lastHeartbeatAt" FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND state='running'`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, collector_id AS "collectorId", safe_error_code AS "errorCode", safe_error_message AS "errorMessage", completed_at AS "completedAt" FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND state IN ('failed','dead_lettered') ORDER BY completed_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       notes.push('monitoring-worker.ts is dead code (never imported by worker.ts); "monitoringWorker" below reflects trust-monitoring-worker.ts, the real running system for the same role.');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- B. Webhook delivery health ----------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       const [webhookCounts, webhookEndpoints, webhookFailures] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT status, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM spr_webhook_deliveries WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND created_at::timestamptz > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY status`),[39m

[31m+       res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'private, max-age=0, no-store');[39m

[31m+   // Owner-only operational health for the command center. Every section reads[39m
[31m+   // from the real tables the corresponding subsystem already writes -- no[39m
[31m+   // second heartbeat, delivery ledger, integration status, or audit verifier[39m
[31m+   // is created here. Sections with no real backing data are omitted rather[39m
[31m+   // than populated with placeholder values; see the `notes` field.[39m
[31m+   router.get('/founder/operations', requireAuth, requireRole('Owner'), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m
[31m+       const notes: string[] = [];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- A. Worker/job health ---------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       // osv-worker.ts claims agent_jobs rows (job_type osv_manifest_scan /[39m
[31m+       // repository_scan). It has no separate heartbeat row; the queue state[39m
[31m+       // itself (locked_at/locked_by, the same 10-minute staleness window the[39m
[31m+       // worker uses to reclaim stuck jobs) is the real signal.[39m
[31m+       const [osvCounts, osvStale, osvFailures, osvActivity] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT job_type AS "jobType", status, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') GROUP BY job_type, status`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') AND status='Running' AND locked_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, job_type AS "jobType", error, attempt_count AS "attemptCount", max_attempts AS "maxAttempts", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') AND status='Failed' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 5`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT MAX(updated_at) AS "lastActivityAt" FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan')`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // monitoring-worker.ts (the file name this dashboard's spec named) is not[39m
[31m+       // imported by worker.ts and never runs in production -- confirmed dead[39m
[31m+       // code, not a running system. trust-monitoring-worker.ts is the real,[39m
[31m+       // currently-running system that plays the equivalent role (collector_jobs[39m
[31m+       // has an actual heartbeat_at column, unlike agent_jobs).[39m
[31m+       const [monitoringCounts, monitoringHeartbeat, monitoringFailures] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT state, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} GROUP BY state`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT MAX(heartbeat_at) AS "lastHeartbeatAt" FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND state='running'`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, collector_id AS "collectorId", safe_error_code AS "errorCode", safe_error_message AS "errorMessage", completed_at AS "completedAt" FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND state IN ('failed','dead_lettered') ORDER BY completed_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       notes.push('monitoring-worker.ts is dead code (never imported by worker.ts); "monitoringWorker" below reflects trust-monitoring-worker.ts, the real running system for the same role.');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- B. Webhook delivery health ----------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       const [webhookCounts, webhookEndpoints, webhookFailures] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT status, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM spr_webhook_deliveries WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND created_at::timestamptz > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY status`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE active)::int AS "activeCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT active)::int AS "disabledCount" FROM spr_webhooks WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId}`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT d.id, d.webhook_id AS "webhookId", w.url, d.event_type AS "eventType", d.safe_error_code AS "errorCode", d.safe_error_message AS "errorMessage", d.completed_at AS "completedAt" FROM spr_webhook_deliveries d JOIN spr_webhooks w ON w.id=d.webhook_id AND w.tenant_id=d.tenant_id WHERE d.tenant_id=${tenantId} AND d.status IN ('failed','dead_lettered') ORDER BY d.completed_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       notes.push('Webhook failures are grouped by destination endpoint (webhookId/url), not "provider" -- SPR webhooks are user-configured destination URLs, not third-party provider connectors; there is no per-provider concept for outbound deliveries.');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- C. Integration health ----------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       const [credentialRows, integrationRows] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT provider, status, last_tested_at AS "lastTestedAt" FROM integration_credentials WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId}`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT name, connected, last_sync_date AS "lastSyncDate" FROM integrations WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId}`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       const credentialByProvider = new Map<string, any>((credentialRows as any).rows?.map((r: any) => [r.provider, r]) ?? []);[39m
[31m+       const integrationByName = new Map<string, any>((integrationRows as any).rows?.map((r: any) => [r.name, r]) ?? []);[39m
[31m+       const integrations = INTEGRATION_CATALOG.map((item) => ({[39m
[31m+         provider: item.provider,[39m
[31m+         name: item.name,[39m
[31m+         connected: Boolean(integrationByName.get(item.name)?.connected),[39m
[31m+         lastSyncDate: integrationByName.get(item.name)?.lastSyncDate ?? null,[39m
[31m+         credentialStatus: credentialByProvider.get(item.provider)?.status ?? 'NOT_CONFIGURED',[39m
[31m+         lastTestedAt: credentialByProvider.get(item.provider)?.lastTestedAt ?? null,[39m
[31m+       }));[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- D. Audit chain integrity --------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       // Reuses the exact function GET /api/auth/audit-chain/verify calls --[39m
[31m+       // no second verifier.[39m
[31m+       const auditChain = await verifyAuditChain(db, tenantId);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- E. Scan / job queue --------------------------------------------------[39m

[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m

[31m+       const passportRows = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id, version, evidence, client_id AS "clientId" FROM passports WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND (${clientScope} IS NULL OR client_id=${clientScope}) ORDER BY id`) as any).rows ?? [];[39m
[31m+       const passportIds = passportRows.map((row: any) => String(row.id));[39m
[31m+       const parseJson = (value: unknown): unknown[] => { try { const parsed = JSON.parse(String(value ?? '')); return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : []; } catch { return []; } };[39m

[31m+       // `asset_id IN ${passportIds}`; do not replace this with ANY(array).[39m
[31m+       const findingRows = passportIds.length ? ((await db.execute(sql`SELECT id, passport_id AS "passportId", evidence_ids, status FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id IN ${passportIds}`) as any).rows ?? []) : [];[39m
[31m+       const evidenceByPassport = new Map<string, any[]>();[39m
[31m+       for (const passport of passportRows) evidenceByPassport.set(String(passport.id), parseJson(passport.evidence) as any[]);[39m

[31m+         const openFindingEvidenceIds = findings.filter((row: any) => !['resolved','closed','verified'].includes(String(row.status || '').toLowerCase())).flatMap((row: any) => parseJson(row.evidence_ids)).filter((id: any): id is string => typeof id === 'string');[39m
[31m+         const adapted = adaptEvidenceForEvaluation({ evidence: evidenceByPassport.get(String(passport.id)) ?? [], passportVersion: passport.version, openFindingEvidenceIds });[39m
[31m+         const decision = evaluateVerification({ evidence: adapted.evidence, evaluatedAt, targetIdentity: adapted.targetIdentity });[39m
[31m+         verificationDecisions[String(passport.id)] = decision;[39m
[31m+         verificationDetails[String(passport.id)] = { unmappedCount: adapted.unmappedCount, undatedCount: adapted.undatedCount, observations: decision.observationCount, independentSources: decision.independentSourceCount };[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'private, max-age=0, no-store');[39m
[31m+       return res.json({ verificationDecisions, verificationDetails });[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) { return next(error); }[39m
[31m+   });[39m
