[31m+   // Owner-only operational health for the command center. Every section reads[39m
[31m+   // from the real tables the corresponding subsystem already writes -- no[39m
[31m+   // second heartbeat, delivery ledger, integration status, or audit verifier[39m
[31m+   // is created here. Sections with no real backing data are omitted rather[39m
[31m+   // than populated with placeholder values; see the `notes` field.[39m
[31m+   router.get('/founder/operations', requireAuth, requireRole('Owner'), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m
[31m+       const notes: string[] = [];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- A. Worker/job health ---------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       // osv-worker.ts claims agent_jobs rows (job_type osv_manifest_scan /[39m
[31m+       // repository_scan). It has no separate heartbeat row; the queue state[39m
[31m+       // itself (locked_at/locked_by, the same 10-minute staleness window the[39m
[31m+       // worker uses to reclaim stuck jobs) is the real signal.[39m
[31m+       const [osvCounts, osvStale, osvFailures, osvActivity] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT job_type AS "jobType", status, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') GROUP BY job_type, status`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') AND status='Running' AND locked_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, job_type AS "jobType", error, attempt_count AS "attemptCount", max_attempts AS "maxAttempts", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') AND status='Failed' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 5`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT MAX(updated_at) AS "lastActivityAt" FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan')`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // monitoring-worker.ts (the file name this dashboard's spec named) is not[39m
[31m+       // imported by worker.ts and never runs in production -- confirmed dead[39m
[31m+       // code, not a running system. trust-monitoring-worker.ts is the real,[39m
[31m+       // currently-running system that plays the equivalent role (collector_jobs[39m
[31m+       // has an actual heartbeat_at column, unlike agent_jobs).[39m
[31m+       const [monitoringCounts, monitoringHeartbeat, monitoringFailures] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT state, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} GROUP BY state`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT MAX(heartbeat_at) AS "lastHeartbeatAt" FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND state='running'`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, collector_id AS "collectorId", safe_error_code AS "errorCode", safe_error_message AS "errorMessage", completed_at AS "completedAt" FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND state IN ('failed','dead_lettered') ORDER BY completed_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       notes.push('monitoring-worker.ts is dead code (never imported by worker.ts); "monitoringWorker" below reflects trust-monitoring-worker.ts, the real running system for the same role.');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- B. Webhook delivery health ----------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       const [webhookCounts, webhookEndpoints, webhookFailures] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT status, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM spr_webhook_deliveries WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND created_at::timestamptz > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY status`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE active)::int AS "activeCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT active)::int AS "disabledCount" FROM spr_webhooks WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId}`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT d.id, d.webhook_id AS "webhookId", w.url, d.event_type AS "eventType", d.safe_error_code AS "errorCode", d.safe_error_message AS "errorMessage", d.completed_at AS "completedAt" FROM spr_webhook_deliveries d JOIN spr_webhooks w ON w.id=d.webhook_id AND w.tenant_id=d.tenant_id WHERE d.tenant_id=${tenantId} AND d.status IN ('failed','dead_lettered') ORDER BY d.completed_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       notes.push('Webhook failures are grouped by destination endpoint (webhookId/url), not "provider" -- SPR webhooks are user-configured destination URLs, not third-party provider connectors; there is no per-provider concept for outbound deliveries.');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- C. Integration health ----------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       const [credentialRows, integrationRows] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT provider, status, last_tested_at AS "lastTestedAt" FROM integration_credentials WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId}`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT name, connected, last_sync_date AS "lastSyncDate" FROM integrations WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId}`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       const credentialByProvider = new Map<string, any>((credentialRows as any).rows?.map((r: any) => [r.provider, r]) ?? []);[39m
[31m+       const integrationByName = new Map<string, any>((integrationRows as any).rows?.map((r: any) => [r.name, r]) ?? []);[39m
[31m+       const integrations = INTEGRATION_CATALOG.map((item) => ({[39m
[31m+         provider: item.provider,[39m
[31m+         name: item.name,[39m
[31m+         connected: Boolean(integrationByName.get(item.name)?.connected),[39m
[31m+         lastSyncDate: integrationByName.get(item.name)?.lastSyncDate ?? null,[39m
[31m+         credentialStatus: credentialByProvider.get(item.provider)?.status ?? 'NOT_CONFIGURED',[39m
[31m+         lastTestedAt: credentialByProvider.get(item.provider)?.lastTestedAt ?? null,[39m
[31m+       }));[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- D. Audit chain integrity --------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       // Reuses the exact function GET /api/auth/audit-chain/verify calls --[39m
[31m+       // no second verifier.[39m
[31m+       const auditChain = await verifyAuditChain(db, tenantId);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- E. Scan / job queue --------------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       const [runningRepoScans, complianceSchedules] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, passport_id AS "passportId", status, progress, updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type='repository_scan' AND status='Running' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 10`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, client_id AS "clientId", frequency, status, last_audit_at AS "lastAuditAt", next_audit_at AS "nextAuditAt" FROM compliance_schedules WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} ORDER BY COALESCE(last_audit_at, created_at) DESC LIMIT 10`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return res.json({[39m
[31m+         generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),[39m
[31m+         workers: {[39m
[31m+           osv: {[39m
[31m+             countsByStatus: (osvCounts as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+             staleRunningCount: Number((osvStale as any).rows?.[0]?.count ?? 0),[39m
[31m+             recentFailures: (osvFailures as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+             lastActivityAt: (osvActivity as any).rows?.[0]?.lastActivityAt ?? null,[39m
[31m+           },[39m
[31m+           monitoringWorker: {[39m
[31m+             realSource: 'trust-monitoring-worker.ts (collector_jobs)',[39m
[31m+             countsByState: (monitoringCounts as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+             lastHeartbeatAt: (monitoringHeartbeat as any).rows?.[0]?.lastHeartbeatAt ?? null,[39m
[31m+             recentFailures: (monitoringFailures as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+           },[39m
[31m+         },[39m
[31m+         webhooks: {[39m
[31m+           countsByStatusLast7Days: (webhookCounts as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+           activeEndpoints: Number((webhookEndpoints as any).rows?.[0]?.activeCount ?? 0),[39m
[31m+           disabledEndpoints: Number((webhookEndpoints as any).rows?.[0]?.disabledCount ?? 0),[39m
[31m+           recentFailures: (webhookFailures as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+         },[39m
[31m+         integrations,[39m
[31m+         auditChain,[39m
[31m+         queue: {[39m
[31m+           runningRepositoryScans: (runningRepoScans as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+           recentlyFailedJobs: (osvFailures as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+           complianceSchedules: (complianceSchedules as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+         },[39m
[31m+         notes,[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+       return next(error);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   });[39m

[31m+   // Owner-only operational health for the command center. Every section reads[39m
[31m+   // from the real tables the corresponding subsystem already writes -- no[39m
[31m+   // second heartbeat, delivery ledger, integration status, or audit verifier[39m
[31m+   // is created here. Sections with no real backing data are omitted rather[39m
[31m+   // than populated with placeholder values; see the `notes` field.[39m
[31m+   router.get('/founder/operations', requireAuth, requireRole('Owner'), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m
[31m+       const notes: string[] = [];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- A. Worker/job health ---------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       // osv-worker.ts claims agent_jobs rows (job_type osv_manifest_scan /[39m
[31m+       // repository_scan). It has no separate heartbeat row; the queue state[39m
[31m+       // itself (locked_at/locked_by, the same 10-minute staleness window the[39m
[31m+       // worker uses to reclaim stuck jobs) is the real signal.[39m
[31m+       const [osvCounts, osvStale, osvFailures, osvActivity] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT job_type AS "jobType", status, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') GROUP BY job_type, status`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') AND status='Running' AND locked_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, job_type AS "jobType", error, attempt_count AS "attemptCount", max_attempts AS "maxAttempts", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') AND status='Failed' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 5`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT MAX(updated_at) AS "lastActivityAt" FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan')`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // monitoring-worker.ts (the file name this dashboard's spec named) is not[39m
[31m+       // imported by worker.ts and never runs in production -- confirmed dead[39m
[31m+       // code, not a running system. trust-monitoring-worker.ts is the real,[39m
[31m+       // currently-running system that plays the equivalent role (collector_jobs[39m
[31m+       // has an actual heartbeat_at column, unlike agent_jobs).[39m
[31m+       const [monitoringCounts, monitoringHeartbeat, monitoringFailures] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT state, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} GROUP BY state`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT MAX(heartbeat_at) AS "lastHeartbeatAt" FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND state='running'`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, collector_id AS "collectorId", safe_error_code AS "errorCode", safe_error_message AS "errorMessage", completed_at AS "completedAt" FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND state IN ('failed','dead_lettered') ORDER BY completed_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       notes.push('monitoring-worker.ts is dead code (never imported by worker.ts); "monitoringWorker" below reflects trust-monitoring-worker.ts, the real running system for the same role.');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- B. Webhook delivery health ----------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       const [webhookCounts, webhookEndpoints, webhookFailures] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT status, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM spr_webhook_deliveries WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND created_at::timestamptz > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY status`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE active)::int AS "activeCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT active)::int AS "disabledCount" FROM spr_webhooks WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId}`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT d.id, d.webhook_id AS "webhookId", w.url, d.event_type AS "eventType", d.safe_error_code AS "errorCode", d.safe_error_message AS "errorMessage", d.completed_at AS "completedAt" FROM spr_webhook_deliveries d JOIN spr_webhooks w ON w.id=d.webhook_id AND w.tenant_id=d.tenant_id WHERE d.tenant_id=${tenantId} AND d.status IN ('failed','dead_lettered') ORDER BY d.completed_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       notes.push('Webhook failures are grouped by destination endpoint (webhookId/url), not "provider" -- SPR webhooks are user-configured destination URLs, not third-party provider connectors; there is no per-provider concept for outbound deliveries.');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- C. Integration health ----------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       const [credentialRows, integrationRows] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT provider, status, last_tested_at AS "lastTestedAt" FROM integration_credentials WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId}`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT name, connected, last_sync_date AS "lastSyncDate" FROM integrations WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId}`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       const credentialByProvider = new Map<string, any>((credentialRows as any).rows?.map((r: any) => [r.provider, r]) ?? []);[39m
[31m+       const integrationByName = new Map<string, any>((integrationRows as any).rows?.map((r: any) => [r.name, r]) ?? []);[39m
[31m+       const integrations = INTEGRATION_CATALOG.map((item) => ({[39m
[31m+         provider: item.provider,[39m
[31m+         name: item.name,[39m
[31m+         connected: Boolean(integrationByName.get(item.name)?.connected),[39m
[31m+         lastSyncDate: integrationByName.get(item.name)?.lastSyncDate ?? null,[39m
[31m+         credentialStatus: credentialByProvider.get(item.provider)?.status ?? 'NOT_CONFIGURED',[39m
[31m+         lastTestedAt: credentialByProvider.get(item.provider)?.lastTestedAt ?? null,[39m
[31m+       }));[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- D. Audit chain integrity --------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       // Reuses the exact function GET /api/auth/audit-chain/verify calls --[39m
[31m+       // no second verifier.[39m
[31m+       const auditChain = await verifyAuditChain(db, tenantId);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- E. Scan / job queue --------------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       const [runningRepoScans, complianceSchedules] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, passport_id AS "passportId", status, progress, updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type='repository_scan' AND status='Running' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 10`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, client_id AS "clientId", frequency, status, last_audit_at AS "lastAuditAt", next_audit_at AS "nextAuditAt" FROM compliance_schedules WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} ORDER BY COALESCE(last_audit_at, created_at) DESC LIMIT 10`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return res.json({[39m
[31m+         generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),[39m
[31m+         workers: {[39m
[31m+           osv: {[39m
[31m+             countsByStatus: (osvCounts as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+             staleRunningCount: Number((osvStale as any).rows?.[0]?.count ?? 0),[39m
[31m+             recentFailures: (osvFailures as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+             lastActivityAt: (osvActivity as any).rows?.[0]?.lastActivityAt ?? null,[39m
[31m+           },[39m
[31m+           monitoringWorker: {[39m
[31m+             realSource: 'trust-monitoring-worker.ts (collector_jobs)',[39m
[31m+             countsByState: (monitoringCounts as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+             lastHeartbeatAt: (monitoringHeartbeat as any).rows?.[0]?.lastHeartbeatAt ?? null,[39m
[31m+             recentFailures: (monitoringFailures as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+           },[39m
[31m+         },[39m
[31m+         webhooks: {[39m
[31m+           countsByStatusLast7Days: (webhookCounts as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+           activeEndpoints: Number((webhookEndpoints as any).rows?.[0]?.activeCount ?? 0),[39m
[31m+           disabledEndpoints: Number((webhookEndpoints as any).rows?.[0]?.disabledCount ?? 0),[39m
[31m+           recentFailures: (webhookFailures as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+         },[39m
[31m+         integrations,[39m
[31m+         auditChain,[39m
[31m+         queue: {[39m

[31m+   router.get('/user/passports/:id/verification', requireAuth, async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m
[31m+       const clientScope = req.user!.role === 'Client' ? (req.user as any).clientId : null;[39m
[31m+       const passportResult = await db.execute(sql`SELECT id, version, evidence, client_id AS "clientId" FROM passports WHERE id=${req.params.id} AND tenant_id=${tenantId} AND (${clientScope} IS NULL OR client_id=${clientScope}) LIMIT 1`) as any;[39m
[31m+       const passport = passportResult.rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+       if (!passport) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Passport not found' });[39m
[31m+       const findingResult = await db.execute(sql`SELECT id, passport_id AS "passportId", evidence_ids, status FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passport.id}`) as any;[39m
[31m+       const parseJson = (value: unknown): unknown[] => { try { const parsed = JSON.parse(String(value ?? '')); return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : []; } catch { return []; } };[39m
[31m+       const openFindingEvidenceIds = (findingResult.rows ?? []).filter((row: any) => !['resolved','closed','verified'].includes(String(row.status || '').toLowerCase())).flatMap((row: any) => parseJson(row.evidence_ids)).filter((id: any): id is string => typeof id === 'string');[39m
[31m+       const adapted = adaptEvidenceForEvaluation({ evidence: parseJson(passport.evidence) as any[], passportVersion: passport.version, openFindingEvidenceIds });[39m
[31m+       const evaluatedAt = Date.now();[39m
[31m+       const decision = evaluateVerification({ evidence: adapted.evidence, evaluatedAt, targetIdentity: adapted.targetIdentity });[39m
[31m+       res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'private, max-age=0, no-store');[39m
[31m+       return res.json({ decision, observations: decision.observationCount, independentSources: decision.independentSourceCount });[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) { return next(error); }[39m

[31m+   // Owner-only operational health for the command center. Every section reads[39m
[31m+   // from the real tables the corresponding subsystem already writes -- no[39m
[31m+   // second heartbeat, delivery ledger, integration status, or audit verifier[39m
[31m+   // is created here. Sections with no real backing data are omitted rather[39m
[31m+   // than populated with placeholder values; see the `notes` field.[39m
[31m+   router.get('/founder/operations', requireAuth, requireRole('Owner'), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m
[31m+       const notes: string[] = [];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- A. Worker/job health ---------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       // osv-worker.ts claims agent_jobs rows (job_type osv_manifest_scan /[39m
[31m+       // repository_scan). It has no separate heartbeat row; the queue state[39m
[31m+       // itself (locked_at/locked_by, the same 10-minute staleness window the[39m
[31m+       // worker uses to reclaim stuck jobs) is the real signal.[39m
[31m+       const [osvCounts, osvStale, osvFailures, osvActivity] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT job_type AS "jobType", status, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') GROUP BY job_type, status`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') AND status='Running' AND locked_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, job_type AS "jobType", error, attempt_count AS "attemptCount", max_attempts AS "maxAttempts", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') AND status='Failed' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 5`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT MAX(updated_at) AS "lastActivityAt" FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan')`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // monitoring-worker.ts (the file name this dashboard's spec named) is not[39m
[31m+       // imported by worker.ts and never runs in production -- confirmed dead[39m
[31m+       // code, not a running system. trust-monitoring-worker.ts is the real,[39m
[31m+       // currently-running system that plays the equivalent role (collector_jobs[39m
[31m+       // has an actual heartbeat_at column, unlike agent_jobs).[39m
[31m+       const [monitoringCounts, monitoringHeartbeat, monitoringFailures] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT state, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} GROUP BY state`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT MAX(heartbeat_at) AS "lastHeartbeatAt" FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND state='running'`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, collector_id AS "collectorId", safe_error_code AS "errorCode", safe_error_message AS "errorMessage", completed_at AS "completedAt" FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND state IN ('failed','dead_lettered') ORDER BY completed_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       notes.push('monitoring-worker.ts is dead code (never imported by worker.ts); "monitoringWorker" below reflects trust-monitoring-worker.ts, the real running system for the same role.');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- B. Webhook delivery health ----------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       const [webhookCounts, webhookEndpoints, webhookFailures] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT status, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM spr_webhook_deliveries WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND created_at::timestamptz > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY status`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE active)::int AS "activeCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT active)::int AS "disabledCount" FROM spr_webhooks WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId}`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT d.id, d.webhook_id AS "webhookId", w.url, d.event_type AS "eventType", d.safe_error_code AS "errorCode", d.safe_error_message AS "errorMessage", d.completed_at AS "completedAt" FROM spr_webhook_deliveries d JOIN spr_webhooks w ON w.id=d.webhook_id AND w.tenant_id=d.tenant_id WHERE d.tenant_id=${tenantId} AND d.status IN ('failed','dead_lettered') ORDER BY d.completed_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       notes.push('Webhook failures are grouped by destination endpoint (webhookId/url), not "provider" -- SPR webhooks are user-configured destination URLs, not third-party provider connectors; there is no per-provider concept for outbound deliveries.');[39m
[31m+[39m

[31m+ export async function buildAndPersistReport(db: any, tenantId: string, passportId: string, reportType: string) {[39m
[31m+   const passport = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,name,overall_score,security_score,compliance_score,verification_status,confidence_score,evidence_completeness,sbom,evidence,vulnerabilities,timeline FROM passports WHERE id=${passportId} AND tenant_id=${tenantId} LIMIT 1`) as any).rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+   if (!passport) return null;[39m
[31m+   const findings = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,control_id,title,severity,status,description,remediation,evidence_ids,updated_at,resolved_at FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'low' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END,updated_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const evidence = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,provider,control_id,subject,source_url,observed_at,verification_method,status,severity,evidence_hash,limitation FROM evidence_ledger WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY observed_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const observations = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,observation_version,generated_at,previous_observation_id,evidence_ids,finding_ids,canonical_payload_hash,completeness_basis_points,confidence_basis_points,open_finding_count,unknown_dimension_count FROM trust_observations WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY observation_version DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const remediation = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM trust_remediation_work_items WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const verification = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM remediation_verification_ledger WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND finding_id IN (SELECT id FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId}) ORDER BY created_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const latest = observations[0];[39m
[31m+   const risk = deriveReportRiskFields(passport as ReportPassportRow);[39m
[31m+   const report = {[39m
[31m+     schemaVersion: 'spr.report.v2', reportType, generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(), passport: { id: passport.id, name: passport.name },[39m
[31m+     risk: { overall: risk.canonicalScore, security: passport.security_score, compliance: passport.compliance_score, verificationStatus: risk.verificationStatus },[39m
[31m+     evidenceQuality: { completenessBasisPoints: risk.completenessBasisPoints, confidenceBasisPoints: risk.confidenceBasisPoints, unknownDimensions: latest?.unknown_dimension_count ?? 0, latestObservationAt: latest?.generated_at ?? null },[39m
[31m+     findings, evidence, observations, remediation, verification,[39m
[31m+     traceability: 'Report -> Passport -> Risk -> Finding -> Observation -> Provider -> Source -> Timestamp -> Hash',[39m
[31m+     resolutionTraceability: 'Finding -> remediation -> new observation -> independent verification',[39m
[31m+     limitations: evidence.filter((item: any) => item.limitation).map((item: any) => ({ evidenceId: item.id, limitation: item.limitation })),[39m
[31m+     ...buildReportTypeExtras(reportType, passport, findings),[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+   const canonicalPayload = JSON.stringify(report);[39m
[31m+   const reportHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalPayload).digest('hex');[39m
[31m+   await db.execute(sql`INSERT INTO trust_report_snapshots (id,tenant_id,passport_id,report_type,generated_at,score,confidence_basis_points,completeness_basis_points,evidence_ids,finding_ids,observation_id,canonical_payload_hash,payload,created_at) VALUES (${id('report')},${tenantId},${passportId},${reportType},${report.generatedAt},${risk.canonicalScore},${risk.confidenceBasisPoints},${risk.completenessBasisPoints},${JSON.stringify(evidence.map((item: any) => item.id))},${JSON.stringify(findings.map((item: any) => item.id))},${latest?.id ?? null},${reportHash},${canonicalPayload},${report.generatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,passport_id,report_type,canonical_payload_hash) DO NOTHING`);[39m
[31m+   return { ...report, reportHash };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export function deriveReportRiskFields(passport: ReportPassportRow) {[39m
[31m+   const verificationStatus = passport.verification_status || 'unverified';[39m
[31m+   const isMeasured = verificationStatus !== 'unverified';[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     canonicalScore: isMeasured ? passport.overall_score : null,[39m
[31m+     verificationStatus,[39m
[31m+     confidenceBasisPoints: isMeasured && passport.confidence_score != null ? Math.round(passport.confidence_score * 100) : null,[39m
[31m+     completenessBasisPoints: isMeasured && passport.evidence_completeness != null ? Math.round(passport.evidence_completeness * 100) : null,[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function buildReportTypeExtras(reportType: string, passport: any, findings: any[]) {[39m
[31m+   if (reportType === 'sbom') {[39m
[31m+     const components = parseJson(passport.sbom, []) as any[];[39m
[31m+     const vulnerabilities = parseJson(passport.vulnerabilities, []) as any[];[39m
[31m+     const sbom = components.map((component) => {[39m
[31m+       const name = component?.name || component?.packageName || component?.component;[39m
[31m+       const matched = vulnerabilities.filter((vuln) => (vuln?.component || vuln?.packageName || vuln?.package) === name);[39m
[31m+       return { ...component, vulnerabilityCount: matched.length, criticalOrHighCount: matched.filter((vuln) => SEVERITY_ORDER.slice(0, 2).includes(String(vuln?.severity || '').toLowerCase())).length };[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     return { sbom };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (reportType === 'compliance') {[39m
[31m+     const byControl = new Map<string, { controlId: string; findingCount: number; openCount: number; worstSeverity: string; findingIds: string[] }>();[39m
[31m+     for (const finding of findings) {[39m
[31m+       const controlId = finding.control_id || 'unmapped';[39m
[31m+       const entry = byControl.get(controlId) || { controlId, findingCount: 0, openCount: 0, worstSeverity: 'low', findingIds: [] as string[] };[39m
[31m+       entry.findingCount += 1;[39m
[31m+       entry.findingIds.push(finding.id);[39m
[31m+       if (!['resolved', 'closed', 'verified'].includes(String(finding.status || '').toLowerCase())) entry.openCount += 1;[39m
[31m+       const severity = String(finding.severity || '').toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+       if (SEVERITY_ORDER.includes(severity) && SEVERITY_ORDER.indexOf(severity) < SEVERITY_ORDER.indexOf(entry.worstSeverity)) entry.worstSeverity = severity;[39m
[31m+       byControl.set(controlId, entry);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return { controls: [...byControl.values()] };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return {};[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+       const credentials = decryptCredentials(stored.encrypted_payload) as Record<string, string>;[39m

[31m+       return res.json({ runId, provider, observationCount: observations.length, ...result });[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m

[31m+       await db.execute(sql`UPDATE trust_collection_runs SET completed_at=${completedAt},status='FAILED',error_code='COLLECTION_FAILED',error_message=${error instanceof Error ? error.message.slice(0,1000) : 'COLLECTION_FAILED'} WHERE id=${runId} AND tenant_id=${tenantId}`).catch(() => undefined);[39m
[31m+       await db.execute(sql`UPDATE trust_monitoring_state SET last_run_at=${completedAt},last_failure_at=${completedAt},consecutive_failures=consecutive_failures+1,status=CASE WHEN consecutive_failures+1 >= 5 THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'DEGRADED' END,updated_at=${completedAt} WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} AND provider=${provider}`).catch(() => undefined);[39m

[31m+ export async function buildAndPersistReport(db: any, tenantId: string, passportId: string, reportType: string) {[39m
[31m+   const passport = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,name,overall_score,security_score,compliance_score,verification_status,confidence_score,evidence_completeness,sbom,evidence,vulnerabilities,timeline FROM passports WHERE id=${passportId} AND tenant_id=${tenantId} LIMIT 1`) as any).rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+   if (!passport) return null;[39m
[31m+   const findings = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,control_id,title,severity,status,description,remediation,evidence_ids,updated_at,resolved_at FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'low' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END,updated_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const evidence = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,provider,control_id,subject,source_url,observed_at,verification_method,status,severity,evidence_hash,limitation FROM evidence_ledger WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY observed_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const observations = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,observation_version,generated_at,previous_observation_id,evidence_ids,finding_ids,canonical_payload_hash,completeness_basis_points,confidence_basis_points,open_finding_count,unknown_dimension_count FROM trust_observations WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY observation_version DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const remediation = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM trust_remediation_work_items WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const verification = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM remediation_verification_ledger WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND finding_id IN (SELECT id FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId}) ORDER BY created_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const latest = observations[0];[39m
[31m+   const risk = deriveReportRiskFields(passport as ReportPassportRow);[39m
[31m+   const report = {[39m
[31m+     schemaVersion: 'spr.report.v2', reportType, generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(), passport: { id: passport.id, name: passport.name },[39m
[31m+     risk: { overall: risk.canonicalScore, security: passport.security_score, compliance: passport.compliance_score, verificationStatus: risk.verificationStatus },[39m
[31m+     evidenceQuality: { completenessBasisPoints: risk.completenessBasisPoints, confidenceBasisPoints: risk.confidenceBasisPoints, unknownDimensions: latest?.unknown_dimension_count ?? 0, latestObservationAt: latest?.generated_at ?? null },[39m
[31m+     findings, evidence, observations, remediation, verification,[39m
[31m+     traceability: 'Report -> Passport -> Risk -> Finding -> Observation -> Provider -> Source -> Timestamp -> Hash',[39m
[31m+     resolutionTraceability: 'Finding -> remediation -> new observation -> independent verification',[39m
[31m+     limitations: evidence.filter((item: any) => item.limitation).map((item: any) => ({ evidenceId: item.id, limitation: item.limitation })),[39m
[31m+     ...buildReportTypeExtras(reportType, passport, findings),[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+   const canonicalPayload = JSON.stringify(report);[39m
[31m+   const reportHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalPayload).digest('hex');[39m
[31m+   await db.execute(sql`INSERT INTO trust_report_snapshots (id,tenant_id,passport_id,report_type,generated_at,score,confidence_basis_points,completeness_basis_points,evidence_ids,finding_ids,observation_id,canonical_payload_hash,payload,created_at) VALUES (${id('report')},${tenantId},${passportId},${reportType},${report.generatedAt},${risk.canonicalScore},${risk.confidenceBasisPoints},${risk.completenessBasisPoints},${JSON.stringify(evidence.map((item: any) => item.id))},${JSON.stringify(findings.map((item: any) => item.id))},${latest?.id ?? null},${reportHash},${canonicalPayload},${report.generatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,passport_id,report_type,canonical_payload_hash) DO NOTHING`);[39m
[31m+   return { ...report, reportHash };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export function deriveReportRiskFields(passport: ReportPassportRow) {[39m
[31m+   const verificationStatus = passport.verification_status || 'unverified';[39m
[31m+   const isMeasured = verificationStatus !== 'unverified';[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     canonicalScore: isMeasured ? passport.overall_score : null,[39m
[31m+     verificationStatus,[39m
[31m+     confidenceBasisPoints: isMeasured && passport.confidence_score != null ? Math.round(passport.confidence_score * 100) : null,[39m
[31m+     completenessBasisPoints: isMeasured && passport.evidence_completeness != null ? Math.round(passport.evidence_completeness * 100) : null,[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function buildReportTypeExtras(reportType: string, passport: any, findings: any[]) {[39m
[31m+   if (reportType === 'sbom') {[39m
[31m+     const components = parseJson(passport.sbom, []) as any[];[39m
[31m+     const vulnerabilities = parseJson(passport.vulnerabilities, []) as any[];[39m
[31m+     const sbom = components.map((component) => {[39m
[31m+       const name = component?.name || component?.packageName || component?.component;[39m
[31m+       const matched = vulnerabilities.filter((vuln) => (vuln?.component || vuln?.packageName || vuln?.package) === name);[39m
[31m+       return { ...component, vulnerabilityCount: matched.length, criticalOrHighCount: matched.filter((vuln) => SEVERITY_ORDER.slice(0, 2).includes(String(vuln?.severity || '').toLowerCase())).length };[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     return { sbom };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (reportType === 'compliance') {[39m
[31m+     const byControl = new Map<string, { controlId: string; findingCount: number; openCount: number; worstSeverity: string; findingIds: string[] }>();[39m
[31m+     for (const finding of findings) {[39m
[31m+       const controlId = finding.control_id || 'unmapped';[39m
[31m+       const entry = byControl.get(controlId) || { controlId, findingCount: 0, openCount: 0, worstSeverity: 'low', findingIds: [] as string[] };[39m
[31m+       entry.findingCount += 1;[39m
[31m+       entry.findingIds.push(finding.id);[39m
[31m+       if (!['resolved', 'closed', 'verified'].includes(String(finding.status || '').toLowerCase())) entry.openCount += 1;[39m
[31m+       const severity = String(finding.severity || '').toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+       if (SEVERITY_ORDER.includes(severity) && SEVERITY_ORDER.indexOf(severity) < SEVERITY_ORDER.indexOf(entry.worstSeverity)) entry.worstSeverity = severity;[39m
[31m+       byControl.set(controlId, entry);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return { controls: [...byControl.values()] };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return {};[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export async function buildAndPersistReport(db: any, tenantId: string, passportId: string, reportType: string) {[39m
[31m+   const passport = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,name,overall_score,security_score,compliance_score,verification_status,confidence_score,evidence_completeness,sbom,evidence,vulnerabilities,timeline FROM passports WHERE id=${passportId} AND tenant_id=${tenantId} LIMIT 1`) as any).rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+   if (!passport) return null;[39m
[31m+   const findings = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,control_id,title,severity,status,description,remediation,evidence_ids,updated_at,resolved_at FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'low' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END,updated_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const evidence = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,provider,control_id,subject,source_url,observed_at,verification_method,status,severity,evidence_hash,limitation FROM evidence_ledger WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY observed_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const observations = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,observation_version,generated_at,previous_observation_id,evidence_ids,finding_ids,canonical_payload_hash,completeness_basis_points,confidence_basis_points,open_finding_count,unknown_dimension_count FROM trust_observations WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY observation_version DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const remediation = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM trust_remediation_work_items WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const verification = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM remediation_verification_ledger WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND finding_id IN (SELECT id FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId}) ORDER BY created_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const latest = observations[0];[39m
[31m+   const risk = deriveReportRiskFields(passport as ReportPassportRow);[39m
[31m+   const report = {[39m
[31m+     schemaVersion: 'spr.report.v2', reportType, generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(), passport: { id: passport.id, name: passport.name },[39m
[31m+     risk: { overall: risk.canonicalScore, security: passport.security_score, compliance: passport.compliance_score, verificationStatus: risk.verificationStatus },[39m
[31m+     evidenceQuality: { completenessBasisPoints: risk.completenessBasisPoints, confidenceBasisPoints: risk.confidenceBasisPoints, unknownDimensions: latest?.unknown_dimension_count ?? 0, latestObservationAt: latest?.generated_at ?? null },[39m
[31m+     findings, evidence, observations, remediation, verification,[39m
[31m+     traceability: 'Report -> Passport -> Risk -> Finding -> Observation -> Provider -> Source -> Timestamp -> Hash',[39m
[31m+     resolutionTraceability: 'Finding -> remediation -> new observation -> independent verification',[39m
[31m+     limitations: evidence.filter((item: any) => item.limitation).map((item: any) => ({ evidenceId: item.id, limitation: item.limitation })),[39m
[31m+     ...buildReportTypeExtras(reportType, passport, findings),[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+   const canonicalPayload = JSON.stringify(report);[39m
[31m+   const reportHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalPayload).digest('hex');[39m
[31m+   await db.execute(sql`INSERT INTO trust_report_snapshots (id,tenant_id,passport_id,report_type,generated_at,score,confidence_basis_points,completeness_basis_points,evidence_ids,finding_ids,observation_id,canonical_payload_hash,payload,created_at) VALUES (${id('report')},${tenantId},${passportId},${reportType},${report.generatedAt},${risk.canonicalScore},${risk.confidenceBasisPoints},${risk.completenessBasisPoints},${JSON.stringify(evidence.map((item: any) => item.id))},${JSON.stringify(findings.map((item: any) => item.id))},${latest?.id ?? null},${reportHash},${canonicalPayload},${report.generatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,passport_id,report_type,canonical_payload_hash) DO NOTHING`);[39m
[31m+   return { ...report, reportHash };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export function deriveReportRiskFields(passport: ReportPassportRow) {[39m
[31m+   const verificationStatus = passport.verification_status || 'unverified';[39m
[31m+   const isMeasured = verificationStatus !== 'unverified';[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     canonicalScore: isMeasured ? passport.overall_score : null,[39m
[31m+     verificationStatus,[39m
[31m+     confidenceBasisPoints: isMeasured && passport.confidence_score != null ? Math.round(passport.confidence_score * 100) : null,[39m
[31m+     completenessBasisPoints: isMeasured && passport.evidence_completeness != null ? Math.round(passport.evidence_completeness * 100) : null,[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function buildReportTypeExtras(reportType: string, passport: any, findings: any[]) {[39m
[31m+   if (reportType === 'sbom') {[39m
[31m+     const components = parseJson(passport.sbom, []) as any[];[39m
[31m+     const vulnerabilities = parseJson(passport.vulnerabilities, []) as any[];[39m
[31m+     const sbom = components.map((component) => {[39m
[31m+       const name = component?.name || component?.packageName || component?.component;[39m
[31m+       const matched = vulnerabilities.filter((vuln) => (vuln?.component || vuln?.packageName || vuln?.package) === name);[39m
[31m+       return { ...component, vulnerabilityCount: matched.length, criticalOrHighCount: matched.filter((vuln) => SEVERITY_ORDER.slice(0, 2).includes(String(vuln?.severity || '').toLowerCase())).length };[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     return { sbom };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (reportType === 'compliance') {[39m
[31m+     const byControl = new Map<string, { controlId: string; findingCount: number; openCount: number; worstSeverity: string; findingIds: string[] }>();[39m
[31m+     for (const finding of findings) {[39m
[31m+       const controlId = finding.control_id || 'unmapped';[39m
[31m+       const entry = byControl.get(controlId) || { controlId, findingCount: 0, openCount: 0, worstSeverity: 'low', findingIds: [] as string[] };[39m
[31m+       entry.findingCount += 1;[39m
[31m+       entry.findingIds.push(finding.id);[39m
[31m+       if (!['resolved', 'closed', 'verified'].includes(String(finding.status || '').toLowerCase())) entry.openCount += 1;[39m
[31m+       const severity = String(finding.severity || '').toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+       if (SEVERITY_ORDER.includes(severity) && SEVERITY_ORDER.indexOf(severity) < SEVERITY_ORDER.indexOf(entry.worstSeverity)) entry.worstSeverity = severity;[39m
[31m+       byControl.set(controlId, entry);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return { controls: [...byControl.values()] };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return {};[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export function createTrustLoopRouter() {[39m

[31m+   router.post('/collect', async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m

[31m+     const { passportId, provider } = parsed.data;[39m
[31m+     const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m
[31m+     const runId = id('collect');[39m
[31m+     const startedAt = new Date().toISOString();[39m
[31m+     const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+     try {[39m

[31m+ export async function buildAndPersistReport(db: any, tenantId: string, passportId: string, reportType: string) {[39m
[31m+   const passport = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,name,overall_score,security_score,compliance_score,verification_status,confidence_score,evidence_completeness,sbom,evidence,vulnerabilities,timeline FROM passports WHERE id=${passportId} AND tenant_id=${tenantId} LIMIT 1`) as any).rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+   if (!passport) return null;[39m
[31m+   const findings = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,control_id,title,severity,status,description,remediation,evidence_ids,updated_at,resolved_at FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'low' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END,updated_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const evidence = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,provider,control_id,subject,source_url,observed_at,verification_method,status,severity,evidence_hash,limitation FROM evidence_ledger WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY observed_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const observations = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,observation_version,generated_at,previous_observation_id,evidence_ids,finding_ids,canonical_payload_hash,completeness_basis_points,confidence_basis_points,open_finding_count,unknown_dimension_count FROM trust_observations WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY observation_version DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const remediation = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM trust_remediation_work_items WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const verification = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM remediation_verification_ledger WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND finding_id IN (SELECT id FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId}) ORDER BY created_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const latest = observations[0];[39m
[31m+   const risk = deriveReportRiskFields(passport as ReportPassportRow);[39m
[31m+   const report = {[39m
[31m+     schemaVersion: 'spr.report.v2', reportType, generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(), passport: { id: passport.id, name: passport.name },[39m
[31m+     risk: { overall: risk.canonicalScore, security: passport.security_score, compliance: passport.compliance_score, verificationStatus: risk.verificationStatus },[39m
[31m+     evidenceQuality: { completenessBasisPoints: risk.completenessBasisPoints, confidenceBasisPoints: risk.confidenceBasisPoints, unknownDimensions: latest?.unknown_dimension_count ?? 0, latestObservationAt: latest?.generated_at ?? null },[39m
[31m+     findings, evidence, observations, remediation, verification,[39m
[31m+     traceability: 'Report -> Passport -> Risk -> Finding -> Observation -> Provider -> Source -> Timestamp -> Hash',[39m
[31m+     resolutionTraceability: 'Finding -> remediation -> new observation -> independent verification',[39m
[31m+     limitations: evidence.filter((item: any) => item.limitation).map((item: any) => ({ evidenceId: item.id, limitation: item.limitation })),[39m
[31m+     ...buildReportTypeExtras(reportType, passport, findings),[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+   const canonicalPayload = JSON.stringify(report);[39m
[31m+   const reportHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalPayload).digest('hex');[39m
[31m+   await db.execute(sql`INSERT INTO trust_report_snapshots (id,tenant_id,passport_id,report_type,generated_at,score,confidence_basis_points,completeness_basis_points,evidence_ids,finding_ids,observation_id,canonical_payload_hash,payload,created_at) VALUES (${id('report')},${tenantId},${passportId},${reportType},${report.generatedAt},${risk.canonicalScore},${risk.confidenceBasisPoints},${risk.completenessBasisPoints},${JSON.stringify(evidence.map((item: any) => item.id))},${JSON.stringify(findings.map((item: any) => item.id))},${latest?.id ?? null},${reportHash},${canonicalPayload},${report.generatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,passport_id,report_type,canonical_payload_hash) DO NOTHING`);[39m
[31m+   return { ...report, reportHash };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ import { AuthenticatedRequest } from '../middleware/security.ts';[39m
[31m+ import { decryptCredentials } from '../integrations/credential-vault.ts';[39m
[31m+ import { collectDeepProviderEvidence } from '../integrations/deep-collectors.ts';[39m
[31m+ import { collectGitHubDeepEvidence } from '../integrations/github-deep.ts';[39m
[31m+ import { persistTrustLoop, verifyRemediation } from '../trust/trust-loop.ts';[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ const collectSchema = z.object({ passportId: z.string().trim().min(1).max(255), provider: z.string().trim().min(1).max(64) }).strict();[39m
[31m+ const remediationSchema = z.object({[39m
[31m+   findingId: z.string().trim().min(1),[39m
[31m+   title: z.string().trim().min(1).max(255),[39m
[31m+   description: z.string().max(4000).optional(),[39m
[31m+   assigneeId: z.string().max(255).optional(),[39m
[31m+   assigneeDisplay: z.string().max(255).optional(),[39m
[31m+   externalSystem: z.string().trim().min(1).max(64).default('SPR'),[39m
[31m+   externalTicketId: z.string().max(255).optional(),[39m
[31m+   slaDueAt: z.string().datetime().optional(),[39m
[31m+   priority: z.enum(['LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH', 'CRITICAL']).default('HIGH'),[39m
[31m+ }).strict();[39m
[31m+ const remediationUpdateSchema = z.object({ status: z.enum(['OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'BLOCKED', 'READY_FOR_VERIFICATION', 'VERIFIED', 'CLOSED', 'CANCELLED']), ownerId: z.string().max(255).optional(), ownerDisplay: z.string().max(255).optional(), slaDueAt: z.string().datetime().nullable().optional() }).strict();[39m
[31m+ const verifySchema = z.object({ findingId: z.string().trim().min(1), observationIds: z.array(z.string().min(1)).max(50), evidenceIds: z.array(z.string().min(1)).max(200) }).strict();[39m
[31m+ const reportTypes = z.enum(['executive', 'technical', 'msp', 'customer', 'compliance', 'vendor', 'auditor', 'evidence-ledger']);[39m
[31m+ function id(prefix: string) { return `${prefix}_${crypto.randomUUID().replaceAll('-', '')}`; }[39m
[31m+ function parseJson(value: unknown, fallback: unknown = []) { try { return value ? JSON.parse(String(value)) : fallback; } catch { return fallback; } }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ const SEVERITY_ORDER = ['critical', 'high', 'medium', 'low'];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ export type ReportPassportRow = {[39m
[31m+   overall_score: number | null;[39m
[31m+   security_score: number | null;[39m
[31m+   compliance_score: number | null;[39m
[31m+   verification_status: string | null;[39m
[31m+   confidence_score: number | null;[39m
[31m+   evidence_completeness: number | null;[39m
[31m+ };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ export function deriveReportRiskFields(passport: ReportPassportRow) {[39m
[31m+   const verificationStatus = passport.verification_status || 'unverified';[39m
[31m+   const isMeasured = verificationStatus !== 'unverified';[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     canonicalScore: isMeasured ? passport.overall_score : null,[39m
[31m+     verificationStatus,[39m
[31m+     confidenceBasisPoints: isMeasured && passport.confidence_score != null ? Math.round(passport.confidence_score * 100) : null,[39m
[31m+     completenessBasisPoints: isMeasured && passport.evidence_completeness != null ? Math.round(passport.evidence_completeness * 100) : null,[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function buildReportTypeExtras(reportType: string, passport: any, findings: any[]) {[39m
[31m+   if (reportType === 'sbom') {[39m
[31m+     const components = parseJson(passport.sbom, []) as any[];[39m
[31m+     const vulnerabilities = parseJson(passport.vulnerabilities, []) as any[];[39m
[31m+     const sbom = components.map((component) => {[39m
[31m+       const name = component?.name || component?.packageName || component?.component;[39m
[31m+       const matched = vulnerabilities.filter((vuln) => (vuln?.component || vuln?.packageName || vuln?.package) === name);[39m
[31m+       return { ...component, vulnerabilityCount: matched.length, criticalOrHighCount: matched.filter((vuln) => SEVERITY_ORDER.slice(0, 2).includes(String(vuln?.severity || '').toLowerCase())).length };[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     return { sbom };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (reportType === 'compliance') {[39m
[31m+     const byControl = new Map<string, { controlId: string; findingCount: number; openCount: number; worstSeverity: string; findingIds: string[] }>();[39m
[31m+     for (const finding of findings) {[39m
[31m+       const controlId = finding.control_id || 'unmapped';[39m
[31m+       const entry = byControl.get(controlId) || { controlId, findingCount: 0, openCount: 0, worstSeverity: 'low', findingIds: [] as string[] };[39m
[31m+       entry.findingCount += 1;[39m
[31m+       entry.findingIds.push(finding.id);[39m
[31m+       if (!['resolved', 'closed', 'verified'].includes(String(finding.status || '').toLowerCase())) entry.openCount += 1;[39m
[31m+       const severity = String(finding.severity || '').toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+       if (SEVERITY_ORDER.includes(severity) && SEVERITY_ORDER.indexOf(severity) < SEVERITY_ORDER.indexOf(entry.worstSeverity)) entry.worstSeverity = severity;[39m
[31m+       byControl.set(controlId, entry);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return { controls: [...byControl.values()] };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return {};[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export function createTrustLoopRouter() {[39m
[31m+   const router = Router();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   router.post('/collect', async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     const parsed = collectSchema.safeParse(req.body);[39m
[31m+     if (!parsed.success) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'INVALID_PAYLOAD', details: parsed.error.flatten() });[39m
[31m+     const { passportId, provider } = parsed.data;[39m
[31m+     const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m
[31m+     const runId = id('collect');[39m
[31m+     const startedAt = new Date().toISOString();[39m
[31m+     const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const passport = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,client_id FROM passports WHERE id=${passportId} AND tenant_id=${tenantId} LIMIT 1`) as any).rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+       if (!passport) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'PASSPORT_NOT_FOUND' });[39m
[31m+       const stored = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT encrypted_payload FROM integration_credentials WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND provider=${provider} LIMIT 1`) as any).rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+       if (!stored?.encrypted_payload) return res.status(409).json({ error: 'CREDENTIAL_NOT_CONFIGURED' });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       await db.execute(sql`INSERT INTO trust_collection_runs (id,tenant_id,passport_id,provider,started_at,status,idempotency_key,created_at) VALUES (${runId},${tenantId},${passportId},${provider},${startedAt},'RUNNING',${`${tenantId}:${passportId}:${provider}:${startedAt}`},${startedAt})`);[39m
[31m+       const credentials = decryptCredentials(stored.encrypted_payload) as Record<string, string>;[39m
[31m+       const observations = provider === 'github' ? await collectGitHubDeepEvidence(credentials) : await collectDeepProviderEvidence(provider as any, credentials);[39m
[31m+       const result = await persistTrustLoop({ tenantId, passportId, clientId: passport.client_id || passport.id, assetId: passport.id, observations, generationReason: 'provider_collection', actorType: 'worker', collectorVersionMap: { [provider]: 'deep-v2' } });[39m
[31m+       const completedAt = new Date().toISOString();[39m
[31m+       await db.execute(sql`UPDATE trust_collection_runs SET completed_at=${completedAt},status='SUCCEEDED',observation_count=${observations.length},evidence_count=${result.evidenceIds.length},failure_count=${observations.filter((o) => o.status === 'FAIL').length},collector_version='deep-v2' WHERE id=${runId} AND tenant_id=${tenantId}`);[39m
[31m+       await db.execute(sql`INSERT INTO trust_monitoring_state (id,tenant_id,passport_id,provider,next_run_at,last_run_at,last_success_at,last_evidence_hash,consecutive_failures,status,updated_at) VALUES (${id('monitor')},${tenantId},${passportId},${provider},${new Date(Date.now()+3600000).toISOString()},${completedAt},${completedAt},${result.payloadHash},0,'HEALTHY',${completedAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,passport_id,provider) DO UPDATE SET next_run_at=EXCLUDED.next_run_at,last_run_at=EXCLUDED.last_run_at,last_success_at=EXCLUDED.last_success_at,last_evidence_hash=EXCLUDED.last_evidence_hash,consecutive_failures=0,status='HEALTHY',updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at`);[39m
[31m+       return res.json({ runId, provider, observationCount: observations.length, ...result });[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+       const completedAt = new Date().toISOString();[39m
[31m+       await db.execute(sql`UPDATE trust_collection_runs SET completed_at=${completedAt},status='FAILED',error_code='COLLECTION_FAILED',error_message=${error instanceof Error ? error.message.slice(0,1000) : 'COLLECTION_FAILED'} WHERE id=${runId} AND tenant_id=${tenantId}`).catch(() => undefined);[39m
[31m+       await db.execute(sql`UPDATE trust_monitoring_state SET last_run_at=${completedAt},last_failure_at=${completedAt},consecutive_failures=consecutive_failures+1,status=CASE WHEN consecutive_failures+1 >= 5 THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'DEGRADED' END,updated_at=${completedAt} WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} AND provider=${provider}`).catch(() => undefined);[39m
[31m+       return next(error);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const findingsWithRemediationSelect = sql`[39m
[31m+     SELECT f.*, r.id AS remediation_id, r.status AS remediation_status, r.owner_id AS remediation_owner_id,[39m
[31m+            r.owner_display AS remediation_owner_display, r.sla_due_at AS remediation_sla_due_at, r.updated_at AS remediation_updated_at[39m
[31m+     FROM trust_findings f[39m
[31m+     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ([39m
[31m+       SELECT * FROM trust_remediation_work_items w[39m
[31m+       WHERE w.tenant_id = f.tenant_id AND w.finding_id = f.id[39m
[31m+       ORDER BY w.created_at DESC LIMIT 1[39m
[31m+     ) r ON true[39m
[31m+   `;[39m
[31m+   router.get('/findings', async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m
[31m+       const passportId = typeof req.query.passportId === 'string' ? req.query.passportId : null;[39m
[31m+       const rows = passportId[39m
[31m+         ? await db.execute(sql`${findingsWithRemediationSelect} WHERE f.tenant_id=${tenantId} AND f.passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY CASE f.severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'low' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END,f.updated_at DESC`)[39m
[31m+         : await db.execute(sql`${findingsWithRemediationSelect} WHERE f.tenant_id=${tenantId} ORDER BY f.updated_at DESC`);[39m
[31m+       return res.json({ findings: (rows as any).rows || [] });[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) { return next(error); }[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   router.post('/remediations', async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     const parsed = remediationSchema.safeParse(req.body);[39m
[31m+     if (!parsed.success) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'INVALID_PAYLOAD', details: parsed.error.flatten() });[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const p = parsed.data;[39m
[31m+       const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m
[31m+       const finding = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,client_id,passport_id,title,description FROM trust_findings WHERE id=${p.findingId} AND tenant_id=${tenantId} LIMIT 1`) as any).rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+       if (!finding) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'FINDING_NOT_FOUND' });[39m
[31m+       const now = new Date().toISOString();[39m
[31m+       const workId = id('remed');[39m
[31m+       await db.execute(sql`INSERT INTO trust_remediation_work_items (id,tenant_id,passport_id,finding_id,external_system,external_ticket_id,owner_id,owner_display,sla_due_at,status,remediation_plan,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (${workId},${tenantId},${finding.passport_id},${finding.id},${p.externalSystem},${p.externalTicketId ?? null},${p.assigneeId ?? null},${p.assigneeDisplay ?? null},${p.slaDueAt ?? null},'OPEN',${p.description || finding.description},${now},${now})`);[39m
[31m+       await db.execute(sql`INSERT INTO remediation_tasks (id,tenant_id,client_id,alert_id,title,description,priority,status,assignee_id,created_by,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (${workId},${tenantId},${finding.client_id},${finding.id},${p.title},${p.description || finding.description},${p.priority},'OPEN',${p.assigneeId ?? null},${req.user!.uid},${now},${now})`);[39m
[31m+       const created = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM trust_remediation_work_items WHERE id=${workId} AND tenant_id=${tenantId} LIMIT 1`) as any).rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+       return res.status(201).json({ ...created, title: p.title });[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) { return next(error); }[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   router.get('/remediations/:id', async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m
[31m+       const row = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT w.*, f.title AS finding_title FROM trust_remediation_work_items w JOIN trust_findings f ON f.id = w.finding_id AND f.tenant_id = w.tenant_id WHERE w.id=${req.params.id} AND w.tenant_id=${tenantId} LIMIT 1`) as any).rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+       if (!row) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'REMEDIATION_NOT_FOUND' });[39m
[31m+       return res.json({ ...row, title: row.finding_title });[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) { return next(error); }[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   router.post('/remediations/:id/verify-latest', async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m
[31m+       const work = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,finding_id,passport_id FROM trust_remediation_work_items WHERE id=${req.params.id} AND tenant_id=${tenantId} LIMIT 1`) as any).rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+       if (!work) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'REMEDIATION_NOT_FOUND' });[39m
[31m+       const latestObservation = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,evidence_ids FROM trust_observations WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${work.passport_id} ORDER BY observation_version DESC LIMIT 1`) as any).rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+       if (!latestObservation) return res.status(409).json({ error: 'NO_OBSERVATION_ON_FILE', message: 'SPR has no recorded observation for this software yet. Collect evidence before verifying.' });[39m
[31m+       const evidenceIds: string[] = parseJson(latestObservation.evidence_ids, []) as string[];[39m
[31m+       const result = await verifyRemediation({ tenantId, findingId: work.finding_id, observationIds: [latestObservation.id], evidenceIds, actorId: req.user!.uid });[39m
[31m+       const now = new Date().toISOString();[39m
[31m+       await db.execute(sql`UPDATE trust_remediation_work_items SET status='VERIFIED',updated_at=${now},closed_at=${now} WHERE id=${work.id} AND tenant_id=${tenantId}`);[39m
[31m+       const row = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM trust_remediation_work_items WHERE id=${work.id} AND tenant_id=${tenantId} LIMIT 1`) as any).rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+       return res.json({ ...row, verification: result });[39m
[31m+     } catch (error: any) {[39m
[31m+       const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);[39m
[31m+       if (/^VERIFICATION_|^FINDING_NOT_FOUND$/.test(message)) return res.status(409).json({ error: message });[39m
[31m+       return next(error);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   router.patch('/remediations/:id', async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     const parsed = remediationUpdateSchema.safeParse(req.body);[39m
[31m+     if (!parsed.success) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'INVALID_PAYLOAD', details: parsed.error.flatten() });[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m
[31m+       const p = parsed.data;[39m
[31m+       const now = new Date().toISOString();[39m
[31m+       const rows = await db.execute(sql`UPDATE trust_remediation_work_items SET status=${p.status},owner_id=COALESCE(${p.ownerId ?? null},owner_id),owner_display=COALESCE(${p.ownerDisplay ?? null},owner_display),sla_due_at=CASE WHEN ${p.slaDueAt === undefined} THEN sla_due_at ELSE ${p.slaDueAt} END,updated_at=${now},closed_at=CASE WHEN ${p.status} IN ('CLOSED','VERIFIED') THEN ${now} ELSE closed_at END WHERE id=${req.params.id} AND tenant_id=${tenantId} RETURNING *`);[39m
[31m+       const row = (rows as any).rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+       if (!row) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'REMEDIATION_NOT_FOUND' });[39m
[31m+       return res.json(row);[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) { return next(error); }[39m
[31m+   });[39m

[31m+   router.post('/verify', async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     const parsed = verifySchema.safeParse(req.body);[39m
[31m+     if (!parsed.success) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'INVALID_PAYLOAD', details: parsed.error.flatten() });[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const result = await verifyRemediation({ ...parsed.data, tenantId: req.user!.tenantId, actorId: req.user!.uid });[39m
[31m+       await db.execute(sql`UPDATE trust_remediation_work_items SET status='VERIFIED',updated_at=${new Date().toISOString()},closed_at=${new Date().toISOString()} WHERE tenant_id=${req.user!.tenantId} AND finding_id=${parsed.data.findingId}`);[39m
[31m+       return res.json(result);[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) { return next(error); }[39m
[31m+   });[39m

[31m+       const passportId = typeof req.query.passportId === 'string' ? req.query.passportId : null;[39m
[31m+       const rows = passportId ? await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM trust_monitoring_state WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY provider`) : await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM trust_monitoring_state WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} ORDER BY passport_id,provider`);[39m

[31m+     } catch (error) { return next(error); }[39m
[31m+   });[39m

[31m+   router.get('/ledger/:passportId', async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m
[31m+       const passportId = req.params.passportId;[39m

[31m+       if (!(scope as any).rows?.length) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'PASSPORT_NOT_FOUND' });[39m
[31m+       const observations = await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,observation_version,generated_at,previous_observation_id,evidence_ids,finding_ids,canonical_payload_hash,completeness_basis_points,open_finding_count,unknown_dimension_count FROM trust_observations WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY observation_version DESC`);[39m
[31m+       const evidence = await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,provider,control_id,subject,source_url,observed_at,verification_method,status,severity,evidence_hash,limitation FROM evidence_ledger WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY observed_at DESC`);[39m
[31m+       const findings = await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,control_id,title,severity,status,evidence_ids,fingerprint,updated_at,resolved_at FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC`);[39m
[31m+       const remediation = await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM trust_remediation_work_items WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC`);[39m
[31m+       const verification = await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM remediation_verification_ledger WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND finding_id IN (SELECT id FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId}) ORDER BY created_at DESC`);[39m
[31m+       return res.json({ observations: (observations as any).rows || [], findings: (findings as any).rows || [], evidence: (evidence as any).rows || [], remediation: (remediation as any).rows || [], verification: (verification as any).rows || [], trace: 'Report -> Passport -> Risk -> Finding -> Observation -> Provider -> Source -> Timestamp -> Hash' });[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) { return next(error); }[39m
[31m+   });[39m

[31m+   router.get('/reports/:passportId/history', async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m
[31m+       const passportId = req.params.passportId;[39m
[31m+       const typeFilter = typeof req.query.type === 'string' ? reportTypes.safeParse(req.query.type) : null;[39m
[31m+       if (typeFilter && !typeFilter.success) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'INVALID_REPORT_TYPE' });[39m
[31m+       const rows = typeFilter?.success[39m
[31m+         ? await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,report_type,generated_at,score,confidence_basis_points,completeness_basis_points,canonical_payload_hash FROM trust_report_snapshots WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} AND report_type=${typeFilter.data} ORDER BY generated_at DESC LIMIT 50`)[39m

[31m+ export async function buildAndPersistReport(db: any, tenantId: string, passportId: string, reportType: string) {[39m
[31m+   const passport = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,name,overall_score,security_score,compliance_score,verification_status,confidence_score,evidence_completeness,sbom,evidence,vulnerabilities,timeline FROM passports WHERE id=${passportId} AND tenant_id=${tenantId} LIMIT 1`) as any).rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+   if (!passport) return null;[39m
[31m+   const findings = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,control_id,title,severity,status,description,remediation,evidence_ids,updated_at,resolved_at FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'low' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END,updated_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const evidence = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,provider,control_id,subject,source_url,observed_at,verification_method,status,severity,evidence_hash,limitation FROM evidence_ledger WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY observed_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const observations = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,observation_version,generated_at,previous_observation_id,evidence_ids,finding_ids,canonical_payload_hash,completeness_basis_points,confidence_basis_points,open_finding_count,unknown_dimension_count FROM trust_observations WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY observation_version DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const remediation = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM trust_remediation_work_items WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const verification = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM remediation_verification_ledger WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND finding_id IN (SELECT id FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId}) ORDER BY created_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const latest = observations[0];[39m
[31m+   const risk = deriveReportRiskFields(passport as ReportPassportRow);[39m
[31m+   const report = {[39m
[31m+     schemaVersion: 'spr.report.v2', reportType, generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(), passport: { id: passport.id, name: passport.name },[39m
[31m+     risk: { overall: risk.canonicalScore, security: passport.security_score, compliance: passport.compliance_score, verificationStatus: risk.verificationStatus },[39m
[31m+     evidenceQuality: { completenessBasisPoints: risk.completenessBasisPoints, confidenceBasisPoints: risk.confidenceBasisPoints, unknownDimensions: latest?.unknown_dimension_count ?? 0, latestObservationAt: latest?.generated_at ?? null },[39m
[31m+     findings, evidence, observations, remediation, verification,[39m
[31m+     traceability: 'Report -> Passport -> Risk -> Finding -> Observation -> Provider -> Source -> Timestamp -> Hash',[39m
[31m+     resolutionTraceability: 'Finding -> remediation -> new observation -> independent verification',[39m
[31m+     limitations: evidence.filter((item: any) => item.limitation).map((item: any) => ({ evidenceId: item.id, limitation: item.limitation })),[39m
[31m+     ...buildReportTypeExtras(reportType, passport, findings),[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+   const canonicalPayload = JSON.stringify(report);[39m
[31m+   const reportHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalPayload).digest('hex');[39m
[31m+   await db.execute(sql`INSERT INTO trust_report_snapshots (id,tenant_id,passport_id,report_type,generated_at,score,confidence_basis_points,completeness_basis_points,evidence_ids,finding_ids,observation_id,canonical_payload_hash,payload,created_at) VALUES (${id('report')},${tenantId},${passportId},${reportType},${report.generatedAt},${risk.canonicalScore},${risk.confidenceBasisPoints},${risk.completenessBasisPoints},${JSON.stringify(evidence.map((item: any) => item.id))},${JSON.stringify(findings.map((item: any) => item.id))},${latest?.id ?? null},${reportHash},${canonicalPayload},${report.generatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,passport_id,report_type,canonical_payload_hash) DO NOTHING`);[39m
[31m+   return { ...report, reportHash };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ async function shutdown(signal: string) { if (shuttingDown) return; shuttingDown = true; console.info(`[SPR] ${signal} received; shutting down gracefully.`); const forceTimer = setTimeout(() => process.exit(1), 15_000); forceTimer.unref(); if (server) await new Promise<void>(resolve => server!.close(() => resolve())); await closeDatabase().catch(error => console.error('[SPR] Database shutdown error:', error)); if (config.sentry.dsn) await Sentry.close(2_000).catch(() => undefined); clearTimeout(forceTimer); process.exit(0); }[39m

[31m+ function isEscalated(alert: Alert) {[39m
