[31m+ function AlertDrawer({ alert, onClose, onAlertAction }: { alert: Alert; onClose: () => void; onAlertAction: (alert: Alert, action: AlertAction, assigneeDisplay?: string) => Promise<void> }) {[39m
[31m+   const [working, setWorking] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const [assignee, setAssignee] = useState(alert.ownerDisplay || '');[39m
[31m+   const [showAssign, setShowAssign] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const run = async (action: AlertAction, extra?: string) => {[39m
[31m+     setWorking(true);[39m
[31m+     try { await onAlertAction(alert, action, extra); setShowAssign(false); } finally { setWorking(false); }[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[70] flex justify-end bg-black/20" onMouseDown={onClose}>[39m
[31m+     <aside role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={`Alert details for ${alert.title}`} onMouseDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()} className="h-full w-full max-w-xl overflow-y-auto border-l border-[#e1dfdd] bg-white p-6">[39m
[31m+       <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 border-b border-[#e1dfdd] pb-4">[39m
[31m+         <div>[39m
[31m+           <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-[#0f6cbd]"><ShieldAlert className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Finding detail</div>[39m
[31m+           <h2 className="mt-2 text-[18px] font-semibold text-[#201f1e]">{alert.title}</h2>[39m
[31m+           <p className="mt-1 font-mono text-[11px] text-[#8a8886]">{alert.id}</p>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+         <button onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close alert details" className="rounded border border-[#c8c6c4] p-1.5 text-[#605e5c] hover:bg-black/[.03]"><X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></button>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-[13px]">[39m
[31m+         <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 ${severityText[alert.severity] || 'text-[#605e5c]'}`}><span className={`h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${severityDot[alert.severity] || 'bg-[#8a8886]'}`} />{alert.severity}</span>[39m
[31m+         <span className="text-[#8a8886]">{alert.category}</span>[39m
[31m+         <span className="text-[#605e5c]">{alert.clientName}</span>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <div className="mt-4 space-y-4">[39m
[31m+         <div className="rounded-md border border-[#e1dfdd] p-3">[39m
[31m+           <div className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wide text-[#605e5c]">Description</div>[39m
[31m+           <p className="mt-2 text-[13px] leading-6 text-[#323130]">{alert.description || 'No description observed.'}</p>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+         <div className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">[39m
[31m+           <Detail label="Observed timestamp" value={alert.timestamp || 'Not observed'} />[39m
[31m+           <Detail label="Current workflow state" value={alert.status} />[39m
[31m+           <Detail label="Assigned to" value={alert.ownerDisplay || 'Unassigned'} />[39m
[31m+           <Detail label="SLA due" value={alert.slaDueAt ? new Date(alert.slaDueAt).toLocaleString() : 'No SLA set'} />[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <div className="mt-4 rounded-md border border-[#e1dfdd] bg-[#faf9f8] p-3">[39m
[31m+         <div className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-[#201f1e]">Record a workflow decision</div>[39m
[31m+         <p className="mt-1 text-[12px] leading-5 text-[#605e5c]">Actions create or update the remediation work item tied to this finding, through the authenticated Trust Loop route.</p>[39m
[31m+         <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">[39m
[31m+           {(alert.status === 'Active') && <button disabled={working} onClick={() => void run('acknowledge')} className="h-8 rounded bg-[#0f6cbd] px-3 text-[12px] font-medium text-white hover:bg-[#004578] disabled:opacity-40">Acknowledge</button>}[39m
[31m+           {(alert.status === 'Active' || alert.status === 'Acknowledged') && <button disabled={working} onClick={() => setShowAssign((open) => !open)} className="h-8 rounded border border-[#c8c6c4] px-3 text-[12px] font-medium text-[#323130] hover:bg-black/[.03] disabled:opacity-40">Assign…</button>}[39m
[31m+           {(alert.status === 'Active' || alert.status === 'Acknowledged') && <button disabled={working} onClick={() => void run('escalate')} className="h-8 rounded border border-[#c8c6c4] px-3 text-[12px] font-medium text-[#8a5700] hover:bg-black/[.03] disabled:opacity-40">Escalate</button>}[39m
[31m+           {(alert.status === 'Active' || alert.status === 'Acknowledged') && <button disabled={working} onClick={() => void run('snooze')} className="h-8 rounded border border-[#c8c6c4] px-3 text-[12px] font-medium text-[#323130] hover:bg-black/[.03] disabled:opacity-40">Snooze</button>}[39m
[31m+           {(alert.status !== 'Resolved') && <button disabled={working} onClick={() => void run('resolve')} className="h-8 rounded bg-[#0e700e] px-3 text-[12px] font-medium text-white hover:bg-[#0e700e]/90 disabled:opacity-40">Mark resolved</button>}[39m
[31m+           {alert.status === 'Snoozed' && <button disabled={working} onClick={() => void run('reopen')} className="h-8 rounded border border-[#c8c6c4] px-3 text-[12px] font-medium text-[#0f6cbd] hover:bg-black/[.03] disabled:opacity-40">Restore active</button>}[39m
[31m+           {alert.status === 'Resolved' && <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[12px] text-[#0e700e]"><ShieldCheck className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />Resolved state recorded; new evidence is still required to verify the finding.</div>}[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+         {showAssign && ([39m
[31m+           <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded border border-[#e1dfdd] bg-white p-2">[39m
[31m+             <input value={assignee} onChange={(event) => setAssignee(event.target.value)} placeholder="Name or email" className="h-9 min-w-0 flex-1 rounded border border-[#c8c6c4] bg-white px-3 text-[13px] text-[#201f1e] outline-none placeholder:text-[#8a8886] focus:border-[#0f6cbd] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#0f6cbd]" />[39m
[31m+             <button disabled={working || !assignee.trim()} onClick={() => void run('assign', assignee.trim())} className="h-9 rounded bg-[#0f6cbd] px-3 text-[12px] font-medium text-white hover:bg-[#004578] disabled:opacity-40">Assign</button>[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         )}[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     </aside>[39m
[31m+   </div>;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+   { id: 'cloud-serverless', name: 'Cloud & Serverless Runtimes', iconName: 'Server', description: 'Function-as-a-Service executors, cloud API gateways, storage buckets, and dynamic cloud resource schedulers.', threatProfile: 'Denial of Wallet, cloud account takeovers, storage bucket misconfigurations, and function injection attacks.', hardeningBlueprint: 'Apply strict Principle of Least Privilege to IAM execution roles, enforce storage bucket private-by-default access, and set execution timeout caps.', complianceMandate: 'NIST SP 800-210 (General Cloud Security), CIS Cloud Provider Foundation Benchmarks.', vulnerabilityClass: 'IAM Privilege Abuse, Public S3 Buckets' },[39m
[31m+   { id: 'ai-ml', name: 'AI & Machine Learning Frameworks', iconName: 'Sparkles', description: 'Neural network training libraries, model serving pipelines, vector databases, and LLM orchestration wrappers.', threatProfile: 'Prompt injection, training data poisoning, model extraction, and arbitrary code execution via compromised model weights (e.g. Pickle files).', hardeningBlueprint: 'Strictly use safe weight serialization formats (e.g. Safetensors), sanitize all incoming context window inputs, and audit vector indexes.', complianceMandate: 'NIST AI Risk Management Framework, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.', vulnerabilityClass: 'Arbitrary Code Execution, Prompt Injection' },[39m
[31m+   { id: 'apis-middleware', name: 'APIs & Integration Middleware', iconName: 'Plug', description: 'Message brokers, GraphQL servers, enterprise service buses, and third-party integration gateways.', threatProfile: 'Message queue poisoning, excessive data exposure (GraphQL query depth limits exceeded), and authentication bypass on proxy layers.', hardeningBlueprint: 'Define strict GraphQL query depth and complexity limits, sign all message payloads, and restrict broker ports from public egress.', complianceMandate: 'OWASP API Security Top 10, SOC 2 CC6.6 (Safe Web App Protection).', vulnerabilityClass: 'GraphQL Denial of Service, Queue Poisoning' },[39m
[31m+   { id: 'virtualization', name: 'Virtualization & Hypervisors', iconName: 'Layers', description: 'Bare-metal hypervisors, virtualization managers, and cloud-native MicroVM runtimes.', threatProfile: 'Hypervisor breakout, guest-to-host execution side channels (e.g. Spectre/Meltdown), CPU caching leaks.', hardeningBlueprint: 'Apply core pinning, enable microarchitectural hardware mitigations in boot configs, and restrict physical host administration channels.', complianceMandate: 'NIST SP 800-125 (Virtualization Security), PCI DSS Section 2 (System Hardening).', vulnerabilityClass: 'Hypervisor Breakout, Side Channel Leaks' }[39m
[31m+ ];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ const getIconComponent = (iconName: string) => {[39m
[31m+   const map: Record<string, React.ComponentType<any>> = { Globe, Database, Code, Layers, Cpu, GitBranch, Lock, Activity, Server, Sparkles, Plug, ShieldCheck, FileText };[39m
[31m+   return map[iconName] || Code;[39m
[31m+ };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ interface SoftwareSectorsPanelProps {[39m
[31m+   passports: SoftwarePassport[];[39m
[31m+   onFilterCategory: (category: string) => void;[39m
[31m+   onNavigateTab?: (tab: string, itemId?: string) => void;[39m
[31m+   setSelectedPassportId: (id: string | null) => void;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ export default function SoftwareSectorsPanel({ passports, onFilterCategory, onNavigateTab, setSelectedPassportId }: SoftwareSectorsPanelProps) {[39m
[31m+   const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');[39m
[31m+   const [selectedSectorId, setSelectedSectorId] = useState<string | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [showAddForm, setShowAddForm] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const [customSectors, setCustomSectors] = useState<SectorProfile[]>(() => {[39m
[31m+     try { const saved = localStorage.getItem('msp_custom_sectors'); return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : []; } catch { return []; }[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+   const [newName, setNewName] = useState('');[39m
[31m+   const [newIcon, setNewIcon] = useState('Cpu');[39m
[31m+   const [newDescription, setNewDescription] = useState('');[39m
[31m+   const [newThreat, setNewThreat] = useState('');[39m
[31m+   const [newHardening, setNewHardening] = useState('');[39m
[31m+   const [newCompliance, setNewCompliance] = useState('');[39m
[31m+   const [newVulClass, setNewVulClass] = useState('');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const allSectors = useMemo(() => [...DEFAULT_SECTORS, ...customSectors], [customSectors]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const sectorMetrics = useMemo(() => {[39m
[31m+     const metrics: Record<string, { count: number; avgTrust: number; totalCves: number; totalSboms: number; matchedPassports: SoftwarePassport[] }> = {};[39m
[31m+     allSectors.forEach(sector => {[39m
[31m+       const matched = passports.filter(p => p.category.toLowerCase().trim() === sector.name.toLowerCase().trim());[39m
[31m+       const scored = matched.filter((p): p is SoftwarePassport & { overallScore: number } => p.overallScore != null);[39m
[31m+       const count = matched.length;[39m
[31m+       const avgTrust = scored.length > 0 ? Math.round(scored.reduce((acc, p) => acc + p.overallScore, 0) / scored.length) : 0;[39m
[31m+       const totalCves = matched.reduce((acc, p) => acc + p.vulnerabilities.length, 0);[39m
[31m+       const totalSboms = matched.reduce((acc, p) => acc + p.sbom.length, 0);[39m
[31m+       metrics[sector.id] = { count, avgTrust, totalCves, totalSboms, matchedPassports: matched };[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     return metrics;[39m
[31m+   }, [allSectors, passports]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const filteredSectors = useMemo(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (!searchQuery.trim()) return allSectors;[39m
[31m+     return allSectors.filter(s => s.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) || s.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) || s.vulnerabilityClass.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()));[39m
[31m+   }, [allSectors, searchQuery]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const aggregateStats = useMemo(() => {[39m
[31m+     const totalTrackedPassports = passports.length;[39m
[31m+     const sectorsWithActivePassports = (Object.values(sectorMetrics) as { count: number }[]).filter(m => m.count > 0).length;[39m
[31m+     const totalCvesAcrossSectors = passports.reduce((acc, p) => acc + p.vulnerabilities.length, 0);[39m
[31m+     const scored = passports.filter((p): p is SoftwarePassport & { overallScore: number } => p.overallScore != null);[39m
[31m+     const overallEcosystemTrust = scored.length > 0 ? Math.round(scored.reduce((acc, p) => acc + p.overallScore, 0) / scored.length) : 90;[39m
[31m+     return { totalTrackedPassports, sectorsWithActivePassports, totalCvesAcrossSectors, overallEcosystemTrust };[39m
[31m+   }, [passports, sectorMetrics]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const handleAddSector = (e: React.FormEvent) => {[39m
[31m+     e.preventDefault();[39m
[31m+     if (!newName.trim() || !newDescription.trim()) return;[39m
[31m+     const sectorId = 'sect-' + Date.now();[39m
[31m+     const newSector: SectorProfile = { id: sectorId, name: newName.trim(), iconName: newIcon, description: newDescription.trim(), threatProfile: newThreat.trim() || 'General access breach and package substitution in pipeline.', hardeningBlueprint: newHardening.trim() || 'Enforce multi-tenant access restriction and strict verification of digital cryptographic hashes.', complianceMandate: newCompliance.trim() || 'SOC 2 Core Controls.', vulnerabilityClass: newVulClass.trim() || 'General Software Security Vulnerability' };[39m
[31m+     const updated = [...customSectors, newSector];[39m
[31m+     setCustomSectors(updated);[39m
[31m+     localStorage.setItem('msp_custom_sectors', JSON.stringify(updated));[39m
[31m+     setNewName(''); setNewDescription(''); setNewThreat(''); setNewHardening(''); setNewCompliance(''); setNewVulClass(''); setNewIcon('Cpu'); setShowAddForm(false); setSelectedSectorId(sectorId);[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const selectedSector = allSectors.find(s => s.id === selectedSectorId);[39m
[31m+   const selectedMetrics = selectedSectorId ? sectorMetrics[selectedSectorId] : null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="space-y-4" id="software-sectors-explorer">[39m
[31m+       <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between"><div><h2 className="text-[15px] font-semibold text-[#201f1e]">Software sectors</h2><p className="mt-0.5 text-[13px] text-[#605e5c]">Technology sector classifications, threat profiles and hardening guidance mapped to your catalog.</p></div></div>[39m
[31m+       <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-6 rounded-md border border-[#e1dfdd] bg-white p-3">[39m
[31m+         <div><div className="text-[11px] text-[#605e5c]">Tracked sectors</div><div className="text-lg font-semibold text-[#201f1e]">{allSectors.length}</div></div>[39m
[31m+         <div><div className="text-[11px] text-[#605e5c]">Ecosystem trust</div><div className="text-lg font-semibold text-[#0e700e]">{aggregateStats.overallEcosystemTrust}/100</div></div>[39m
[31m+         <div><div className="text-[11px] text-[#605e5c]">Covered footprint</div><div className="text-lg font-semibold text-[#201f1e]">{aggregateStats.sectorsWithActivePassports} / {allSectors.length}</div></div>[39m
[31m+         <div><div className="text-[11px] text-[#605e5c]">Active sector findings</div><div className={`text-lg font-semibold ${aggregateStats.totalCvesAcrossSectors > 0 ? 'text-[#a4262c]' : 'text-[#0e700e]'}`}>{aggregateStats.totalCvesAcrossSectors}</div></div>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+       <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">[39m
[31m+         <label className="flex h-9 w-full items-center gap-2 rounded border border-[#c8c6c4] bg-white px-3 focus-within:border-[#0f6cbd] focus-within:ring-1 focus-within:ring-[#0f6cbd] sm:max-w-md"><Search className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-[#8a8886]" /><input type="text" placeholder="Search sectors, vulnerability classes, compliance standards..." value={searchQuery} onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)} className="w-full bg-transparent text-[13px] text-[#323130] outline-none placeholder:text-[#8a8886]" /></label>[39m
[31m+         <button onClick={() => setShowAddForm(true)} className="flex h-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded bg-[#0f6cbd] px-3 text-[13px] font-medium text-white hover:bg-[#004578]"><Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /><span>Register software sector</span></button>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+       <div className="grid grid-cols-1 items-start gap-4 lg:grid-cols-12">[39m
[31m+         <div className={`${selectedSectorId ? 'lg:col-span-7' : 'lg:col-span-12'} grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 md:grid-cols-2`}>[39m
[31m+           {filteredSectors.map(sector => {[39m
[31m+             const Icon = getIconComponent(sector.iconName); const metrics = sectorMetrics[sector.id]; const isSelected = sector.id === selectedSectorId;[39m
[31m+             return <div key={sector.id} onClick={() => setSelectedSectorId(sector.id === selectedSectorId ? null : sector.id)} className={`flex h-44 cursor-pointer flex-col justify-between rounded-md border bg-white p-3 text-left transition-colors ${isSelected ? 'border-[#0f6cbd] bg-[#eff6fc]' : 'border-[#e1dfdd] hover:border-[#c8c6c4]'}`}>[39m
[31m+               <div><div className="flex items-start justify-between"><div className="rounded bg-[#f3f2f1] p-1.5 text-[#605e5c]"><Icon className="h-4 w-4" /></div>{metrics.count > 0 ? <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-medium ${metrics.avgTrust >= 90 ? 'text-[#0e700e]' : metrics.avgTrust >= 80 ? 'text-[#8a5700]' : 'text-[#a4262c]'}`}><span className={`h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${metrics.avgTrust >= 90 ? 'bg-[#0e700e]' : metrics.avgTrust >= 80 ? 'bg-[#8a5700]' : 'bg-[#a4262c]'}`} />{metrics.avgTrust}% avg trust</span> : <span className="text-[11px] text-[#8a8886]">Empty sector</span>}</div><h3 className="mt-2.5 text-[13px] font-semibold text-[#201f1e]">{sector.name}</h3><p className="mt-1 line-clamp-2 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-[#8a8886]">{sector.description}</p></div>[39m
[31m+               <div className="mt-2.5 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-[#f3f2f1] pt-2 text-[11px] text-[#605e5c]"><div className="flex gap-3"><span>Passports <strong className="font-semibold text-[#323130]">{metrics.count}</strong></span>{metrics.count > 0 && <span>Findings <strong className={`font-semibold ${metrics.totalCves > 0 ? 'text-[#a4262c]' : 'text-[#0e700e]'}`}>{metrics.totalCves}</strong></span>}</div><span className="flex items-center gap-0.5 font-medium text-[#0f6cbd]"><span>Analyze</span><ChevronRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></span></div>[39m
[31m+             </div>;[39m
[31m+           })}[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+         {selectedSector && selectedMetrics && <div className="sticky top-4 space-y-4 rounded-md border border-[#e1dfdd] bg-white p-4 text-left lg:col-span-5">[39m
[31m+           <div className="flex items-start justify-between"><div className="flex items-center gap-2.5"><div className="rounded bg-[#eff6fc] p-2 text-[#0f6cbd]">{React.createElement(getIconComponent(selectedSector.iconName), { className: 'w-4 h-4' })}</div><div><h3 className="text-[14px] font-semibold text-[#201f1e]">{selectedSector.name}</h3><span className="text-[11px] text-[#8a8886]">Sector ID: {selectedSector.id}</span></div></div><button onClick={() => setSelectedSectorId(null)} className="rounded p-1 text-[#8a8886] hover:bg-black/[.03] hover:text-[#605e5c]" title="Close analysis"><X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></button></div>[39m
[31m+           <p className="rounded-md border border-[#e1dfdd] bg-[#faf9f8] p-3 text-[12px] leading-relaxed text-[#605e5c]">{selectedSector.description}</p>[39m
[31m+           <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2"><div className="rounded border border-[#e1dfdd] bg-[#faf9f8] p-2"><span className="block text-[11px] text-[#8a8886]">Active passports</span><span className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-[#323130]">{selectedMetrics.count} monitored</span></div><div className="rounded border border-[#e1dfdd] bg-[#faf9f8] p-2"><span className="block text-[11px] text-[#8a8886]">Total dependencies</span><span className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-[#323130]">{selectedMetrics.totalSboms} SBOM nodes</span></div></div>[39m
[31m+           <div className="space-y-3"><div><h4 className="flex items-center gap-1.5 border-b border-[#f3f2f1] pb-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-[#605e5c]"><ShieldAlert className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-[#0f6cbd]" /> Major threat vector</h4><p className="mt-1 text-[12px] leading-relaxed text-[#605e5c]">{selectedSector.threatProfile}</p></div><div><h4 className="flex items-center gap-1.5 border-b border-[#f3f2f1] pb-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-[#605e5c]"><Award className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-[#0f6cbd]" /> Sector compliance target</h4><p className="mt-1 text-[12px] font-medium leading-relaxed text-[#0f6cbd]">{selectedSector.complianceMandate}</p></div><div><h4 className="flex items-center gap-1.5 border-b border-[#f3f2f1] pb-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-[#605e5c]"><Settings className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-[#0f6cbd]" /> Security hardening blueprint</h4><p className="mt-1 rounded border border-[#e1dfdd] bg-[#eff6fc] p-2 text-[12px] leading-relaxed text-[#201f1e]">{selectedSector.hardeningBlueprint}</p></div></div>[39m
[31m+           <div className="space-y-2 border-t border-[#f3f2f1] pt-3"><span className="block text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-[#8a8886]">Verified passports in sector</span>{selectedMetrics.count === 0 ? <div className="space-y-2 rounded-md border border-dashed border-[#e1dfdd] bg-[#faf9f8] py-5 text-center"><p className="text-[12px] italic text-[#8a8886]">No software passports registered in this category.</p><button onClick={() => onFilterCategory(selectedSector.name)} className="h-8 rounded border border-[#c8c6c4] px-3 text-[12px] font-medium text-[#323130] hover:bg-black/[.03]">View empty catalog filter</button></div> : <div className="space-y-1.5">{selectedMetrics.matchedPassports.map(p => <div key={p.id} onClick={() => setSelectedPassportId(p.id)} className="flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-between rounded border border-[#e1dfdd] bg-[#faf9f8] p-2.5 hover:border-[#c8c6c4]"><div className="min-w-0"><h4 className="truncate text-[13px] font-medium text-[#201f1e]">{p.name}</h4><span className="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] text-[#8a8886]">Version {p.version} · {p.publisher}</span></div><div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2"><span className={`flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-full border text-[11px] font-semibold ${p.overallScore == null ? '—' : p.overallScore}</span><ChevronRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-[#8a8886]" /></div></div>)}</div>}</div>[39m
[31m+           <div className="border-t border-[#f3f2f1] pt-3"><button onClick={() => onFilterCategory(selectedSector.name)} className="flex h-9 w-full items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded bg-[#0f6cbd] px-3 text-[13px] font-medium text-white hover:bg-[#004578]"><Eye className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /><span>Filter catalog grid</span></button></div>[39m
[31m+         </div>}[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+       {showAddForm && <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40 p-4"><div className="w-full max-w-lg rounded-md border border-[#e1dfdd] bg-white p-5"><div [31m+       const openFindingEvidenceIds = (findingResult.rows ?? []).filter((row: any) => !['resolved','closed','verified'].includes(String(row.status || '').toLowerCase())).flatMap((row: any) => parseJson(row.evidence_ids)).filter((id: any): id is string => typeof id === 'string');[39m

[31m+   router.get('/user/verification', requireAuth, async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m
[31m+       const clientScope = req.user!.role === 'Client' ? (req.user as any).clientId : null;[39m
[31m+       const passportRows = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id, version, evidence, client_id AS "clientId" FROM passports WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND (${clientScope} IS NULL OR client_id=${clientScope}) ORDER BY id`) as any).rows ?? [];[39m
[31m+       const passportIds = passportRows.map((row: any) => String(row.id));[39m
[31m+       const parseJson = (value: unknown): unknown[] => { try { const parsed = JSON.parse(String(value ?? '')); return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : []; } catch { return []; } };[39m
[31m+       // Drizzle's proven one-query binding shape for the passport findings is[39m
[31m+       // `asset_id IN ${passportIds}`; do not replace this with ANY(array).[39m
[31m+       const findingRows = passportIds.length ? ((await db.execute(sql`SELECT id, passport_id AS "passportId", evidence_ids, status FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id IN ${passportIds}`) as any).rows ?? []) : [];[39m
[31m+       const evidenceByPassport = new Map<string, any[]>();[39m
[31m+       for (const passport of passportRows) evidenceByPassport.set(String(passport.id), parseJson(passport.evidence) as any[]);[39m
[31m+       const evaluatedAt = Date.now();[39m
[31m+       const verificationDecisions: Record<string, VerificationDecision> = {};[39m
[31m+       const verificationDetails: Record<string, unknown> = {};[39m
[31m+       for (const passport of passportRows) {[39m
[31m+         const findings = findingRows.filter((row: any) => String(row.passportId) === String(passport.id));[39m
[31m+         const openFindingEvidenceIds = findings.filter((row: any) => !['resolved','closed','verified'].includes(String(row.status || '').toLowerCase())).flatMap((row: any) => parseJson(row.evidence_ids)).filter((id: any): id is string => typeof id === 'string');[39m
[31m+         const adapted = adaptEvidenceForEvaluation({ evidence: evidenceByPassport.get(String(passport.id)) ?? [], passportVersion: passport.version, openFindingEvidenceIds });[39m
[31m+         const decision = evaluateVerification({ evidence: adapted.evidence, evaluatedAt, targetIdentity: adapted.targetIdentity });[39m
[31m+         verificationDecisions[String(passport.id)] = decision;[39m
[31m+         verificationDetails[String(passport.id)] = { unmappedCount: adapted.unmappedCount, undatedCount: adapted.undatedCount, observations: decision.observationCount, independentSources: decision.independentSourceCount };[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'private, max-age=0, no-store');[39m
[31m+       return res.json({ verificationDecisions, verificationDetails });[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) { return next(error); }[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return router;[39m

[31m+   title: z.string().trim().min(1).max(255),[39m
[31m+   description: z.string().max(4000).optional(),[39m
[31m+   assigneeId: z.string().max(255).optional(),[39m
[31m+   assigneeDisplay: z.string().max(255).optional(),[39m
[31m+   externalSystem: z.string().trim().min(1).max(64).default('SPR'),[39m
[31m+   externalTicketId: z.string().max(255).optional(),[39m
[31m+   slaDueAt: z.string().datetime().optional(),[39m
[31m+   priority: z.enum(['LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH', 'CRITICAL']).default('HIGH'),[39m
[31m+ }).strict();[39m
[31m+ const remediationUpdateSchema = z.object({ status: z.enum(['OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'BLOCKED', 'READY_FOR_VERIFICATION', 'VERIFIED', 'CLOSED', 'CANCELLED']), ownerId: z.string().max(255).optional(), ownerDisplay: z.string().max(255).optional(), slaDueAt: z.string().datetime().nullable().optional() }).strict();[39m
[31m+ const verifySchema = z.object({ findingId: z.string().trim().min(1), observationIds: z.array(z.string().min(1)).max(50), evidenceIds: z.array(z.string().min(1)).max(200) }).strict();[39m
[31m+ const reportTypes = z.enum(['executive', 'technical', 'msp', 'customer', 'compliance', 'vendor', 'auditor', 'evidence-ledger']);[39m
[31m+ function id(prefix: string) { return `${prefix}_${crypto.randomUUID().replaceAll('-', '')}`; }[39m
[31m+ function parseJson(value: unknown, fallback: unknown = []) { try { return value ? JSON.parse(String(value)) : fallback; } catch { return fallback; } }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ const SEVERITY_ORDER = ['critical', 'high', 'medium', 'low'];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ export type ReportPassportRow = {[39m
[31m+   overall_score: number | null;[39m
[31m+   security_score: number | null;[39m
[31m+   compliance_score: number | null;[39m
[31m+   verification_status: string | null;[39m
[31m+   confidence_score: number | null;[39m
[31m+   evidence_completeness: number | null;[39m
[31m+ };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ export function deriveReportRiskFields(passport: ReportPassportRow) {[39m
[31m+   const verificationStatus = passport.verification_status || 'unverified';[39m
[31m+   const isMeasured = verificationStatus !== 'unverified';[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     canonicalScore: isMeasured ? passport.overall_score : null,[39m
[31m+     verificationStatus,[39m
[31m+     confidenceBasisPoints: isMeasured && passport.confidence_score != null ? Math.round(passport.confidence_score * 100) : null,[39m
[31m+     completenessBasisPoints: isMeasured && passport.evidence_completeness != null ? Math.round(passport.evidence_completeness * 100) : null,[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function buildReportTypeExtras(reportType: string, passport: any, findings: any[]) {[39m
[31m+   if (reportType === 'sbom') {[39m
[31m+     const components = parseJson(passport.sbom, []) as any[];[39m
[31m+     const vulnerabilities = parseJson(passport.vulnerabilities, []) as any[];[39m
[31m+     const sbom = components.map((component) => {[39m
[31m+       const name = component?.name || component?.packageName || component?.component;[39m
[31m+       const matched = vulnerabilities.filter((vuln) => (vuln?.component || vuln?.packageName || vuln?.package) === name);[39m
[31m+       return { ...component, vulnerabilityCount: matched.length, criticalOrHighCount: matched.filter((vuln) => SEVERITY_ORDER.slice(0, 2).includes(String(vuln?.severity || '').toLowerCase())).length };[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     return { sbom };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (reportType === 'compliance') {[39m
[31m+     const byControl = new Map<string, { controlId: string; findingCount: number; openCount: number; worstSeverity: string; findingIds: string[] }>();[39m
[31m+     for (const finding of findings) {[39m
[31m+       const controlId = finding.control_id || 'unmapped';[39m
[31m+       const entry = byControl.get(controlId) || { controlId, findingCount: 0, openCount: 0, worstSeverity: 'low', findingIds: [] as string[] };[39m
[31m+       entry.findingCount += 1;[39m
[31m+       entry.findingIds.push(finding.id);[39m
[31m+       if (!['resolved', 'closed', 'verified'].includes(String(finding.status || '').toLowerCase())) entry.openCount += 1;[39m
[31m+       const severity = String(finding.severity || '').toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+       if (SEVERITY_ORDER.includes(severity) && SEVERITY_ORDER.indexOf(severity) < SEVERITY_ORDER.indexOf(entry.worstSeverity)) entry.worstSeverity = severity;[39m
[31m+       byControl.set(controlId, entry);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return { controls: [...byControl.values()] };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return {};[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export function createTrustLoopRouter() {[39m
[31m+   const router = Router();[39m

[31m+   router.post('/collect', async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     const parsed = collectSchema.safeParse(req.body);[39m
[31m+     if (!parsed.success) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'INVALID_PAYLOAD', details: parsed.error.flatten() });[39m
[31m+     const { passportId, provider } = parsed.data;[39m
[31m+     const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m
[31m+     const runId = id('collect');[39m
[31m+     const startedAt = new Date().toISOString();[39m
[31m+     const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const passport = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,client_id FROM passports WHERE id=${passportId} AND tenant_id=${tenantId} LIMIT 1`) as any).rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+       if (!passport) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'PASSPORT_NOT_FOUND' });[39m
[31m+       const stored = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT encrypted_payload FROM integration_credentials WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND provider=${provider} LIMIT 1`) as any).rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+       if (!stored?.encrypted_payload) return res.status(409).json({ error: 'CREDENTIAL_NOT_CONFIGURED' });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       await db.execute(sql`INSERT INTO trust_collection_runs (id,tenant_id,passport_id,provider,started_at,status,idempotency_key,created_at) VALUES (${runId},${tenantId},${passportId},${provider},${startedAt},'RUNNING',${`${tenantId}:${passportId}:${provider}:${startedAt}`},${startedAt})`);[39m
[31m+       const credentials = decryptCredentials(stored.encrypted_payload) as Record<string, string>;[39m
[31m+       const observations = provider === 'github' ? await collectGitHubDeepEvidence(credentials) : await collectDeepProviderEvidence(provider as any, credentials);[39m
[31m+       const result = await persistTrustLoop({ tenantId, passportId, clientId: passport.client_id || passport.id, assetId: passport.id, observations, generationReason: 'provider_collection', actorType: 'worker', collectorVersionMap: { [provider]: 'deep-v2' } });[39m
[31m+       const completedAt = new Date().toISOString();[39m
[31m+       await db.execute(sql`UPDATE trust_collection_runs SET completed_at=${completedAt},status='SUCCEEDED',observation_count=${observations.length},evidence_count=${result.evidenceIds.length},failure_count=${observations.filter((o) => o.status === 'FAIL').length},collector_version='deep-v2' WHERE id=${runId} AND tenant_id=${tenantId}`);[39m
[31m+       await db.execute(sql`INSERT INTO trust_monitoring_state (id,tenant_id,passport_id,provider,next_run_at,last_run_at,last_success_at,last_evidence_hash,consecutive_failures,status,updated_at) VALUES (${id('monitor')},${tenantId},${passportId},${provider},${new Date(Date.now()+3600000).toISOString()},${completedAt},${completedAt},${result.payloadHash},0,'HEALTHY',${completedAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,passport_id,provider) DO UPDATE SET next_run_at=EXCLUDED.next_run_at,last_run_at=EXCLUDED.last_run_at,last_success_at=EXCLUDED.last_success_at,last_evidence_hash=EXCLUDED.last_evidence_hash,consecutive_failures=0,status='HEALTHY',updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at`);[39m
[31m+       return res.json({ runId, provider, observationCount: observations.length, ...result });[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+       const completedAt = new Date().toISOString();[39m
[31m+       await db.execute(sql`UPDATE trust_collection_runs SET completed_at=${completedAt},status='FAILED',error_code='COLLECTION_FAILED',error_message=${error instanceof Error ? error.message.slice(0,1000) : 'COLLECTION_FAILED'} WHERE id=${runId} AND tenant_id=${tenantId}`).catch(() => undefined);[39m
[31m+       await db.execute(sql`UPDATE trust_monitoring_state SET last_run_at=${completedAt},last_failure_at=${completedAt},consecutive_failures=consecutive_failures+1,status=CASE WHEN consecutive_failures+1 >= 5 THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'DEGRADED' END,updated_at=${completedAt} WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} AND provider=${provider}`).catch(() => undefined);[39m
[31m+       return next(error);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const findingsWithRemediationSelect = sql`[39m
[31m+     SELECT f.*, r.id AS remediation_id, r.status AS remediation_status, r.owner_id AS remediation_owner_id,[39m
[31m+            r.owner_display AS remediation_owner_display, r.sla_due_at AS remediation_sla_due_at, r.updated_at AS remediation_updated_at[39m
[31m+     FROM trust_findings f[39m
[31m+     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ([39m
[31m+       SELECT * FROM trust_remediation_work_items w[39m
[31m+       WHERE w.tenant_id = f.tenant_id AND w.finding_id = f.id[39m
[31m+       ORDER BY w.created_at DESC LIMIT 1[39m
[31m+     ) r ON true[39m
[31m+   `;[39m
[31m+   router.get('/findings', async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m

[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m

[31m+       const passportId = typeof req.query.passportId === 'string' ? req.query.passportId : null;[39m

[31m+         : await db.execute(sql`${findingsWithRemediationSelect} WHERE f.tenant_id=${tenantId} ORDER BY f.updated_at DESC`);[39m
[31m+       return res.json({ findings: (rows as any).rows || [] });[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) { return next(error); }[39m

[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m

[31m+       const evidenceIds: string[] = parseJson(latestObservation.evidence_ids, []) as string[];[39m
[31m+       const result = await verifyRemediation({ tenantId, findingId: work.finding_id, observationIds: [latestObservation.id], evidenceIds, actorId: req.user!.uid });[39m
[31m+       const now = new Date().toISOString();[39m
[31m+       await db.execute(sql`UPDATE trust_remediation_work_items SET status='VERIFIED',updated_at=${now},closed_at=${now} WHERE id=${work.id} AND tenant_id=${tenantId}`);[39m
[31m+       const row = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM trust_remediation_work_items WHERE id=${work.id} AND tenant_id=${tenantId} LIMIT 1`) as any).rows?.[0];[39m

[31m+       const payload = parseJson(row.payload, {});[39m

[31m+ export async function buildAndPersistReport(db: any, tenantId: string, passportId: string, reportType: string) {[39m
[31m+   const passport = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,name,overall_score,security_score,compliance_score,verification_status,confidence_score,evidence_completeness,sbom,evidence,vulnerabilities,timeline FROM passports WHERE id=${passportId} AND tenant_id=${tenantId} LIMIT 1`) as any).rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+   if (!passport) return null;[39m
[31m+   const findings = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,control_id,title,severity,status,description,remediation,evidence_ids,updated_at,resolved_at FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'low' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END,updated_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const evidence = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,provider,control_id,subject,source_url,observed_at,verification_method,status,severity,evidence_hash,limitation FROM evidence_ledger WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY observed_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const observations = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,observation_version,generated_at,previous_observation_id,evidence_ids,finding_ids,canonical_payload_hash,completeness_basis_points,confidence_basis_points,open_finding_count,unknown_dimension_count FROM trust_observations WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY observation_version DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const remediation = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM trust_remediation_work_items WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const verification = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM remediation_verification_ledger WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND finding_id IN (SELECT id FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId}) ORDER BY created_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const latest = observations[0];[39m
[31m+   const risk = deriveReportRiskFields(passport as ReportPassportRow);[39m
[31m+   const report = {[39m
[31m+     schemaVersion: 'spr.report.v2', reportType, generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(), passport: { id: passport.id, name: passport.name },[39m
[31m+     risk: { overall: risk.canonicalScore, security: passport.security_score, compliance: passport.compliance_score, verificationStatus: risk.verificationStatus },[39m
[31m+     evidenceQuality: { completenessBasisPoints: risk.completenessBasisPoints, confidenceBasisPoints: risk.confidenceBasisPoints, unknownDimensions: latest?.unknown_dimension_count ?? 0, latestObservationAt: latest?.generated_at ?? null },[39m
[31m+     findings, evidence, observations, remediation, verification,[39m
[31m+     traceability: 'Report -> Passport -> Risk -> Finding -> Observation -> Provider -> Source -> Timestamp -> Hash',[39m
[31m+     resolutionTraceability: 'Finding -> remediation -> new observation -> independent verification',[39m
[31m+     limitations: evidence.filter((item: any) => item.limitation).map((item: any) => ({ evidenceId: item.id, limitation: item.limitation })),[39m
[31m+     ...buildReportTypeExtras(reportType, passport, findings),[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+   const canonicalPayload = JSON.stringify(report);[39m
[31m+   const reportHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalPayload).digest('hex');[39m
[31m+   await db.execute(sql`INSERT INTO trust_report_snapshots (id,tenant_id,passport_id,report_type,generated_at,score,confidence_basis_points,completeness_basis_points,evidence_ids,finding_ids,observation_id,canonical_payload_hash,payload,created_at) VALUES (${id('report')},${tenantId},${passportId},${reportType},${report.generatedAt},${risk.canonicalScore},${risk.confidenceBasisPoints},${risk.completenessBasisPoints},${JSON.stringify(evidence.map((item: any) => item.id))},${JSON.stringify(findings.map((item: any) => item.id))},${latest?.id ?? null},${reportHash},${canonicalPayload},${report.generatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,passport_id,report_type,canonical_payload_hash) DO NOTHING`);[39m
[31m+   return { ...report, reportHash };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export function deriveReportRiskFields(passport: ReportPassportRow) {[39m
[31m+   const verificationStatus = passport.verification_status || 'unverified';[39m
[31m+   const isMeasured = verificationStatus !== 'unverified';[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     canonicalScore: isMeasured ? passport.overall_score : null,[39m
[31m+     verificationStatus,[39m
[31m+     confidenceBasisPoints: isMeasured && passport.confidence_score != null ? Math.round(passport.confidence_score * 100) : null,[39m
[31m+     completenessBasisPoints: isMeasured && passport.evidence_completeness != null ? Math.round(passport.evidence_completeness * 100) : null,[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function buildReportTypeExtras(reportType: string, passport: any, findings: any[]) {[39m
[31m+   if (reportType === 'sbom') {[39m
[31m+     const components = parseJson(passport.sbom, []) as any[];[39m
[31m+     const vulnerabilities = parseJson(passport.vulnerabilities, []) as any[];[39m
[31m+     const sbom = components.map((component) => {[39m
[31m+       const name = component?.name || component?.packageName || component?.component;[39m
[31m+       const matched = vulnerabilities.filter((vuln) => (vuln?.component || vuln?.packageName || vuln?.package) === name);[39m
[31m+       return { ...component, vulnerabilityCount: matched.length, criticalOrHighCount: matched.filter((vuln) => SEVERITY_ORDER.slice(0, 2).includes(String(vuln?.severity || '').toLowerCase())).length };[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     return { sbom };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (reportType === 'compliance') {[39m
[31m+     const byControl = new Map<string, { controlId: string; findingCount: number; openCount: number; worstSeverity: string; findingIds: string[] }>();[39m
[31m+     for (const finding of findings) {[39m
[31m+       const controlId = finding.control_id || 'unmapped';[39m
[31m+       const entry = byControl.get(controlId) || { controlId, findingCount: 0, openCount: 0, worstSeverity: 'low', findingIds: [] as string[] };[39m
[31m+       entry.findingCount += 1;[39m
[31m+       entry.findingIds.push(finding.id);[39m
[31m+       if (!['resolved', 'closed', 'verified'].includes(String(finding.status || '').toLowerCase())) entry.openCount += 1;[39m
[31m+       const severity = String(finding.severity || '').toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+       if (SEVERITY_ORDER.includes(severity) && SEVERITY_ORDER.indexOf(severity) < SEVERITY_ORDER.indexOf(entry.worstSeverity)) entry.worstSeverity = severity;[39m
[31m+       byControl.set(controlId, entry);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return { controls: [...byControl.values()] };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return {};[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export async function buildAndPersistReport(db: any, tenantId: string, passportId: string, reportType: string) {[39m
[31m+   const passport = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,name,overall_score,security_score,compliance_score,verification_status,confidence_score,evidence_completeness,sbom,evidence,vulnerabilities,timeline FROM passports WHERE id=${passportId} AND tenant_id=${tenantId} LIMIT 1`) as any).rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+   if (!passport) return null;[39m
[31m+   const findings = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,control_id,title,severity,status,description,remediation,evidence_ids,updated_at,resolved_at FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'low' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END,updated_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const evidence = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,provider,control_id,subject,source_url,observed_at,verification_method,status,severity,evidence_hash,limitation FROM evidence_ledger WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY observed_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const observations = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,observation_version,generated_at,previous_observation_id,evidence_ids,finding_ids,canonical_payload_hash,completeness_basis_points,confidence_basis_points,open_finding_count,unknown_dimension_count FROM trust_observations WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY observation_version DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const remediation = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM trust_remediation_work_items WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const verification = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM remediation_verification_ledger WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND finding_id IN (SELECT id FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId}) ORDER BY created_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const latest = observations[0];[39m
[31m+   const risk = deriveReportRiskFields(passport as ReportPassportRow);[39m
[31m+   const report = {[39m
[31m+     schemaVersion: 'spr.report.v2', reportType, generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(), passport: { id: passport.id, name: passport.name },[39m
[31m+     risk: { overall: risk.canonicalScore, security: passport.security_score, compliance: passport.compliance_score, verificationStatus: risk.verificationStatus },[39m
[31m+     evidenceQuality: { completenessBasisPoints: risk.completenessBasisPoints, confidenceBasisPoints: risk.confidenceBasisPoints, unknownDimensions: latest?.unknown_dimension_count ?? 0, latestObservationAt: latest?.generated_at ?? null },[39m
[31m+     findings, evidence, observations, remediation, verification,[39m
[31m+     traceability: 'Report -> Passport -> Risk -> Finding -> Observation -> Provider -> Source -> Timestamp -> Hash',[39m
[31m+     resolutionTraceability: 'Finding -> remediation -> new observation -> independent verification',[39m
[31m+     limitations: evidence.filter((item: any) => item.limitation).map((item: any) => ({ evidenceId: item.id, limitation: item.limitation })),[39m
[31m+     ...buildReportTypeExtras(reportType, passport, findings),[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+   const canonicalPayload = JSON.stringify(report);[39m
[31m+   const reportHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalPayload).digest('hex');[39m
[31m+   await db.execute(sql`INSERT INTO trust_report_snapshots (id,tenant_id,passport_id,report_type,generated_at,score,confidence_basis_points,completeness_basis_points,evidence_ids,finding_ids,observation_id,canonical_payload_hash,payload,created_at) VALUES (${id('report')},${tenantId},${passportId},${reportType},${report.generatedAt},${risk.canonicalScore},${risk.confidenceBasisPoints},${risk.completenessBasisPoints},${JSON.stringify(evidence.map((item: any) => item.id))},${JSON.stringify(findings.map((item: any) => item.id))},${latest?.id ?? null},${reportHash},${canonicalPayload},${report.generatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,passport_id,report_type,canonical_payload_hash) DO NOTHING`);[39m
[31m+   return { ...report, reportHash };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+   clients: Client[];[39m
[31m+   alerts: Alert[];[39m
[31m+   findings: any[];[39m
[31m+   role?: string;[39m
[31m+   onSelectClient: (id: string) => void;[39m
[31m+   onSelectPassport?: (passportId: string) => void;[39m
[31m+   onNavigate: (tab: string) => void;[39m
[31m+   verificationDecisions?: Record<string, VerificationDecision>;[39m
[31m+   verificationDetails?: Record<string, unknown>;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type Assignment = { id: string; client_id: string; technician_display: string; assigned_by: string; updated_at: string };[39m
[31m+ type TeamMember = { id: number; email: string; displayName?: string | null; role: string };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ const severityClass = (severity: Alert['severity']) => severity === 'Critical'[39m
[31m+   ? 'border-[#a4262c]/30 bg-[#fdf2f2] text-[#a4262c]'[39m
[31m+   : severity === 'High' ? 'border-[#8a5700]/30 bg-[#fff4ce] text-[#8a5700]'[39m
[31m+   : 'border-[#0f6cbd]/30 bg-[#eff6fc] text-[#0f6cbd]';[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ export default function MSPCommandCenter({ clients, alerts, findings, role = 'Viewer', onSelectClient, onNavigate, onSelectPassport, verificationDecisions = {}, verificationDetails = {} }: Props) {[39m
[31m+   const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Alert | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [assignments, setAssignments] = useState<Assignment[]>([]);[39m
[31m+   const [team, setTeam] = useState<TeamMember[]>([]);[39m
[31m+   const [assigningClientId, setAssigningClientId] = useState<string | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const canAssign = role === 'Owner' || role === 'Admin';[39m
[31m+   const trustStateFromDecision = (decision?: VerificationDecision) => decision?.state ?? 'UNINITIALIZED';[39m
[31m+   const trustStateForPassportItem = (item: { passportId: string }) => trustStateFromDecision(verificationDecisions?.[item.passportId]);[39m
[31m+   const selectPassport = (passportId: string) => { onSelectPassport?.(passportId); };[39m
[31m+   const passportDecision = (passport: { id: string }) => { const decision = verificationDecisions?.[passport.id]; return decision; };[39m
[31m+   void verificationDetails;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const loadAssignments = () => { apiFetch('/api/msp/assignments').then((r) => r.ok ? r.json() : null).then((data) => { if (Array.isArray(data?.assignments)) setAssignments(data.assignments); }).catch(() => {}); };[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => { loadAssignments(); apiFetch('/api/organization/team').then((r) => r.ok ? r.json() : null).then((data) => { if (Array.isArray(data)) setTeam(data); }).catch(() => {}); }, []);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const assignmentByClient = useMemo(() => new Map(assignments.map((a) => [a.client_id, a])), [assignments]);[39m
[31m+   const assignTechnician = async (clientId: string, member: TeamMember) => {[39m
[31m+     const response = await apiFetch('/api/msp/assignments', { method: 'PUT', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ clientId, technicianUserId: member.id, technicianDisplay: member.displayName || member.email }) });[39m
[31m+     if (response.ok) { loadAssignments(); setAssigningClientId(null); }[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+   const unassignTechnician = async (clientId: string) => {[39m
[31m+     const response = await apiFetch(`/api/msp/assignments/${encodeURIComponent(clientId)}`, { method: 'DELETE' });[39m
[31m+     if (response.ok) loadAssignments();[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const clientRiskRollup = useMemo(() => clients.map((client) => {[39m
[31m+     const clientAlerts = alerts.filter((a) => a.clientName === client.name);[39m
[31m+     const active = clientAlerts.filter((a) => a.status !== 'Resolved' && a.status !== 'Cancelled');[39m
[31m+     const critical = active.filter((a) => a.severity === 'Critical').length;[39m
[31m+     const high = active.filter((a) => a.severity === 'High').length;[39m
[31m+     return { client, activeCount: active.length, critical, high, assignment: assignmentByClient.get(client.id) };[39m
[31m+   }).sort((a, b) => (b.critical - a.critical) || (b.high - a.high) || (b.activeCount - a.activeCount)), [clients, alerts, assignmentByClient]);[39m
[31m+   // Sourced from the same /api/trust-loop/findings data App.tsx already fetched[39m
[31m+   // to build `alerts` -- no second network round trip for finding detail.[39m
[31m+   const finding = useMemo(() => selected ? findings.find((item: any) => String(item.id) === selected.id) || null : null, [selected?.id, findings]);[39m
[31m+   const findingError = selected && !finding ? 'Finding details are unavailable.' : null;[39m
[31m+   const [task, setTask] = useState<any | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [taskLoading, setTaskLoading] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const [taskError, setTaskError] = useState<string | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const attention = useMemo(() => alerts.filter(item => item.status === 'Active').sort((a, b) => {[39m
[31m+     const rank = { Critical: 3, High: 2, Medium: 1, Low: 0 };[39m
[31m+     return rank[b.severity] - rank[a.severity];[39m
[31m+   }), [alerts]);[39m
[31m+   const criticalClients = new Set(attention.filter(item => item.severity === 'Critical').map(item => item.clientName)).size;[39m
[31m+   const attentionClients = new Set(attention.filter(item => item.severity !== 'Critical').map(item => item.clientName)).size;[39m
[31m+   // A remediation may already exist for this finding (created from the Alerts[39m
[31m+   // view via the same /api/trust-loop/remediations backend) -- load it by the[39m
[31m+   // id the findings join already gives us instead of scanning a task list.[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     setTask(null); setTaskError(null);[39m
[31m+     if (!selected?.remediationId) return;[39m
[31m+     let cancelled = false;[39m
[31m+     apiFetch(`/api/trust-loop/remediations/${encodeURIComponent(selected.remediationId)}`).then(response => response.ok ? response.json() : null).then(data => { if (!cancelled && data) setTask(data); }).catch(() => {});[39m
[31m+     return () => { cancelled = true; };[39m
[31m+   }, [selected?.id, selected?.remediationId]);[39m
[31m+   const createTask = async () => {[39m
[31m+     if (!selected || !finding || taskLoading) return;[39m
[31m+     setTaskLoading(true); setTaskError(null);[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const response = await apiFetch('/api/trust-loop/remediations', {[39m
[31m+         method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },[39m
[31m+         body: JSON.stringify({ findingId: selected.id, title: selected.title, description: selected.description, priority: selected.severity.toUpperCase() }),[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+       const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));[39m
[31m+       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(body?.error || 'SPR could not create the remediation task.');[39m
[31m+       setTask(body);[39m
[31m+     } catch (cause: any) { setTaskError(cause?.message || 'SPR could not create the remediation task.'); }[39m
[31m+     finally { setTaskLoading(false); }[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+   const transitionTask = async (status: 'IN_PROGRESS' | 'READY_FOR_VERIFICATION') => {[39m
[31m+     if (!task || taskLoading) return;[39m
[31m+     setTaskLoading(true); setTaskError(null);[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const response = await apiFetch(`/api/trust-loop/remediations/${encodeURIComponent(task.id)}`, { method: 'PATCH', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ status }) });[39m
[31m+       const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));[39m
[31m+       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(body?.error || 'SPR could not update the task.');[39m
[31m+       setTask(body);[39m
[31m+     } catch (cause: any) { setTaskError(cause?.message || 'SPR could not update the task.'); }[39m
[31m+     finally { setTaskLoading(false); }[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+   // Re-verifies against the most recent trust_observation SPR already has on[39m
[31m+   // file for this software -- there is no live "run a check now" job queue,[39m
[31m+   // so this is honestly a re-check of existing evidence, not a fresh scan.[39m
[31m+   const verifyWithLatestEvidence = async () => {[39m
[31m+     if (!task || taskLoading) return;[39m
[31m+     setTaskLoading(true); setTaskError(null);[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const response = await apiFetch(`/api/trust-loop/remediations/${encodeURIComponent(task.id)}/verify-latest`, { method: 'POST' });[39m
[31m+       const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));[39m
[31m+       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(body?.error || 'SPR could not verify this task against current evidence.');[39m
[31m+       setTask(body);[39m
[31m+     } catch (cause: any) { setTaskError(cause?.message || 'SPR could not verify this task against current evidence.'); }[39m
[31m+     finally { setTaskLoading(false); }[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return <section id="msp-command-center" aria-labelledby="msp-command-center-title">[39m
[31m+     <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">[39m
[31m+       <div>[39m
[31m+         <h1 id="msp-command-center-title" className="text-[22px] font-semibold text-[#201f1e]">Who needs you today?</h1>[39m
[31m+         <p className="mt-1 text-[13px] text-[#605e5c]">Prioritized work from the evidence and findings SPR currently has on record. A closed task is not a verified fix.</p>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+       <button type="button" onClick={() => onNavigate('clients')} className="inline-flex h-8 items-center gap-1.5 rounded border border-[#c8c6c4] px-3 text-[13px] font-medium text-[#323130] hover:bg-black/[.03]">[39m
[31m+         View all clients <ArrowRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />[39m
[31m+       </button>[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap gap-6 rounded-md border border-[#e1dfdd] bg-white p-3">[39m
[31m+       <Metric label="Clients" value={clients.length} icon={<Building2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />} />[39m
[31m+       <Metric label="Healthy" value={Math.max(0, clients.length - criticalClients - attentionClients)} icon={<CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-[#0e700e]" />} />[39m
[31m+       <Metric label="Need attention" value={attentionClients} icon={<AlertTriangle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-[#8a5700]" />} />[39m
[31m+       <Metric label="Critical" value={criticalClients} icon={<ShieldAlert className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-[#a4262c]" />} />[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     <div className="mb-4 rounded-md border border-[#e1dfdd] bg-white">[39m
[31m+       <div className="border-b border-[#e1dfdd] px-4 py-3"><h2 className="text-[14px] font-semibold text-[#201f1e]">Cross-client risk</h2><p className="mt-0.5 text-[12px] text-[#605e5c]">Every client ranked by active critical and high findings, with technician assignment.</p></div>[39m
[31m+       <div className="overflow-x-auto">[39m
[31m+         <table className="w-full min-w-[640px] text-left text-[13px]">[39m
[31m+           <thead className="border-b border-[#e1dfdd] text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wide text-[#605e5c]"><tr><th className="px-4 py-2">Client</th><th className="px-4 py-2">Critical</th><th className="px-4 py-2">High</th><th className="px-4 py-2">Active findings</th><th className="px-4 py-2">Assigned technician</th></tr></thead>[39m
[31m+           <tbody>[39m
[31m+             {clientRiskRollup.map(({ client, activeCount, critical, high, assignment }) => ([39m
[31m+               <tr key={client.id} className="border-b border-[#f3f2f1] hover:bg-black/[.02]">[39m
[31m+                 <td className="px-4 py-2.5 font-medium text-[#201f1e]">{client.name}</td>[39m
[31m+                 <td className="px-4 py-2.5">{critical > 0 ? <span className="rounded border border-[#a4262c]/30 bg-[#fdf2f2] px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-[#a4262c]">{critical}</span> : <span className="text-[#8a8886]">0</span>}</td>[39m
[31m+                 <td className="px-4 py-2.5">{high > 0 ? <span className="rounded border border-[#8a5700]/30 bg-[#fff4ce] px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-[#8a5700]">{high}</span> : <span className="text-[#8a8886]">0</span>}</td>[39m
[31m+                 <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-[#323130]">{activeCount}</td>[39m
[31m+                 <td className="px-4 py-2.5">[39m
[31m+                   {assigningClientId === client.id ? ([39m
[31m+                     <select autoFocus onBlur={() => setAssigningClientId(null)} onChange={(e) => { const member = team.find((m) => String(m.id) === e.target.value); if (member) void assignTechnician(client.id, member); }} className="h-8 rounded border border-[#c8c6c4] bg-white px-2 text-[12px] text-[#201f1e] focus:border-[#0f6cbd] focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#0f6cbd]">[39m
[31m+                       <option value="">Select technician…</option>[39m
[31m+                       {team.map((member) => <option key={member.id} value={member.id}>{member.displayName || member.email}</option>)}[39m
[31m+                     </select>[39m
[31m+                   ) : assignment ? ([39m
[31m+                     <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[12px] text-[#323130]"><User className="h-3 w-3 text-[#8a8886]" />{assignment.technician_display}[39m
[31m+                       {canAssign && <button type="button" onClick={() => void unassignTechnician(client.id)} className="text-[#8a8886] hover:text-[#a4262c]">×</button>}[39m
[31m+                       {canAssign && <button type="button" onClick={() => setAssigningClientId(client.id)} className="text-[#0f6cbd] hover:text-[#004578]">change</button>}[39m
[31m+                     </div>[39m
[31m+                   ) : canAssign ? ([39m
[31m+                     <button type="button" onClick={() => setAssigningClientId(client.id)} className="rounded border border-[#c8c6c4] px-2 py-1 text-[12px] text-[#605e5c] hover:bg-black/[.03]">Assign…</button>[39m
[31m+                   ) : <span className="text-[12px] text-[#8a8886]">Unassigned</span>}[39m
[31m+                 </td>[39m
[31m+               </tr>[39m
[31m+             ))}[39m
[31m+           </tbody>[39m
[31m+         </table>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     <div className="rounded-md border border-[#e1dfdd] bg-white">[39m
[31m+       <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 border-b border-[#e1dfdd] px-4 py-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">[39m
[31m+         <div><h2 className="text-[14px] font-semibold text-[#201f1e]">Clients needing action</h2><p className="mt-0.5 text-[12px] text-[#605e5c]">Most urgent first, based on active recorded findings.</p></div>[39m
[31m+         <span className="w-fit rounded border border-[#c8c6c4] bg-[#faf9f8] px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-[#605e5c]">{attention.length} active findings</span>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+       {attention.length ? <div>[39m
[31m+         {attention.map(alert => {[39m
[31m+           const client = clients.find(item => item.name === alert.clientName);[39m
[31m+           return <article key={alert.id} className="grid gap-3 border-b border-[#f3f2f1] px-4 py-3 last:border-b-0 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(180px,0.8fr)_minmax(260px,1.5fr)_auto] lg:items-center">[39m
[31m+             <div>[39m
[31m+               <p className="font-medium text-[#201f1e]">{alert.clientName}</p>[39m
[31m+               <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-[#8a8886]">Observed {alert.timestamp}</p>[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+             <div>[39m
[31m+               <div className="mb-1.5 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5"><span className={`rounded border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold ${severityClass(alert.severity)}`}>{alert.severity}</span><span className="rounded bg-[#f3f2f1] px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] text-[#605e5c]">{alert.category}</span></div>[39m
[31m+               <p className="text-[13px] font-medium text-[#201f1e]">{alert.title}</p><p className="mt-0.5 text-[12px] leading-5 text-[#605e5c]">{alert.description}</p>[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m

[31m+ export function deriveReportRiskFields(passport: ReportPassportRow) {[39m
[31m+   const verificationStatus = passport.verification_status || 'unverified';[39m
[31m+   const isMeasured = verificationStatus !== 'unverified';[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     canonicalScore: isMeasured ? passport.overall_score : null,[39m
[31m+     verificationStatus,[39m
[31m+     confidenceBasisPoints: isMeasured && passport.confidence_score != null ? Math.round(passport.confidence_score * 100) : null,[39m
[31m+     completenessBasisPoints: isMeasured && passport.evidence_completeness != null ? Math.round(passport.evidence_completeness * 100) : null,[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function buildReportTypeExtras(reportType: string, passport: any, findings: any[]) {[39m
[31m+   if (reportType === 'sbom') {[39m
[31m+     const components = parseJson(passport.sbom, []) as any[];[39m
[31m+     const vulnerabilities = parseJson(passport.vulnerabilities, []) as any[];[39m
[31m+     const sbom = components.map((component) => {[39m
[31m+       const name = component?.name || component?.packageName || component?.component;[39m
[31m+       const matched = vulnerabilities.filter((vuln) => (vuln?.component || vuln?.packageName || vuln?.package) === name);[39m
[31m+       return { ...component, vulnerabilityCount: matched.length, criticalOrHighCount: matched.filter((vuln) => SEVERITY_ORDER.slice(0, 2).includes(String(vuln?.severity || '').toLowerCase())).length };[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     return { sbom };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (reportType === 'compliance') {[39m
[31m+     const byControl = new Map<string, { controlId: string; findingCount: number; openCount: number; worstSeverity: string; findingIds: string[] }>();[39m
[31m+     for (const finding of findings) {[39m
[31m+       const controlId = finding.control_id || 'unmapped';[39m
[31m+       const entry = byControl.get(controlId) || { controlId, findingCount: 0, openCount: 0, worstSeverity: 'low', findingIds: [] as string[] };[39m
[31m+       entry.findingCount += 1;[39m
[31m+       entry.findingIds.push(finding.id);[39m
[31m+       if (!['resolved', 'closed', 'verified'].includes(String(finding.status || '').toLowerCase())) entry.openCount += 1;[39m
[31m+       const severity = String(finding.severity || '').toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+       if (SEVERITY_ORDER.includes(severity) && SEVERITY_ORDER.indexOf(severity) < SEVERITY_ORDER.indexOf(entry.worstSeverity)) entry.worstSeverity = severity;[39m
[31m+       byControl.set(controlId, entry);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return { controls: [...byControl.values()] };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return {};[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export async function buildAndPersistReport(db: any, tenantId: string, passportId: string, reportType: string) {[39m
[31m+   const passport = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,name,overall_score,security_score,compliance_score,verification_status,confidence_score,evidence_completeness,sbom,evidence,vulnerabilities,timeline FROM passports WHERE id=${passportId} AND tenant_id=${tenantId} LIMIT 1`) as any).rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+   if (!passport) return null;[39m
[31m+   const findings = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,control_id,title,severity,status,description,remediation,evidence_ids,updated_at,resolved_at FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'low' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END,updated_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const evidence = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,provider,control_id,subject,source_url,observed_at,verification_method,status,severity,evidence_hash,limitation FROM evidence_ledger WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY observed_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const observations = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,observation_version,generated_at,previous_observation_id,evidence_ids,finding_ids,canonical_payload_hash,completeness_basis_points,confidence_basis_points,open_finding_count,unknown_dimension_count FROM trust_observations WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY observation_version DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const remediation = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM trust_remediation_work_items WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const verification = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM remediation_verification_ledger WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND finding_id IN (SELECT id FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId}) ORDER BY created_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const latest = observations[0];[39m
[31m+   const risk = deriveReportRiskFields(passport as ReportPassportRow);[39m
[31m+   const report = {[39m
[31m+     schemaVersion: 'spr.report.v2', reportType, generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(), passport: { id: passport.id, name: passport.name },[39m
[31m+     risk: { overall: risk.canonicalScore, security: passport.security_score, compliance: passport.compliance_score, verificationStatus: risk.verificationStatus },[39m
[31m+     evidenceQuality: { completenessBasisPoints: risk.completenessBasisPoints, confidenceBasisPoints: risk.confidenceBasisPoints, unknownDimensions: latest?.unknown_dimension_count ?? 0, latestObservationAt: latest?.generated_at ?? null },[39m
[31m+     findings, evidence, observations, remediation, verification,[39m
[31m+     traceability: 'Report -> Passport -> Risk -> Finding -> Observation -> Provider -> Source -> Timestamp -> Hash',[39m
[31m+     resolutionTraceability: 'Finding -> remediation -> new observation -> independent verification',[39m
[31m+     limitations: evidence.filter((item: any) => item.limitation).map((item: any) => ({ evidenceId: item.id, limitation: item.limitation })),[39m
[31m+     ...buildReportTypeExtras(reportType, passport, findings),[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+   const canonicalPayload = JSON.stringify(report);[39m
[31m+   const reportHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalPayload).digest('hex');[39m
[31m+   await db.execute(sql`INSERT INTO trust_report_snapshots (id,tenant_id,passport_id,report_type,generated_at,score,confidence_basis_points,completeness_basis_points,evidence_ids,finding_ids,observation_id,canonical_payload_hash,payload,created_at) VALUES (${id('report')},${tenantId},${passportId},${reportType},${report.generatedAt},${risk.canonicalScore},${risk.confidenceBasisPoints},${risk.completenessBasisPoints},${JSON.stringify(evidence.map((item: any) => item.id))},${JSON.stringify(findings.map((item: any) => item.id))},${latest?.id ?? null},${reportHash},${canonicalPayload},${report.generatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,passport_id,report_type,canonical_payload_hash) DO NOTHING`);[39m
[31m+   return { ...report, reportHash };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+   findings?: unknown[];[39m
[31m+   evidence?: unknown[];[39m
[31m+   observations?: unknown[];[39m
[31m+   remediation?: unknown[];[39m
[31m+   verification?: unknown[];[39m
[31m+   traceability?: string;[39m
[31m+   limitations?: Array<{ evidenceId?: string; limitation?: string }>;[39m
[31m+   reportHash?: string;[39m
[31m+   sbom?: Array<{ name?: string; version?: string; license?: string; vulnerabilityCount?: number; criticalOrHighCount?: number }>;[39m
[31m+   controls?: Array<{ controlId?: string; findingCount?: number; openCount?: number; worstSeverity?: string }>;[39m
[31m+ };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type ReportSnapshot = {[39m
[31m+   id: string;[39m
[31m+   report_type: string;[39m
[31m+   generated_at: string;[39m
[31m+   score: number;[39m
[31m+   completeness_basis_points: number;[39m
[31m+   canonical_payload_hash: string;[39m
[31m+ };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type ShareInfo = { shareUrl: string; expiresAt: string; reportType: string };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ const REPORT_TYPES: Array<{ value: string; label: string }> = [[39m
[31m+   { value: 'executive', label: 'Executive trust report' },[39m
[31m+   { value: 'technical', label: 'Technical / engineering' },[39m
[31m+   { value: 'compliance', label: 'Compliance (by control)' },[39m
[31m+   { value: 'sbom', label: 'SBOM report' },[39m
[31m+   { value: 'vendor', label: 'Vendor risk' },[39m
[31m+   { value: 'msp', label: 'MSP / client' },[39m
[31m+   { value: 'customer', label: 'Customer-facing' },[39m
[31m+   { value: 'auditor', label: 'Auditor' },[39m
[31m+   { value: 'evidence-ledger', label: 'Evidence ledger' },[39m
[31m+ ];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ const SHARE_ROLES = new Set(['Owner', 'Admin', 'Operator']);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ interface ReportsViewProps {[39m
[31m+   clients?: Client[];[39m
[31m+   passports?: SoftwarePassport[];[39m
[31m+   scans?: Scan[];[39m

[31m+   findings?: unknown[];[39m
