[31m+[39m
[31m+ function download(name: string, body: string, type: string) {[39m
[31m+   const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([body], { type }));[39m
[31m+   const link = document.createElement('a');[39m
[31m+   link.href = url;[39m
[31m+   link.download = name;[39m
[31m+   document.body.appendChild(link);[39m
[31m+   link.click();[39m
[31m+   link.remove();[39m
[31m+   URL.revokeObjectURL(url);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function csvCell(value: unknown) {[39m
[31m+   return `"${String(value ?? '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function clientName(passport: SoftwarePassport, clients: Client[]) {[39m
[31m+   const clientId = String((passport as SoftwarePassport & { clientId?: string }).clientId || '');[39m
[31m+   return clients.find((client) => client.id === clientId)?.name || 'Unassigned client';[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ export default function ReportsView({ clients = [], passports = [], scans = [], alerts = [], findings = [], role = 'Viewer' }: ReportsViewProps) {[39m
[31m+   const [selectedPassportId, setSelectedPassportId] = useState(passports[0]?.id || '');[39m
[31m+   const [reportType, setReportType] = useState('executive');[39m
[31m+   const [report, setReport] = useState<ReportPayload | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const [message, setMessage] = useState('');[39m
[31m+   const [history, setHistory] = useState<ReportSnapshot[]>([]);[39m
[31m+   const [historyLoading, setHistoryLoading] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const [shareInfo, setShareInfo] = useState<ShareInfo | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [sharing, setSharing] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const [shareMessage, setShareMessage] = useState('');[39m
[31m+   const [exportClientIds, setExportClientIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const [whiteLabelClientId, setWhiteLabelClientId] = useState(clients[0]?.id || '');[39m
[31m+   const [mspName, setMspName] = useState('');[39m
[31m+   const [brandColor, setBrandColor] = useState('#22d3ee');[39m
[31m+   const [reportTitle, setReportTitle] = useState('Software Trust & Compliance Ledger');[39m
[31m+   const [executiveSummary, setExecutiveSummary] = useState('');[39m
[31m+   const [logoBase64, setLogoBase64] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);[39m
[31m+   const [sections, setSections] = useState({ summary: true, metrics: true, inventory: true, compliance: true, signatures: true });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const canShare = SHARE_ROLES.has(role);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (!passports.some((passport) => passport.id === selectedPassportId)) {[39m
[31m+       setSelectedPassportId(passports[0]?.id || '');[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }, [passports, selectedPassportId]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (!clients.some((client) => client.id === whiteLabelClientId)) {[39m
[31m+       setWhiteLabelClientId(clients[0]?.id || '');[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }, [clients, whiteLabelClientId]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     setReport(null);[39m
[31m+     setHistory([]);[39m
[31m+     setShareInfo(null);[39m
[31m+     setShareMessage('');[39m
[31m+     setMessage('');[39m
[31m+   }, [selectedPassportId, reportType]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const selectedPassport = passports.find((passport) => passport.id === selectedPassportId);[39m
[31m+   const evidenceCount = passports.reduce((total, passport) => total + passport.evidence.length, 0);[39m
[31m+   const vulnerabilityCount = passports.reduce((total, passport) => total + passport.vulnerabilities.length, 0);[39m
[31m+   const findingCount = findings.length;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const loadHistory = async (passportId: string) => {[39m
[31m+     setHistoryLoading(true);[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const response = await apiFetch(`/api/trust-loop/reports/${encodeURIComponent(passportId)}/history?type=${encodeURIComponent(reportType)}`);[39m
[31m+       const payload = await response.json().catch(() => null);[39m
[31m+       if (response.ok) setHistory(Array.isArray(payload?.snapshots) ? payload.snapshots : []);[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setHistoryLoading(false);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const loadReport = async () => {[39m
[31m+     if (!selectedPassport) return;[39m
[31m+     setLoading(true);[39m
[31m+     setMessage('');[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const response = await apiFetch(`/api/trust-loop/reports/${encodeURIComponent(selectedPassport.id)}?type=${encodeURIComponent(reportType)}`);[39m
[31m+       const payload = await response.json().catch(() => null);[39m
[31m+       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(String(payload?.error || `Report request failed (${response.status})`));[39m
[31m+       setReport(payload as ReportPayload);[39m
[31m+       setMessage('Authoritative report loaded from the tenant-scoped trust report endpoint.');[39m
[31m+       void loadHistory(selectedPassport.id);[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+       setReport(null);[39m
[31m+       setMessage(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unable to load the report.');[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setLoading(false);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const loadSnapshot = async (snapshotId: string) => {[39m
[31m+     if (!selectedPassport) return;[39m
[31m+     setLoading(true);[39m
[31m+     setMessage('');[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const response = await apiFetch(`/api/trust-loop/reports/${encodeURIComponent(selectedPassport.id)}/history/${encodeURIComponent(snapshotId)}`);[39m
[31m+       const payload = await response.json().catch(() => null);[39m
[31m+       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(String(payload?.error || `Snapshot request failed (${response.status})`));[39m
[31m+       setReport(payload as ReportPayload);[39m
[31m+       setMessage('Loaded a historical snapshot of this report. Re-run "Load report" for the current state.');[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+       setMessage(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unable to load that snapshot.');[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setLoading(false);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const createShareLink = async () => {[39m
[31m+     if (!selectedPassport) return;[39m
[31m+     setSharing(true);[39m
[31m+     setShareMessage('');[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const response = await apiFetch(`/api/public/v1/reports/${encodeURIComponent(selectedPassport.id)}/token`, {[39m
[31m+         method: 'POST',[39m
[31m+         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },[39m
[31m+         body: JSON.stringify({ type: reportType }),[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+       const payload = await response.json().catch(() => null);[39m
[31m+       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(String(payload?.error || `Share link request failed (${response.status})`));[39m
[31m+       setShareInfo({ shareUrl: payload.shareUrl, expiresAt: payload.expiresAt, reportType: payload.reportType });[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+       setShareInfo(null);[39m
[31m+       setShareMessage(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unable to create a share link.');[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setSharing(false);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const copyShareLink = async () => {[39m
[31m+     if (!shareInfo) return;[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       await navigator.clipboard.writeText(shareInfo.shareUrl);[39m
[31m+       setShareMessage('Share link copied to clipboard.');[39m
[31m+     } catch {[39m
[31m+       setShareMessage('Copy failed — select and copy the link manually.');[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const downloadPdf = () => {[39m
[31m+     if (!selectedPassport) return;[39m
[31m+     generatePassportEvidenceReport(selectedPassport, 'SPR Reports Center', '#22d3ee');[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const exportReportJson = () => {[39m
[31m+     if (!report || !selectedPassport) return;[39m
[31m+     download(`spr-report-${selectedPassport.id}-${reportType}.json`, JSON.stringify(report, null, 2), 'application/json');[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const exportRegistryCsv = () => {[39m
[31m+     const clientFilter = exportClientIds.size > 0 ? exportClientIds : null;[39m
[31m+     const passportInScope = (passport: SoftwarePassport) => !clientFilter || clientFilter.has(String((passport as SoftwarePassport & { clientId?: string }).clientId || ''));[39m
[31m+     const scopedPassports = passports.filter(passportInScope);[39m
[31m+     const scopedClients = clientFilter ? clients.filter((client) => clientFilter.has(client.id)) : clients;[39m
[31m+     const rows = [[39m
[31m+       ['recordType', 'id', 'name', 'version', 'client', 'status', 'severity', 'observedAt'],[39m
[31m+       ...scopedPassports.map((passport) => ['passport', passport.id, passport.name, passport.version, clientName(passport, clients), 'registered', '', passport.releaseDate]),[39m
[31m+       ...scopedPassports.flatMap((passport) => passport.evidence.map((item: any) => ['evidence', item.id, item.name, '', clientName(passport, clients), item.status || item.verificationStatus, '', item.timestamp])),[39m
[31m+       ...scopedPassports.flatMap((passport) => passport.vulnerabilities.map((item: any) => ['vulnerability', item.id, item.title || item.id, item.component || '', clientName(passport, clients), item.status, item.severity, item.detectedAt || item.publishedDate])),[39m
[31m+       ...findings.filter((finding: any) => !clientFilter || clientFilter.has(String(finding.client_id || ''))).map((finding: any) => ['finding', finding.id, finding.title || finding.control_id, '', clients.find((client) => client.id === String(finding.client_id || ''))?.name || 'Unassigned client', finding.status, finding.severity, finding.updated_at]),[39m
[31m+       ...scans.filter((scan) => !clientFilter || scopedClients.some((client) => client.name === scan.clientName)).map((scan) => ['scan', scan.id, scan.targetName, '', scan.clientName, scan.status, '', scan.timestamp]),[39m
[31m+       ...alerts.filter((alert) => !clientFilter || scopedClients.some((client) => client.name === alert.clientName)).map((alert) => ['alert', alert.id, alert.title, '', alert.clientName, alert.status, alert.severity, alert.timestamp]),[39m
[31m+     ];[39m
[31m+     const suffix = clientFilter ? `-${scopedClients.length}-clients` : '';[39m
[31m+     download(`spr-registry-records${suffix}.csv`, rows.map((row) => row.map(csvCell).join(',')).join('\n'), 'text/csv;charset=utf-8');[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const toggleExportClient = (clientId: string) => {[39m
[31m+     setExportClientIds((current) => { const next = new Set(current); if (next.has(clientId)) next.delete(clientId); else next.add(clientId); return next; });[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const handleLogoUpload = (event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {[39m
[31m+     const file = event.target.files?.[0];[39m
[31m+     if (!file) return;[39m
[31m+     const reader = new FileReader();[39m
[31m+     reader.onload = () => setLogoBase64(typeof reader.result === 'string' ? reader.result : undefined);[39m
[31m+     reader.readAsDataURL(file);[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const generateWhiteLabelReport = () => {[39m
[31m+     const client = clients.find((item) => item.id === whiteLabelClientId);[39m
[31m+     if (!client || !mspName.trim()) return;[39m
[31m+     generateCoBrandedTrustReport(client, mspName.trim(), brandColor, reportTitle, 0, executiveSummary, logoBase64, sections.summary, sections.metrics, sections.inventory, sections.compliance, sections.signatures);[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const reportText = useMemo(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (!report) return '';[39m
[31m+     return [[39m
[31m+       `SPR ${report.reportType || reportType} report: ${report.passport?.name || selectedPassport?.name || 'Passport'}`,[39m
[31m+       `Generated: ${report.generatedAt || 'unknown'}`,[39m
[31m+       `Report hash: ${report.reportHash || 'not returned'}`,[39m
[31m+       `Evidence records: ${report.evidence?.length ?? 0}`,[39m
[31m+       `Findings: ${report.findings?.length ?? 0}`,[39m
[31m+       `Observations: ${report.observations?.length ?? 0}`,[39m
[31m+       `Remediation records: ${report.remediation?.length ?? 0}`,[39m
[31m+       `Traceability: ${report.traceability || 'not returned'}`,[39m
[31m+       ...(report.limitations || []).map((item) => `Limitation (${item.evidenceId || 'evidence'}): ${item.limitation || 'not specified'}`),[39m

[31m+           <h1 id="reports-title" className="text-[22px] font-semibold text-[#201f1e]">Reports center</h1>[39m
[31m+           <p className="mt-1 text-[13px] text-[#605e5c]">Evidence-backed exports and reports loaded from this tenant's existing APIs.</p>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+         <button onClick={() => window.print()} className="inline-flex h-8 items-center gap-1.5 rounded border border-[#c8c6c4] px-3 text-[13px] font-medium text-[#323130] hover:bg-black/[.03]"><Printer size={14} /> Print / save PDF</button>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <details className="mb-4 rounded-md border border-[#e1dfdd] bg-[#faf9f8] text-[13px]">[39m

[31m+         <div className="px-3 pb-3 text-[#605e5c]">[39m
[31m+           <p>Exports contain only records loaded from this tenant's existing APIs. No trust score, compliance claim, or finding is inferred in this view.</p>[39m
[31m+           <ol className="mt-1.5 list-decimal space-y-0.5 pl-4">[39m
[31m+             <li>Export a registry CSV, or select a passport and report type to load a server-generated report.</li>[39m
[31m+             <li>Download the loaded report as JSON/PDF, or create a signed, expiring share link.</li>[39m
[31m+             <li>Optionally generate a co-branded white-label PDF for one client.</li>[39m
[31m+           </ol>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       </details>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap gap-6 rounded-md border border-[#e1dfdd] bg-white p-3">[39m

[31m+           ['Clients', clients.length, 'Persisted client records'],[39m
[31m+           ['Passports', passports.length, 'Registered software identity'],[39m

[31m+           ['Findings / vulnerabilities', findingCount + vulnerabilityCount, 'Loaded finding and vulnerability records'],[39m
[31m+         ].map(([label, value, detail]) => ([39m

[31m+             <div className="text-[11px] text-[#605e5c]">{label}</div>[39m
[31m+             <div className="text-lg font-semibold text-[#201f1e]">{value}</div>[39m
[31m+             <div className="text-[11px] text-[#8a8886]">{detail}</div>[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         ))}[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m

[31m+           <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><ShieldCheck size={16} className="text-[#605e5c]" /><h2 className="text-[14px] font-semibold text-[#201f1e]">Tenant registry exports</h2></div>[39m
[31m+           <p className="mt-1 text-[13px] text-[#605e5c]">CSV includes the loaded client, passport, evidence, vulnerability, finding, scan, and alert records.</p>[39m

[31m+             <div className="mt-3 flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row">[39m

[31m+                 {!passports.length && <option value="">No passports loaded</option>}[39m

[31m+               </select>[39m
[31m+               <select value={reportType} onChange={(event) => setReportType(event.target.value)} className="h-9 min-w-0 flex-1 rounded border border-[#c8c6c4] bg-white px-3 text-[13px] text-[#201f1e] focus:border-[#0f6cbd] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#0f6cbd]">[39m
[31m+                 {REPORT_TYPES.map((type) => <option key={type.value} value={type.value}>{type.label}</option>)}[39m
[31m+               </select>[39m
[31m+               <button onClick={() => void loadReport()} disabled={!selectedPassport || loading} className="inline-flex h-9 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded border border-[#0f6cbd] bg-[#eff6fc] px-3 text-[13px] font-medium text-[#0f6cbd] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"><RefreshCw size={14} className={loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''} /> {loading ? 'Loading…' : 'Load report'}</button>[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+             {message && <p className="mt-2 text-[12px] text-[#605e5c]" role="status">{message}</p>}[39m

[31m+ export function deriveReportRiskFields(passport: ReportPassportRow) {[39m
[31m+   const verificationStatus = passport.verification_status || 'unverified';[39m
[31m+   const isMeasured = verificationStatus !== 'unverified';[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     canonicalScore: isMeasured ? passport.overall_score : null,[39m
[31m+     verificationStatus,[39m
[31m+     confidenceBasisPoints: isMeasured && passport.confidence_score != null ? Math.round(passport.confidence_score * 100) : null,[39m
[31m+     completenessBasisPoints: isMeasured && passport.evidence_completeness != null ? Math.round(passport.evidence_completeness * 100) : null,[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function buildReportTypeExtras(reportType: string, passport: any, findings: any[]) {[39m
[31m+   if (reportType === 'sbom') {[39m
[31m+     const components = parseJson(passport.sbom, []) as any[];[39m
[31m+     const vulnerabilities = parseJson(passport.vulnerabilities, []) as any[];[39m
[31m+     const sbom = components.map((component) => {[39m
[31m+       const name = component?.name || component?.packageName || component?.component;[39m
[31m+       const matched = vulnerabilities.filter((vuln) => (vuln?.component || vuln?.packageName || vuln?.package) === name);[39m
[31m+       return { ...component, vulnerabilityCount: matched.length, criticalOrHighCount: matched.filter((vuln) => SEVERITY_ORDER.slice(0, 2).includes(String(vuln?.severity || '').toLowerCase())).length };[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     return { sbom };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (reportType === 'compliance') {[39m
[31m+     const byControl = new Map<string, { controlId: string; findingCount: number; openCount: number; worstSeverity: string; findingIds: string[] }>();[39m
[31m+     for (const finding of findings) {[39m
[31m+       const controlId = finding.control_id || 'unmapped';[39m
[31m+       const entry = byControl.get(controlId) || { controlId, findingCount: 0, openCount: 0, worstSeverity: 'low', findingIds: [] as string[] };[39m
[31m+       entry.findingCount += 1;[39m
[31m+       entry.findingIds.push(finding.id);[39m
[31m+       if (!['resolved', 'closed', 'verified'].includes(String(finding.status || '').toLowerCase())) entry.openCount += 1;[39m
[31m+       const severity = String(finding.severity || '').toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+       if (SEVERITY_ORDER.includes(severity) && SEVERITY_ORDER.indexOf(severity) < SEVERITY_ORDER.indexOf(entry.worstSeverity)) entry.worstSeverity = severity;[39m
[31m+       byControl.set(controlId, entry);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return { controls: [...byControl.values()] };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return {};[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export async function buildAndPersistReport(db: any, tenantId: string, passportId: string, reportType: string) {[39m
[31m+   const passport = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,name,overall_score,security_score,compliance_score,verification_status,confidence_score,evidence_completeness,sbom,evidence,vulnerabilities,timeline FROM passports WHERE id=${passportId} AND tenant_id=${tenantId} LIMIT 1`) as any).rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+   if (!passport) return null;[39m
[31m+   const findings = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,control_id,title,severity,status,description,remediation,evidence_ids,updated_at,resolved_at FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'low' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END,updated_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const evidence = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,provider,control_id,subject,source_url,observed_at,verification_method,status,severity,evidence_hash,limitation FROM evidence_ledger WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY observed_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const observations = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,observation_version,generated_at,previous_observation_id,evidence_ids,finding_ids,canonical_payload_hash,completeness_basis_points,confidence_basis_points,open_finding_count,unknown_dimension_count FROM trust_observations WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY observation_version DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const remediation = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM trust_remediation_work_items WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const verification = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM remediation_verification_ledger WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND finding_id IN (SELECT id FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId}) ORDER BY created_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const latest = observations[0];[39m
[31m+   const risk = deriveReportRiskFields(passport as ReportPassportRow);[39m
[31m+   const report = {[39m
[31m+     schemaVersion: 'spr.report.v2', reportType, generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(), passport: { id: passport.id, name: passport.name },[39m
[31m+     risk: { overall: risk.canonicalScore, security: passport.security_score, compliance: passport.compliance_score, verificationStatus: risk.verificationStatus },[39m
[31m+     evidenceQuality: { completenessBasisPoints: risk.completenessBasisPoints, confidenceBasisPoints: risk.confidenceBasisPoints, unknownDimensions: latest?.unknown_dimension_count ?? 0, latestObservationAt: latest?.generated_at ?? null },[39m
[31m+     findings, evidence, observations, remediation, verification,[39m
[31m+     traceability: 'Report -> Passport -> Risk -> Finding -> Observation -> Provider -> Source -> Timestamp -> Hash',[39m
[31m+     resolutionTraceability: 'Finding -> remediation -> new observation -> independent verification',[39m
[31m+     limitations: evidence.filter((item: any) => item.limitation).map((item: any) => ({ evidenceId: item.id, limitation: item.limitation })),[39m
[31m+     ...buildReportTypeExtras(reportType, passport, findings),[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+   const canonicalPayload = JSON.stringify(report);[39m
[31m+   const reportHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalPayload).digest('hex');[39m
[31m+   await db.execute(sql`INSERT INTO trust_report_snapshots (id,tenant_id,passport_id,report_type,generated_at,score,confidence_basis_points,completeness_basis_points,evidence_ids,finding_ids,observation_id,canonical_payload_hash,payload,created_at) VALUES (${id('report')},${tenantId},${passportId},${reportType},${report.generatedAt},${risk.canonicalScore},${risk.confidenceBasisPoints},${risk.completenessBasisPoints},${JSON.stringify(evidence.map((item: any) => item.id))},${JSON.stringify(findings.map((item: any) => item.id))},${latest?.id ?? null},${reportHash},${canonicalPayload},${report.generatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,passport_id,report_type,canonical_payload_hash) DO NOTHING`);[39m
[31m+   return { ...report, reportHash };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+       const severity = String(finding.severity || '').toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+       if (SEVERITY_ORDER.includes(severity) && SEVERITY_ORDER.indexOf(severity) < SEVERITY_ORDER.indexOf(entry.worstSeverity)) entry.worstSeverity = severity;[39m
[31m+       byControl.set(controlId, entry);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return { controls: [...byControl.values()] };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return {};[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+ export async function buildAndPersistReport(db: any, tenantId: string, passportId: string, reportType: string) {[39m
[31m+   const passport = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,name,overall_score,security_score,compliance_score,verification_status,confidence_score,evidence_completeness,sbom,evidence,vulnerabilities,timeline FROM passports WHERE id=${passportId} AND tenant_id=${tenantId} LIMIT 1`) as any).rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+   if (!passport) return null;[39m
[31m+   const findings = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,control_id,title,severity,status,description,remediation,evidence_ids,updated_at,resolved_at FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'low' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END,updated_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const evidence = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,provider,control_id,subject,source_url,observed_at,verification_method,status,severity,evidence_hash,limitation FROM evidence_ledger WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY observed_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const observations = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,observation_version,generated_at,previous_observation_id,evidence_ids,finding_ids,canonical_payload_hash,completeness_basis_points,confidence_basis_points,open_finding_count,unknown_dimension_count FROM trust_observations WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY observation_version DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const remediation = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM trust_remediation_work_items WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const verification = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM remediation_verification_ledger WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND finding_id IN (SELECT id FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId}) ORDER BY created_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const latest = observations[0];[39m
[31m+   const risk = deriveReportRiskFields(passport as ReportPassportRow);[39m
[31m+   const report = {[39m
[31m+     schemaVersion: 'spr.report.v2', reportType, generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(), passport: { id: passport.id, name: passport.name },[39m
[31m+     risk: { overall: risk.canonicalScore, security: passport.security_score, compliance: passport.compliance_score, verificationStatus: risk.verificationStatus },[39m
[31m+     evidenceQuality: { completenessBasisPoints: risk.completenessBasisPoints, confidenceBasisPoints: risk.confidenceBasisPoints, unknownDimensions: latest?.unknown_dimension_count ?? 0, latestObservationAt: latest?.generated_at ?? null },[39m
[31m+     findings, evidence, observations, remediation, verification,[39m
[31m+     traceability: 'Report -> Passport -> Risk -> Finding -> Observation -> Provider -> Source -> Timestamp -> Hash',[39m
[31m+     resolutionTraceability: 'Finding -> remediation -> new observation -> independent verification',[39m
[31m+     limitations: evidence.filter((item: any) => item.limitation).map((item: any) => ({ evidenceId: item.id, limitation: item.limitation })),[39m
[31m+     ...buildReportTypeExtras(reportType, passport, findings),[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+   const canonicalPayload = JSON.stringify(report);[39m
[31m+   const reportHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalPayload).digest('hex');[39m

[31m+ export function deriveReportRiskFields(passport: ReportPassportRow) {[39m
[31m+   const verificationStatus = passport.verification_status || 'unverified';[39m
[31m+   const isMeasured = verificationStatus !== 'unverified';[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     canonicalScore: isMeasured ? passport.overall_score : null,[39m
[31m+     verificationStatus,[39m
[31m+     confidenceBasisPoints: isMeasured && passport.confidence_score != null ? Math.round(passport.confidence_score * 100) : null,[39m
[31m+     completenessBasisPoints: isMeasured && passport.evidence_completeness != null ? Math.round(passport.evidence_completeness * 100) : null,[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function buildReportTypeExtras(reportType: string, passport: any, findings: any[]) {[39m
[31m+   if (reportType === 'sbom') {[39m
[31m+     const components = parseJson(passport.sbom, []) as any[];[39m
[31m+     const vulnerabilities = parseJson(passport.vulnerabilities, []) as any[];[39m
[31m+     const sbom = components.map((component) => {[39m
[31m+       const name = component?.name || component?.packageName || component?.component;[39m
[31m+       const matched = vulnerabilities.filter((vuln) => (vuln?.component || vuln?.packageName || vuln?.package) === name);[39m
[31m+       return { ...component, vulnerabilityCount: matched.length, criticalOrHighCount: matched.filter((vuln) => SEVERITY_ORDER.slice(0, 2).includes(String(vuln?.severity || '').toLowerCase())).length };[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     return { sbom };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (reportType === 'compliance') {[39m
[31m+     const byControl = new Map<string, { controlId: string; findingCount: number; openCount: number; worstSeverity: string; findingIds: string[] }>();[39m
[31m+     for (const finding of findings) {[39m
[31m+       const controlId = finding.control_id || 'unmapped';[39m
[31m+       const entry = byControl.get(controlId) || { controlId, findingCount: 0, openCount: 0, worstSeverity: 'low', findingIds: [] as string[] };[39m
[31m+       entry.findingCount += 1;[39m
[31m+       entry.findingIds.push(finding.id);[39m
[31m+       if (!['resolved', 'closed', 'verified'].includes(String(finding.status || '').toLowerCase())) entry.openCount += 1;[39m
[31m+       const severity = String(finding.severity || '').toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+       if (SEVERITY_ORDER.includes(severity) && SEVERITY_ORDER.indexOf(severity) < SEVERITY_ORDER.indexOf(entry.worstSeverity)) entry.worstSeverity = severity;[39m
[31m+       byControl.set(controlId, entry);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return { controls: [...byControl.values()] };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return {};[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export async function buildAndPersistReport(db: any, tenantId: string, passportId: string, reportType: string) {[39m
[31m+   const passport = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,name,overall_score,security_score,compliance_score,verification_status,confidence_score,evidence_completeness,sbom,evidence,vulnerabilities,timeline FROM passports WHERE id=${passportId} AND tenant_id=${tenantId} LIMIT 1`) as any).rows?.[0];[39m
[31m+   if (!passport) return null;[39m
[31m+   const findings = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,control_id,title,severity,status,description,remediation,evidence_ids,updated_at,resolved_at FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'low' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END,updated_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const evidence = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,provider,control_id,subject,source_url,observed_at,verification_method,status,severity,evidence_hash,limitation FROM evidence_ledger WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY observed_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const observations = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id,observation_version,generated_at,previous_observation_id,evidence_ids,finding_ids,canonical_payload_hash,completeness_basis_points,confidence_basis_points,open_finding_count,unknown_dimension_count FROM trust_observations WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY observation_version DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const remediation = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM trust_remediation_work_items WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const verification = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM remediation_verification_ledger WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND finding_id IN (SELECT id FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id=${passportId}) ORDER BY created_at DESC`) as any).rows || [];[39m
[31m+   const latest = observations[0];[39m
[31m+   const risk = deriveReportRiskFields(passport as ReportPassportRow);[39m
[31m+   const report = {[39m
[31m+     schemaVersion: 'spr.report.v2', reportType, generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(), passport: { id: passport.id, name: passport.name },[39m
[31m+     risk: { overall: risk.canonicalScore, security: passport.security_score, compliance: passport.compliance_score, verificationStatus: risk.verificationStatus },[39m
[31m+     evidenceQuality: { completenessBasisPoints: risk.completenessBasisPoints, confidenceBasisPoints: risk.confidenceBasisPoints, unknownDimensions: latest?.unknown_dimension_count ?? 0, latestObservationAt: latest?.generated_at ?? null },[39m
[31m+     findings, evidence, observations, remediation, verification,[39m
[31m+     traceability: 'Report -> Passport -> Risk -> Finding -> Observation -> Provider -> Source -> Timestamp -> Hash',[39m
[31m+     resolutionTraceability: 'Finding -> remediation -> new observation -> independent verification',[39m
[31m+     limitations: evidence.filter((item: any) => item.limitation).map((item: any) => ({ evidenceId: item.id, limitation: item.limitation })),[39m
[31m+     ...buildReportTypeExtras(reportType, passport, findings),[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+   const canonicalPayload = JSON.stringify(report);[39m
[31m+   const reportHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalPayload).digest('hex');[39m
[31m+   await db.execute(sql`INSERT INTO trust_report_snapshots (id,tenant_id,passport_id,report_type,generated_at,score,confidence_basis_points,completeness_basis_points,evidence_ids,finding_ids,observation_id,canonical_payload_hash,payload,created_at) VALUES (${id('report')},${tenantId},${passportId},${reportType},${report.generatedAt},${risk.canonicalScore},${risk.confidenceBasisPoints},${risk.completenessBasisPoints},${JSON.stringify(evidence.map((item: any) => item.id))},${JSON.stringify(findings.map((item: any) => item.id))},${latest?.id ?? null},${reportHash},${canonicalPayload},${report.generatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,passport_id,report_type,canonical_payload_hash) DO NOTHING`);[39m
[31m+   return { ...report, reportHash };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ async function shutdown(signal: string) { if (shuttingDown) return; shuttingDown = true; console.info(`[SPR] ${signal} received; shutting down gracefully.`); const forceTimer = setTimeout(() => process.exit(1), 15_000); forceTimer.unref(); if (server) await new Promise<void>(resolve => server!.close(() => resolve())); await closeDatabase().catch(error => console.error('[SPR] Database shutdown error:', error)); if (config.sentry.dsn) await Sentry.close(2_000).catch(() => undefined); clearTimeout(forceTimer); process.exit(0); }[39m

[31m+     e.preventDefault();[39m
[31m+     if (!newBpName || !newBpVersion) {[39m
[31m+       alert('Please enter a product name and baseline secure version.');[39m

[31m+       baselineSecureVersion: newBpVersion,[39m
[31m+       allowedLicenses: newBpAllowedLics.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean),[39m

[31m+   const handleRunSandboxAudit = () => {[39m
[31m+     let targetName = sandboxProduct;[39m
[31m+     if (sandboxProduct === 'custom' && sandboxCustomName) {[39m
[31m+       targetName = sandboxCustomName;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+     const matchedBp = bibleProducts.find(bp =>[39m
[31m+       bp.name.toLowerCase() === targetName.toLowerCase() ||[39m
[31m+       targetName.toLowerCase().includes(bp.name.toLowerCase())[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+     let versionStatus: 'Compliant' | 'Warning' | 'Fail' = 'Compliant';[39m
[31m+     let versionDetails = '';[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+     const inputVer = sandboxVersion.trim();[39m
[31m+     if (!inputVer) {[39m
[31m+       versionStatus = 'Warning';[39m
[31m+       versionDetails = 'No version specified. Auditing engine cannot verify baseline standards.';[39m
[31m+     } else if (matchedBp) {[39m
[31m+       const baseline = matchedBp.baselineSecureVersion;[39m
[31m+       const baselineNum = parseFloat(baseline.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, ''));[39m
[31m+       const inputNum = parseFloat(inputVer.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, ''));[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+       if (!isNaN(baselineNum) && !isNaN(inputNum)) {[39m
[31m+         if (inputNum < baselineNum) {[39m
[31m+           versionStatus = 'Fail';[39m
[31m+           versionDetails = `Ingested version v${inputVer} is older than the recommended secure baseline v${baseline}. Potential known CVE exposures exist!`;[39m
[31m+         } else {[39m
[31m+           versionStatus = 'Compliant';[39m
[31m+           versionDetails = `Version v${inputVer} matches or exceeds secure baseline standards (v${baseline}).`;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         versionDetails = `Assumed compatible with baseline standards (Recommended baseline: v${baseline}).`;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       versionDetails = 'Unregistered custom software. Compliance baseline has not been defined in the Master Bible.';[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+     let licenseStatus: 'Compliant' | 'Warning' | 'Fail' = 'Compliant';[39m
[31m+     let licenseDetails = '';[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+     if (matchedBp) {[39m
[31m+       const allowed = matchedBp.allowedLicenses.map((l: string) => l.toLowerCase());[39m
[31m+       const disallowed = matchedBp.disallowedLicenses.map((l: string) => l.toLowerCase());[39m
[31m+       const queryLic = sandboxLicense.trim().toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+       if (disallowed.includes(queryLic)) {[39m
[31m+         licenseStatus = 'Fail';[39m
[31m+         licenseDetails = `License "${sandboxLicense}" is strictly prohibited for the enterprise by corporate policy. Refuse deployments.`;[39m
[31m+       } else if (allowed.length > 0 && !allowed.includes(queryLic)) {[39m
[31m+         licenseStatus = 'Warning';[39m
[31m+         licenseDetails = `License "${sandboxLicense}" is not explicitly greenlisted in the Master Bible for ${matchedBp.name}. Legal review recommended.`;[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         licenseStatus = 'Compliant';[39m
[31m+         licenseDetails = `License "${sandboxLicense}" matches greenlisted standards for this software class.`;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       const queryLic = sandboxLicense.trim().toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+       if (['gpl-3.0', 'agpl-3.0', 'gpl-3.0-only', 'agpl-3.0-only', 'sspl-1.0'].includes(queryLic)) {[39m
[31m+         licenseStatus = 'Fail';[39m
[31m+         licenseDetails = `Copyleft license "${sandboxLicense}" detected. Deploying to commercial client clouds presents critical proprietary exposure risks.`;[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         licenseStatus = 'Compliant';[39m
[31m+         licenseDetails = `License "${sandboxLicense}" is typical of standard permissible open-source software libraries.`;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+     const complianceTarget = matchedBp ? matchedBp.complianceTarget : 'General NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 / CIS Safeguards';[39m
[31m+     const safeguardPolicy = matchedBp ? matchedBp.safeguardPolicy : 'Verify cryptographic signature (SLSA/Cosign), restrict container capabilities, and verify dependency CVE maps prior to operational staging.';[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+     let overallStatus: 'PASS' | 'WARN' | 'FAIL' = 'PASS';[39m
[31m+     if (versionStatus === 'Fail' || licenseStatus === 'Fail') {[39m
[31m+       overallStatus = 'FAIL';[39m
[31m+     } else if (versionStatus === 'Warning' || licenseStatus === 'Warning') {[39m
[31m+       overallStatus = 'WARN';[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+     setSandboxReport({[39m
[31m+       productName: targetName,[39m
[31m+       version: inputVer || 'unknown',[39m
[31m+       license: sandboxLicense,[39m
[31m+       environment: sandboxEnv,[39m
[31m+       overallStatus,[39m
[31m+       versionStatus,[39m
[31m+       versionDetails,[39m
[31m+       licenseStatus,[39m
[31m+       licenseDetails,[39m
[31m+       complianceTarget,[39m
[31m+       safeguardPolicy,[39m
[31m+       timestamp: new Date().toISOString()[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   };[39m

[31m+       const inputNum = parseFloat(inputVer.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, ''));[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+       if (!isNaN(baselineNum) && !isNaN(inputNum)) {[39m
[31m+         if (inputNum < baselineNum) {[39m
[31m+           versionStatus = 'Fail';[39m
[31m+           versionDetails = `Ingested version v${inputVer} is older than the recommended secure baseline v${baseline}. Potential known CVE exposures exist!`;[39m

[31m+           versionDetails = `Version v${inputVer} matches or exceeds secure baseline standards (v${baseline}).`;[39m

[31m+       const baselineNum = parseFloat(baseline.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, ''));[39m
[31m+       const inputNum = parseFloat(inputVer.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, ''));[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+       if (!isNaN(baselineNum) && !isNaN(inputNum)) {[39m
[31m+         if (inputNum < baselineNum) {[39m
[31m+           versionStatus = 'Fail';[39m
[31m+           versionDetails = `Ingested version v${inputVer} is older than the recommended secure baseline v${baseline}. Potential known CVE exposures exist!`;[39m
[31m+         } else {[39m
[31m+           versionStatus = 'Compliant';[39m
[31m+           versionDetails = `Version v${inputVer} matches or exceeds secure baseline standards (v${baseline}).`;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         versionDetails = `Assumed compatible with baseline standards (Recommended baseline: v${baseline}).`;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       versionDetails = 'Unregistered custom software. Compliance baseline has not been defined in the Master Bible.';[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+     let licenseStatus: 'Compliant' | 'Warning' | 'Fail' = 'Compliant';[39m
[31m+     let licenseDetails = '';[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+     if (matchedBp) {[39m
[31m+       const allowed = matchedBp.allowedLicenses.map((l: string) => l.toLowerCase());[39m
[31m+       const disallowed = matchedBp.disallowedLicenses.map((l: string) => l.toLowerCase());[39m
[31m+       const queryLic = sandboxLicense.trim().toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+       if (disallowed.includes(queryLic)) {[39m
[31m+         licenseStatus = 'Fail';[39m
[31m+         licenseDetails = `License "${sandboxLicense}" is strictly prohibited for the enterprise by corporate policy. Refuse deployments.`;[39m
[31m+       } else if (allowed.length > 0 && !allowed.includes(queryLic)) {[39m
[31m+         licenseStatus = 'Warning';[39m
[31m+         licenseDetails = `License "${sandboxLicense}" is not explicitly greenlisted in the Master Bible for ${matchedBp.name}. Legal review recommended.`;[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         licenseStatus = 'Compliant';[39m
[31m+         licenseDetails = `License "${sandboxLicense}" matches greenlisted standards for this software class.`;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       const queryLic = sandboxLicense.trim().toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+       if (['gpl-3.0', 'agpl-3.0', 'gpl-3.0-only', 'agpl-3.0-only', 'sspl-1.0'].includes(queryLic)) {[39m
[31m+         licenseStatus = 'Fail';[39m
[31m+         licenseDetails = `Copyleft license "${sandboxLicense}" detected. Deploying to commercial client clouds presents critical proprietary exposure risks.`;[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         licenseStatus = 'Compliant';[39m
[31m+         licenseDetails = `License "${sandboxLicense}" is typical of standard permissible open-source software libraries.`;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+     const complianceTarget = matchedBp ? matchedBp.complianceTarget : 'General NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 / CIS Safeguards';[39m
[31m+     const safeguardPolicy = matchedBp ? matchedBp.safeguardPolicy : 'Verify cryptographic signature (SLSA/Cosign), restrict container capabilities, and verify dependency CVE maps prior to operational staging.';[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+     let overallStatus: 'PASS' | 'WARN' | 'FAIL' = 'PASS';[39m
[31m+     if (versionStatus === 'Fail' || licenseStatus === 'Fail') {[39m
[31m+       overallStatus = 'FAIL';[39m
[31m+     } else if (versionStatus === 'Warning' || licenseStatus === 'Warning') {[39m
[31m+       overallStatus = 'WARN';[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+     setSandboxReport({[39m
[31m+       productName: targetName,[39m
[31m+       version: inputVer || 'unknown',[39m
[31m+       license: sandboxLicense,[39m
[31m+       environment: sandboxEnv,[39m
[31m+       overallStatus,[39m
[31m+       versionStatus,[39m
[31m+       versionDetails,[39m
[31m+       licenseStatus,[39m
[31m+       licenseDetails,[39m
[31m+       complianceTarget,[39m
[31m+       safeguardPolicy,[39m
[31m+       timestamp: new Date().toISOString()[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="space-y-4" id="msp-settings-view">[39m
[31m+       {/* Page Header */}[39m

[31m+   const handleRunSandboxAudit = () => {[39m
[31m+     let targetName = sandboxProduct;[39m
[31m+     if (sandboxProduct === 'custom' && sandboxCustomName) {[39m
[31m+       targetName = sandboxCustomName;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+     const matchedBp = bibleProducts.find(bp =>[39m
[31m+       bp.name.toLowerCase() === targetName.toLowerCase() ||[39m
[31m+       targetName.toLowerCase().includes(bp.name.toLowerCase())[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+     let versionStatus: 'Compliant' | 'Warning' | 'Fail' = 'Compliant';[39m
[31m+     let versionDetails = '';[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+     const inputVer = sandboxVersion.trim();[39m
[31m+     if (!inputVer) {[39m
[31m+       versionStatus = 'Warning';[39m
[31m+       versionDetails = 'No version specified. Auditing engine cannot verify baseline standards.';[39m
[31m+     } else if (matchedBp) {[39m
[31m+       const baseline = matchedBp.baselineSecureVersion;[39m
[31m+       const baselineNum = parseFloat(baseline.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, ''));[39m
[31m+       const inputNum = parseFloat(inputVer.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, ''));[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+       if (!isNaN(baselineNum) && !isNaN(inputNum)) {[39m
[31m+         if (inputNum < baselineNum) {[39m
[31m+           versionStatus = 'Fail';[39m
[31m+           versionDetails = `Ingested version v${inputVer} is older than the recommended secure baseline v${baseline}. Potential known CVE exposures exist!`;[39m
[31m+         } else {[39m
[31m+           versionStatus = 'Compliant';[39m
[31m+           versionDetails = `Version v${inputVer} matches or exceeds secure baseline standards (v${baseline}).`;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         versionDetails = `Assumed compatible with baseline standards (Recommended baseline: v${baseline}).`;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       versionDetails = 'Unregistered custom software. Compliance baseline has not been defined in the Master Bible.';[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+     let licenseStatus: 'Compliant' | 'Warning' | 'Fail' = 'Compliant';[39m
[31m+     let licenseDetails = '';[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+     if (matchedBp) {[39m
[31m+       const allowed = matchedBp.allowedLicenses.map((l: string) => l.toLowerCase());[39m
[31m+       const disallowed = matchedBp.disallowedLicenses.map((l: string) => l.toLowerCase());[39m
[31m+       const queryLic = sandboxLicense.trim().toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+       if (disallowed.includes(queryLic)) {[39m
[31m+         licenseStatus = 'Fail';[39m
[31m+         licenseDetails = `License "${sandboxLicense}" is strictly prohibited for the enterprise by corporate policy. Refuse deployments.`;[39m
[31m+       } else if (allowed.length > 0 && !allowed.includes(queryLic)) {[39m
[31m+         licenseStatus = 'Warning';[39m
[31m+         licenseDetails = `License "${sandboxLicense}" is not explicitly greenlisted in the Master Bible for ${matchedBp.name}. Legal review recommended.`;[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         licenseStatus = 'Compliant';[39m
[31m+         licenseDetails = `License "${sandboxLicense}" matches greenlisted standards for this software class.`;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       const queryLic = sandboxLicense.trim().toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+       if (['gpl-3.0', 'agpl-3.0', 'gpl-3.0-only', 'agpl-3.0-only', 'sspl-1.0'].includes(queryLic)) {[39m
[31m+         licenseStatus = 'Fail';[39m
[31m+         licenseDetails = `Copyleft license "${sandboxLicense}" detected. Deploying to commercial client clouds presents critical proprietary exposure risks.`;[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         licenseStatus = 'Compliant';[39m
[31m+         licenseDetails = `License "${sandboxLicense}" is typical of standard permissible open-source software libraries.`;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+     const complianceTarget = matchedBp ? matchedBp.complianceTarget : 'General NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 / CIS Safeguards';[39m
[31m+     const safeguardPolicy = matchedBp ? matchedBp.safeguardPolicy : 'Verify cryptographic signature (SLSA/Cosign), restrict container capabilities, and verify dependency CVE maps prior to operational staging.';[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+     let overallStatus: 'PASS' | 'WARN' | 'FAIL' = 'PASS';[39m
[31m+     if (versionStatus === 'Fail' || licenseStatus === 'Fail') {[39m
[31m+       overallStatus = 'FAIL';[39m
[31m+     } else if (versionStatus === 'Warning' || licenseStatus === 'Warning') {[39m
[31m+       overallStatus = 'WARN';[39m
[31m+     }[39m

[31m+     setSandboxReport({[39m
[31m+       productName: targetName,[39m
[31m+       version: inputVer || 'unknown',[39m

[31m+       licenseDetails,[39m
[31m+       complianceTarget,[39m
[31m+       safeguardPolicy,[39m
[31m+       timestamp: new Date().toISOString()[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   };[39m

[31m+         timestamp: row.timestamp,[39m

[31m+         payload: row.payload,[39m
[31m+         hash: row.currentHash,[39m
[31m+         currentHash: row.currentHash,[39m

[31m+   // Owner-only operational health for the command center. Every section reads[39m
[31m+   // from the real tables the corresponding subsystem already writes -- no[39m
[31m+   // second heartbeat, delivery ledger, integration status, or audit verifier[39m
[31m+   // is created here. Sections with no real backing data are omitted rather[39m
[31m+   // than populated with placeholder values; see the `notes` field.[39m
[31m+   router.get('/founder/operations', requireAuth, requireRole('Owner'), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m
[31m+       const notes: string[] = [];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- A. Worker/job health ---------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       // osv-worker.ts claims agent_jobs rows (job_type osv_manifest_scan /[39m
[31m+       // repository_scan). It has no separate heartbeat row; the queue state[39m
[31m+       // itself (locked_at/locked_by, the same 10-minute staleness window the[39m
[31m+       // worker uses to reclaim stuck jobs) is the real signal.[39m
[31m+       const [osvCounts, osvStale, osvFailures, osvActivity] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT job_type AS "jobType", status, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') GROUP BY job_type, status`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') AND status='Running' AND locked_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, job_type AS "jobType", error, attempt_count AS "attemptCount", max_attempts AS "maxAttempts", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') AND status='Failed' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 5`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT MAX(updated_at) AS "lastActivityAt" FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan')`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // monitoring-worker.ts (the file name this dashboard's spec named) is not[39m
[31m+       // imported by worker.ts and never runs in production -- confirmed dead[39m
[31m+       // code, not a running system. trust-monitoring-worker.ts is the real,[39m
[31m+       // currently-running system that plays the equivalent role (collector_jobs[39m
[31m+       // has an actual heartbeat_at column, unlike agent_jobs).[39m
[31m+       const [monitoringCounts, monitoringHeartbeat, monitoringFailures] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT state, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} GROUP BY state`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT MAX(heartbeat_at) AS "lastHeartbeatAt" FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND state='running'`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, collector_id AS "collectorId", safe_error_code AS "errorCode", safe_error_message AS "errorMessage", completed_at AS "completedAt" FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND state IN ('failed','dead_lettered') ORDER BY completed_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       notes.push('monitoring-worker.ts is dead code (never imported by worker.ts); "monitoringWorker" below reflects trust-monitoring-worker.ts, the real running system for the same role.');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- B. Webhook delivery health ----------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       const [webhookCounts, webhookEndpoints, webhookFailures] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT status, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM spr_webhook_deliveries WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND created_at::timestamptz > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY status`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE active)::int AS "activeCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT active)::int AS "disabledCount" FROM spr_webhooks WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId}`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT d.id, d.webhook_id AS "webhookId", w.url, d.event_type AS "eventType", d.safe_error_code AS "errorCode", d.safe_error_message AS "errorMessage", d.completed_at AS "completedAt" FROM spr_webhook_deliveries d JOIN spr_webhooks w ON w.id=d.webhook_id AND w.tenant_id=d.tenant_id WHERE d.tenant_id=${tenantId} AND d.status IN ('failed','dead_lettered') ORDER BY d.completed_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       notes.push('Webhook failures are grouped by destination endpoint (webhookId/url), not "provider" -- SPR webhooks are user-configured destination URLs, not third-party provider connectors; there is no per-provider concept for outbound deliveries.');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- C. Integration health ----------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       const [credentialRows, integrationRows] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT provider, status, last_tested_at AS "lastTestedAt" FROM integration_credentials WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId}`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT name, connected, last_sync_date AS "lastSyncDate" FROM integrations WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId}`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       const credentialByProvider = new Map<string, any>((credentialRows as any).rows?.map((r: any) => [r.provider, r]) ?? []);[39m
[31m+       const integrationByName = new Map<string, any>((integrationRows as any).rows?.map((r: any) => [r.name, r]) ?? []);[39m
[31m+       const integrations = INTEGRATION_CATALOG.map((item) => ({[39m
[31m+         provider: item.provider,[39m
[31m+         name: item.name,[39m
[31m+         connected: Boolean(integrationByName.get(item.name)?.connected),[39m
[31m+         lastSyncDate: integrationByName.get(item.name)?.lastSyncDate ?? null,[39m
[31m+         credentialStatus: credentialByProvider.get(item.provider)?.status ?? 'NOT_CONFIGURED',[39m
[31m+         lastTestedAt: credentialByProvider.get(item.provider)?.lastTestedAt ?? null,[39m
[31m+       }));[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- D. Audit chain integrity --------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       // Reuses the exact function GET /api/auth/audit-chain/verify calls --[39m
[31m+       // no second verifier.[39m
[31m+       const auditChain = await verifyAuditChain(db, tenantId);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- E. Scan / job queue --------------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       const [runningRepoScans, complianceSchedules] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, passport_id AS "passportId", status, progress, updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type='repository_scan' AND status='Running' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 10`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, client_id AS "clientId", frequency, status, last_audit_at AS "lastAuditAt", next_audit_at AS "nextAuditAt" FROM compliance_schedules WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} ORDER BY COALESCE(last_audit_at, created_at) DESC LIMIT 10`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return res.json({[39m
[31m+         generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),[39m
[31m+         workers: {[39m
[31m+           osv: {[39m
[31m+             countsByStatus: (osvCounts as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+             staleRunningCount: Number((osvStale as any).rows?.[0]?.count ?? 0),[39m
[31m+             recentFailures: (osvFailures as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+             lastActivityAt: (osvActivity as any).rows?.[0]?.lastActivityAt ?? null,[39m
[31m+           },[39m
[31m+           monitoringWorker: {[39m
[31m+             realSource: 'trust-monitoring-worker.ts (collector_jobs)',[39m
[31m+             countsByState: (monitoringCounts as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+             lastHeartbeatAt: (monitoringHeartbeat as any).rows?.[0]?.lastHeartbeatAt ?? null,[39m
[31m+             recentFailures: (monitoringFailures as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+           },[39m
[31m+         },[39m
[31m+         webhooks: {[39m
[31m+           countsByStatusLast7Days: (webhookCounts as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+           activeEndpoints: Number((webhookEndpoints as any).rows?.[0]?.activeCount ?? 0),[39m
[31m+           disabledEndpoints: Number((webhookEndpoints as any).rows?.[0]?.disabledCount ?? 0),[39m
[31m+           recentFailures: (webhookFailures as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+         },[39m
[31m+         integrations,[39m
[31m+         auditChain,[39m
[31m+         queue: {[39m
[31m+           runningRepositoryScans: (runningRepoScans as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+           recentlyFailedJobs: (osvFailures as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+           complianceSchedules: (complianceSchedules as any).rows ?? [],[39m
[31m+         },[39m
[31m+         notes,[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+       return next(error);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   });[39m

[31m+   router.get('/user/verification', requireAuth, async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m
[31m+       const clientScope = req.user!.role === 'Client' ? (req.user as any).clientId : null;[39m
[31m+       const passportRows = (await db.execute(sql`SELECT id, version, evidence, client_id AS "clientId" FROM passports WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND (${clientScope} IS NULL OR client_id=${clientScope}) ORDER BY id`) as any).rows ?? [];[39m
[31m+       const passportIds = passportRows.map((row: any) => String(row.id));[39m
[31m+       const parseJson = (value: unknown): unknown[] => { try { const parsed = JSON.parse(String(value ?? '')); return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : []; } catch { return []; } };[39m
[31m+       // Drizzle's proven one-query binding shape for the passport findings is[39m
[31m+       // `asset_id IN ${passportIds}`; do not replace this with ANY(array).[39m
[31m+       const findingRows = passportIds.length ? ((await db.execute(sql`SELECT id, passport_id AS "passportId", evidence_ids, status FROM trust_findings WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND passport_id IN ${passportIds}`) as any).rows ?? []) : [];[39m
[31m+       const evidenceByPassport = new Map<string, any[]>();[39m
[31m+       for (const passport of passportRows) evidenceByPassport.set(String(passport.id), parseJson(passport.evidence) as any[]);[39m
[31m+       const evaluatedAt = Date.now();[39m
[31m+       const verificationDecisions: Record<string, VerificationDecision> = {};[39m
[31m+       const verificationDetails: Record<string, unknown> = {};[39m
[31m+       for (const passport of passportRows) {[39m
[31m+         const findings = findingRows.filter((row: any) => String(row.passportId) === String(passport.id));[39m
[31m+         const openFindingEvidenceIds = findings.filter((row: any) => !['resolved','closed','verified'].includes(String(row.status || '').toLowerCase())).flatMap((row: any) => parseJson(row.evidence_ids)).filter((id: any): id is string => typeof id === 'string');[39m
[31m+         const adapted = adaptEvidenceForEvaluation({ evidence: evidenceByPassport.get(String(passport.id)) ?? [], passportVersion: passport.version, openFindingEvidenceIds });[39m
[31m+         const decision = evaluateVerification({ evidence: adapted.evidence, evaluatedAt, targetIdentity: adapted.targetIdentity });[39m
[31m+         verificationDecisions[String(passport.id)] = decision;[39m
[31m+         verificationDetails[String(passport.id)] = { unmappedCount: adapted.unmappedCount, undatedCount: adapted.undatedCount, observations: decision.observationCount, independentSources: decision.independentSourceCount };[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'private, max-age=0, no-store');[39m
[31m+       return res.json({ verificationDecisions, verificationDetails });[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) { return next(error); }[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return router;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export function createAuthRouter() {[39m
[31m+   const router = Router();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   // The Firebase ID token is the sole authentication authority. The database[39m
[31m+   // record supplies the tenant/RBAC projection after token verification.[39m
[31m+   router.get('/user/me', requireAuth, async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const user = await db.select({[39m
[31m+         id: users.id,[39m
[31m+         uid: users.uid,[39m
[31m+         email: users.email,[39m
[31m+         tenantId: users.tenantId,[39m
[31m+         role: users.role,[39m
[31m+         companyName: users.companyName,[39m
[31m+         roleTitle: users.roleTitle,[39m
[31m+         displayName: users.displayName,[39m
[31m+         numTechnicians: users.numTechnicians,[39m
[31m+         clientCount: users.clientCount,[39m
[31m+         primaryUseCase: users.primaryUseCase,[39m
[31m+         onboarded: users.onboarded,[39m
[31m+         mfaEnabled: users.mfaEnabled,[39m
[31m+         createdAt: users.createdAt,[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+   // Owner-only operational health for the command center. Every section reads[39m
[31m+   // from the real tables the corresponding subsystem already writes -- no[39m
[31m+   // second heartbeat, delivery ledger, integration status, or audit verifier[39m
[31m+   // is created here. Sections with no real backing data are omitted rather[39m
[31m+   // than populated with placeholder values; see the `notes` field.[39m
[31m+   router.get('/founder/operations', requireAuth, requireRole('Owner'), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m
[31m+       const notes: string[] = [];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- A. Worker/job health ---------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       // osv-worker.ts claims agent_jobs rows (job_type osv_manifest_scan /[39m
[31m+       // repository_scan). It has no separate heartbeat row; the queue state[39m
[31m+       // itself (locked_at/locked_by, the same 10-minute staleness window the[39m
[31m+       // worker uses to reclaim stuck jobs) is the real signal.[39m
[31m+       const [osvCounts, osvStale, osvFailures, osvActivity] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT job_type AS "jobType", status, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') GROUP BY job_type, status`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') AND status='Running' AND locked_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, job_type AS "jobType", error, attempt_count AS "attemptCount", max_attempts AS "maxAttempts", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') AND status='Failed' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 5`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT MAX(updated_at) AS "lastActivityAt" FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan')`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // monitoring-worker.ts (the file name this dashboard's spec named) is not[39m
[31m+       // imported by worker.ts and never runs in production -- confirmed dead[39m
[31m+       // code, not a running system. trust-monitoring-worker.ts is the real,[39m
[31m+       // currently-running system that plays the equivalent role (collector_jobs[39m
[31m+       // has an actual heartbeat_at column, unlike agent_jobs).[39m
[31m+       const [monitoringCounts, monitoringHeartbeat, monitoringFailures] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT state, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} GROUP BY state`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT MAX(heartbeat_at) AS "lastHeartbeatAt" FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND state='running'`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, collector_id AS "collectorId", safe_error_code AS "errorCode", safe_error_message AS "errorMessage", completed_at AS "completedAt" FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND state IN ('failed','dead_lettered') ORDER BY completed_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       notes.push('monitoring-worker.ts is dead code (never imported by worker.ts); "monitoringWorker" below reflects trust-monitoring-worker.ts, the real running system for the same role.');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- B. Webhook delivery health ----------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       const [webhookCounts, webhookEndpoints, webhookFailures] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT status, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM spr_webhook_deliveries WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND created_at::timestamptz > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY status`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE active)::int AS "activeCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT active)::int AS "disabledCount" FROM spr_webhooks WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId}`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT d.id, d.webhook_id AS "webhookId", w.url, d.event_type AS "eventType", d.safe_error_code AS "errorCode", d.safe_error_message AS "errorMessage", d.completed_at AS "completedAt" FROM spr_webhook_deliveries d JOIN spr_webhooks w ON w.id=d.webhook_id AND w.tenant_id=d.tenant_id WHERE d.tenant_id=${tenantId} AND d.status IN ('failed','dead_lettered') ORDER BY d.completed_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       notes.push('Webhook failures are grouped by destination endpoint (webhookId/url), not "provider" -- SPR webhooks are user-configured destination URLs, not third-party provider connectors; there is no per-provider concept for outbound deliveries.');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- C. Integration health ----------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       const [credentialRows, integrationRows] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT provider, status, last_tested_at AS "lastTestedAt" FROM integration_credentials WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId}`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT name, connected, last_sync_date AS "lastSyncDate" FROM integrations WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId}`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m

[31m+   // Owner-only operational health for the command center. Every section reads[39m
[31m+   // from the real tables the corresponding subsystem already writes -- no[39m
[31m+   // second heartbeat, delivery ledger, integration status, or audit verifier[39m
[31m+   // is created here. Sections with no real backing data are omitted rather[39m
[31m+   // than populated with placeholder values; see the `notes` field.[39m
[31m+   router.get('/founder/operations', requireAuth, requireRole('Owner'), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res, next) => {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const db = req.db!;[39m
[31m+       const tenantId = req.user!.tenantId;[39m
[31m+       const notes: string[] = [];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- A. Worker/job health ---------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       // osv-worker.ts claims agent_jobs rows (job_type osv_manifest_scan /[39m
[31m+       // repository_scan). It has no separate heartbeat row; the queue state[39m
[31m+       // itself (locked_at/locked_by, the same 10-minute staleness window the[39m
[31m+       // worker uses to reclaim stuck jobs) is the real signal.[39m
[31m+       const [osvCounts, osvStale, osvFailures, osvActivity] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT job_type AS "jobType", status, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') GROUP BY job_type, status`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') AND status='Running' AND locked_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, job_type AS "jobType", error, attempt_count AS "attemptCount", max_attempts AS "maxAttempts", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan') AND status='Failed' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 5`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT MAX(updated_at) AS "lastActivityAt" FROM agent_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND job_type IN ('osv_manifest_scan','repository_scan')`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // monitoring-worker.ts (the file name this dashboard's spec named) is not[39m
[31m+       // imported by worker.ts and never runs in production -- confirmed dead[39m
[31m+       // code, not a running system. trust-monitoring-worker.ts is the real,[39m
[31m+       // currently-running system that plays the equivalent role (collector_jobs[39m
[31m+       // has an actual heartbeat_at column, unlike agent_jobs).[39m
[31m+       const [monitoringCounts, monitoringHeartbeat, monitoringFailures] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT state, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} GROUP BY state`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT MAX(heartbeat_at) AS "lastHeartbeatAt" FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND state='running'`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT id, collector_id AS "collectorId", safe_error_code AS "errorCode", safe_error_message AS "errorMessage", completed_at AS "completedAt" FROM collector_jobs WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND state IN ('failed','dead_lettered') ORDER BY completed_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       notes.push('monitoring-worker.ts is dead code (never imported by worker.ts); "monitoringWorker" below reflects trust-monitoring-worker.ts, the real running system for the same role.');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- B. Webhook delivery health ----------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       const [webhookCounts, webhookEndpoints, webhookFailures] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT status, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM spr_webhook_deliveries WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId} AND created_at::timestamptz > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY status`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE active)::int AS "activeCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT active)::int AS "disabledCount" FROM spr_webhooks WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId}`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT d.id, d.webhook_id AS "webhookId", w.url, d.event_type AS "eventType", d.safe_error_code AS "errorCode", d.safe_error_message AS "errorMessage", d.completed_at AS "completedAt" FROM spr_webhook_deliveries d JOIN spr_webhooks w ON w.id=d.webhook_id AND w.tenant_id=d.tenant_id WHERE d.tenant_id=${tenantId} AND d.status IN ('failed','dead_lettered') ORDER BY d.completed_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       notes.push('Webhook failures are grouped by destination endpoint (webhookId/url), not "provider" -- SPR webhooks are user-configured destination URLs, not third-party provider connectors; there is no per-provider concept for outbound deliveries.');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- C. Integration health ----------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       const [credentialRows, integrationRows] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT provider, status, last_tested_at AS "lastTestedAt" FROM integration_credentials WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId}`),[39m
[31m+         db.execute(sql`SELECT name, connected, last_sync_date AS "lastSyncDate" FROM integrations WHERE tenant_id=${tenantId}`),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+       const credentialByProvider = new Map<string, any>((credentialRows as any).rows?.map((r: any) => [r.provider, r]) ?? []);[39m
[31m+       const integrationByName = new Map<string, any>((integrationRows as any).rows?.map((r: any) => [r.name, r]) ?? []);[39m
[31m+       const integrations = INTEGRATION_CATALOG.map((item) => ({[39m
[31m+         provider: item.provider,[39m
[31m+         name: item.name,[39m
[31m+         connected: Boolean(integrationByName.get(item.name)?.connected),[39m
[31m+         lastSyncDate: integrationByName.get(item.name)?.lastSyncDate ?? null,[39m
[31m+         credentialStatus: credentialByProvider.get(item.provider)?.status ?? 'NOT_CONFIGURED',[39m
[31m+         lastTestedAt: credentialByProvider.get(item.provider)?.lastTestedAt ?? null,[39m
[31m+       }));[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // --- D. Audit chain integrity --------------------------------------------[39m
[31m+       // Reuses the exact function GET /api/auth/audit-chain/verify calls --[39m
[31m+       // no second verifier.[39m
[31m+       const auditChain = await verifyAuditChain(db, tenantId);[39m
